7b09e4e1.description:
Senior FDE (Resident Solution Architect) – Databricks Lakehouse

**Number of Positions:** 20  
**Salary Budget:** ₹22 Lakhs – ₹28 Lakhs per annum  
**Location:** Remote  
**Experience:** 7\+ Years in Data Engineering \| 10\+ Years in Consulting with Databricks Lakehouse

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced **Senior FDE (Resident Solution Architect)** to lead enterprise data engineering and analytics initiatives using the **Databricks Lakehouse Platform**.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in designing scalable data solutions, architecting cloud\-native platforms, and delivering high\-performance distributed data processing systems.

As a Resident Solution Architect, you will work closely with customers to define technical strategy, provide architectural guidance, optimize data platforms, and ensure successful delivery of enterprise\-scale data modernization programs.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and implement scalable, secure, and high\-performance data engineering solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse Platform.
* Lead end\-to\-end architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise data platforms.
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to customer and internal engineering teams.
* Develop and optimize distributed data processing pipelines using Apache Spark.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Drive cloud\-native data platform implementations across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices for production deployments.
* Apply performance tuning and scalability optimization techniques to improve platform efficiency.
* Work closely with Data Scientists and ML teams to support MLOps implementation where required.
* Stay current with Databricks platform capabilities and recommend best practices for enterprise adoption.

Required Qualifications

* 7\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platforms, and Analytics.
* 10\+ years of overall consulting experience.
* **Databricks Data Engineering Professional Certification is mandatory.**
* Completion of required Databricks training and certification courses.
* Proven experience delivering **6–8\+ Databricks implementation projects** with hands\-on development responsibilities.
* Strong expertise in distributed computing using Apache Spark, including Spark architecture and runtime internals.
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks platform features and ecosystem.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD practices for production\-grade deployments.
* Working knowledge of MLOps concepts and implementation.
* Experience in performance tuning and scalability optimization of large\-scale data workloads.

Cloud Expertise

Strong working knowledge of at least **two** major cloud platforms:

* Microsoft Azure
* Amazon Web Services (AWS)
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

Deep implementation expertise in at least one cloud platform is required.

Preferred Skills

* Enterprise Solution Architecture
* Data Lakehouse Architecture
* Cloud\-Native Data Platform Design
* Performance Optimization
* Data Pipeline Modernization
* Stakeholder Management
* Technical Consulting and Customer Engagement

Why Join Us?

* Work on large\-scale enterprise data modernization initiatives.
* Collaborate with industry\-leading architects and engineering teams.
* Drive innovation using the latest Databricks and cloud technologies.
* Influence strategic technology decisions for global customers.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant **Databricks, Apache Spark, Cloud, and Solution Architecture** experience are encouraged to apply.

**Please mention your total experience, Databricks experience, Databricks certification status, cloud expertise, and notice period while applying.**

45b2bd39.title: Data Architect & Canonical Model Lead
45b2bd39.description:
About Us: \*\*

BDIPlus, a US\-based leading transformation Consulting \& Customer Data Platform (CDP) company, is dedicated to delivering cutting\-edge capabilities and solutions that foster the development of enduring competitive advantages. Our innovative solutions showcase our unparalleled proficiency in technology and our profound domain expertise within the Financial Services and Insurance sectors. By synergizing our unmatched technical skills with a comprehensive grasp of each client’s institutional landscape and distinctive areas for improvement, we empower them to convert data into actionable and well\-organized information. This facilitates precise decision making, increased efficiency, and rampant business growth.

\*\*About the Role \*\*

We're seeking an experienced Data Architect \& Canonical Model Lead to own the canonical data model across multiple teams and systems. You'll design cross\-system entity models for policy, customer, and distributor data, lead architecture reviews, and — critically — see those models through to production: implemented in AWS, deployed through automated pipelines, and governed by contracts and quality checks that run without manual intervention.

This is not a documentation role. Models you design are expected to be enforced in running systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Canonical modelling and architecture:**

* Own canonical data model reconciliation across teams, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
* Design and maintain cross\-system entity models for policy, customer, distributor, claims, and product domains.
* Lead architecture reviews for alignment with enterprise data standards.
* Identify gaps and inconsistencies across systems and drive resolution.
* Mentor engineers and analysts on modelling and architecture practice.

**Implementation and production systems**

* Translate canonical models into physical implementations: warehouse and lakehouse schemas, event and API payload contracts, and mappings from source systems.
* Define and enforce data contracts between producers and consumers — schema, semantics, ownership, and SLAs — with breaking\-change detection in CI.
* Design integration patterns across batch, CDC, and event\-driven paths; own how entities are keyed, versioned, deduplicated, and resolved across systems.
* Model slowly changing dimensions, effective\-dating, and bitemporal history where policy and regulatory reporting require point\-in\-time accuracy.
* Embed automated data quality into pipelines — schema, referential integrity, freshness, and reconciliation checks between source and canonical layers, with alerting and quarantine rather than silent failure.
* Own lineage, cataloguing, and metadata so any field can be traced to source and to consumer.

**AWS and deployment**

* Design and govern the data platform on AWS: S3\-based lake with Glue Catalog, Redshift and/or Athena, Lake Formation for access control, and Glue, EMR, or Databricks for processing.
* Define deployment practice for data assets — schemas, models, and pipelines managed as code through Git, with CI/CD, environment promotion (dev/test/prod), and reviewable, reversible schema migrations.
* Manage infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and set standards for the teams building on the platform.
* Set orchestration and observability standards across pipelines, including monitoring, alerting, cost visibility, and incident response for data outages.

**Governance**

* Ensure compliance with data governance, security, privacy, and retention standards.
* Design access controls, masking, and tokenisation appropriate to a regulated environment, and support audit and regulatory reporting requirements.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* 5–8 years in data architecture, data modelling, or a closely related role.
* Proven ownership of canonical or enterprise data models and reconciliation processes.
* Strong cross\-system entity modelling — particularly policy, customer, and distributor domains.
* Deep modelling fundamentals: conceptual/logical/physical modelling, normalisation, dimensional modelling (Kimball), Data Vault or equivalent, and entity resolution across systems with conflicting keys.
* AWS hands\-on: S3, Glue, Athena or Redshift, Lake Formation, IAM. Table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake.
* SQL at an advanced level; Python for pipeline, validation, and tooling work.
* Data integration and ETL/ELT design across batch and streaming; dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks.
* Deployment practice for data platforms — Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment promotion.
* Automated data quality and validation tooling in production use.
* Modelling tools (Erwin, SqlDBM, ER/Studio, or equivalent) and the ability to keep models synchronised with what's actually deployed.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management — you'll influence standards you don't have direct authority over.

**Preferred Skills**

* Insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry — policy administration, claims, or distribution systems.
* Industry data models: ACORD, OMG, or similar.
* Data governance frameworks and tooling (Collibra, Alation, AWS DataZone).
* Event streaming (Kafka, Kinesis) and schema registry practice.
* Master data management and identity resolution.
* Legacy modernisation — mainframe or policy admin system migration to cloud.
* Cost optimisation for large\-scale data platforms.

**Our Purpose and Culture:** At BDIPlus, our mission is to help enterprises utilize their resources more efficiently, implement effective information management, and empower them by enabling richer insights and intelligence.

We are driven by a single purpose: empower the technology transformation. We are passionate about creating foundational technology platforms for enterprise data and information management. Our employees are at the heart of the work we do at BDIPlus. We are committed to encouraging and celebrating innovation, creativity, and hard work among our team members.

**Working at BDIPlus offers:** A diverse, fun, highly intelligent, and innovative team. Provident Fund A competitive salary and an annual bonus. Standard time off, sick leave, and holidays. An environment where creative thinking is encouraged, and innovation drives everything we do.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

959bdaf5.description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.****The Opportunity**
Are you an experienced architect with a passion for designing and delivering cutting\-edge end\-user computing solutions, leveraging your expertise in Citrix and Omnissa technologies? If so, you will thrive in our dynamic team environment at Nutanix, where you will influence large\-scale transformations, work with innovative technologies, and provide technical leadership to drive impactful customer engagements in hybrid infrastructures.**About the Team**
The Staff Consulting Architect will be joining the Professional Services team at Nutanix, located in Bangalore. This team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions in end\-user computing (EUC) that empower organizations to enhance their IT infrastructure and optimize user experience. With a culture that emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and customer\-centricity, team members are encouraged to leverage their expertise and creativity to drive transformative results for clients. The mission of the team is to architect and implement scalable EUC solutions that seamlessly integrate with Nutanix infrastructure, enabling organizations to achieve their digital transformation goals.


You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who fosters a supportive and empowering leadership style that promotes both individual growth and team collaboration. The work setup for this role is hybrid, requiring the hire to be in the office for three days a week while also allowing flexibility for remote work on other days.


The role requires some travel to client locations and other Nutanix offices, as needed, to engage directly with customers and support the implementation of EUC projects. This travel will be essential for building strong relationships and understanding client needs in their specific environments.

 **Your Role*** Architect and design enterprise end\-user computing (EUC) solutions utilizing Citrix and Omnissa technologies within Nutanix infrastructure.
* Lead customer engagements to define architecture, migration strategies, and optimization plans for virtual desktop and application environments.
* Troubleshoot complex EUC environments and provide technical leadership to consulting teams and customers.
* Develop reusable reference architectures, design guides, and standard operating procedures for Citrix/Omnissa deployments.
* Conduct workshops with clients to outline EUC strategy, performance optimization, and security measures.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the development of EUC technical capabilities within the team.
* Establish and monitor performance metrics for EUC solutions to ensure optimal user experience and system reliability.
* Drive initiatives for EUC modernization, automation, and standardization across platforms to meet business continuity requirements.
 **What You Will Bring*** 10\+ years of experience in EUC, virtualization, infrastructure, or related technologies.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with Citrix and/or Omnissa enterprise EUC platforms.
* Deep understanding of VDI, application virtualization, and enterprise networking.
* Proficiency in Nutanix AHV and VMware vSphere environments.
* Experience in designing high\-availability, backup, DR, and business continuity solutions for EUC.
* Strong customer\-facing consulting, communication, and technical leadership skills.
* Proficiency in automation tools such as PowerShell, Terraform, or Ansible.
* Relevant certifications in Citrix, VMware, or related technologies are a plus.

**Work Arrangement**
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.****The Opportunity**
Are you an experienced architect with a passion for designing and delivering cutting\-edge end\-user computing solutions, leveraging your expertise in Citrix and Omnissa technologies? If so, you will thrive in our dynamic team environment at Nutanix, where you will influence large\-scale transformations, work with innovative technologies, and provide technical leadership to drive impactful customer engagements in hybrid infrastructures.**About the Team**
The Staff Consulting Architect will be joining the Professional Services team at Nutanix, located in Bangalore. This team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions in end\-user computing (EUC) that empower organizations to enhance their IT infrastructure and optimize user experience. With a culture that emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and customer\-centricity, team members are encouraged to leverage their expertise and creativity to drive transformative results for clients. The mission of the team is to architect and implement scalable EUC solutions that seamlessly integrate with Nutanix infrastructure, enabling organizations to achieve their digital transformation goals.


You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who fosters a supportive and empowering leadership style that promotes both individual growth and team collaboration. The work setup for this role is hybrid, requiring the hire to be in the office for three days a week while also allowing flexibility for remote work on other days.


The role requires some travel to client locations and other Nutanix offices, as needed, to engage directly with customers and support the implementation of EUC projects. This travel will be essential for building strong relationships and understanding client needs in their specific environments.

 **Your Role*** Architect and design enterprise end\-user computing (EUC) solutions utilizing Citrix and Omnissa technologies within Nutanix infrastructure.
* Lead customer engagements to define architecture, migration strategies, and optimization plans for virtual desktop and application environments.
* Troubleshoot complex EUC environments and provide technical leadership to consulting teams and customers.
* Develop reusable reference architectures, design guides, and standard operating procedures for Citrix/Omnissa deployments.
* Conduct workshops with clients to outline EUC strategy, performance optimization, and security measures.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the development of EUC technical capabilities within the team.
* Establish and monitor performance metrics for EUC solutions to ensure optimal user experience and system reliability.
* Drive initiatives for EUC modernization, automation, and standardization across platforms to meet business continuity requirements.
 **What You Will Bring*** 10\+ years of experience in EUC, virtualization, infrastructure, or related technologies.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with Citrix and/or Omnissa enterprise EUC platforms.
* Deep understanding of VDI, application virtualization, and enterprise networking.
* Proficiency in Nutanix AHV and VMware vSphere environments.
* Experience in designing high\-availability, backup, DR, and business continuity solutions for EUC.
* Strong customer\-facing consulting, communication, and technical leadership skills.
* Proficiency in automation tools such as PowerShell, Terraform, or Ansible.
* Relevant certifications in Citrix, VMware, or related technologies are a plus.

**Work Arrangement**
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

929c9ec0.title: Staff Consulting Architect - Storage
929c9ec0.description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.****The Opportunity**
Are you a seasoned technology expert with a strong background in enterprise storage architecture, virtualization, and integrating complex systems? If so, you’ll thrive in our dynamic team where you will have the opportunity to lead innovative storage integration projects, mentor fellow consultants, and drive transformative solutions for our clients, all while collaborating in a supportive and growth\-focused environment.**About the Team**
The team you will be joining is the Professional Services team at Nutanix, located in Pune or Bangalore. This team is dedicated to delivering high\-quality architectural solutions and consultancy services to help clients optimize their IT infrastructure. With a collaborative and innovative culture, the team thrives on creating impactful solutions that modernize clients’ technological environments and drive their business success. The mission of this team is to empower enterprises to harness the full potential of Nutanix technologies by enabling integration and seamless coexistence with existing storage platforms.


You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who is known for fostering a supportive and empowering leadership style, encouraging team members to take initiative and develop their skills. The work setup for this role is hybrid, requiring the hire to be in the office a minimum of two days per week while allowing for flexibility to work remotely on the other days.


This role will require some travel to meet with clients and engage in on\-site consultations and architecture discussions, so a willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagement and project execution is essential.

 **Your Role*** Architect and deliver enterprise storage solutions integrating Nutanix with Pure Storage, Dell EMC, and other platforms.
* Lead customer architecture and design engagements while modernizing and optimizing existing storage infrastructures.
* Define and implement storage migration strategies, ensuring seamless transitions from legacy systems to modern environments.
* Analyze and troubleshoot complex storage performance issues across applications, networking, and infrastructure.
* Mentor and guide consultants in developing reusable architecture patterns and best practices for storage integration.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align storage solutions with broader enterprise architecture goals.
* Drive automation of storage provisioning and management processes to enhance operational efficiency.
* Establish trusted relationships with clients, acting as a technical advisor on storage and infrastructure needs.
 **What You Will Bring*** Strong expertise in enterprise storage architecture and integration with Nutanix environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Pure Storage and Dell EMC enterprise storage platforms.
* Proficient in SAN/NAS technologies, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, and NFS/SMB.
* Ability to design and optimize storage solutions based on performance, availability, and business requirements.
* Experience in storage modernization, migration strategies, and data protection architectures.
* Competence in automation using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and Python.
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* Strong consulting skills with the ability to engage and lead customer architecture discussions.
**Work Arrangement**
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

d482a560.title: Solutions Consultant
d482a560.description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges \-\- we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes \-\- apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
 At Sovos, we deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that power global tax compliance for some of the world’s largest organizations. As a Solution Consultant, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting system\-to\-system integrations between Sovos platform, client ERP \& third\-party applications.
   

  

 This role is a client\-facing and integration\-focused. You will act as the technical owner of implementation projects, leading requirement gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, go live and hypercare. Collaboration with clients, external integration partners and internal technical teams is key to ensuring seamless integration \& successful project completion.
   

  

**More Specifically, You Will**
* Be the primary technical point of contact throughout the project lifecycle, providing technical support and guidance throughout the project lifecycle
* Collaborate with Client technical, functional \& Sovos project teams, outlining and designing Sovos products to the project scope.
* Gather \& analyse business and technical requirements from clients, translating them into effective solution and integration designs.
* Complete solution design and architecture documents which includes all configuration details and any other necessary information to support Client and Sovos implementations.
* Design and implement API\-based integrations (REST/SOAP) between Sovos platforms and client ERP systems.
* Analyse the structure and definition of our customers integration data files and map their fields/data to Sovos internal data structure according to project scope.
* Validate data flows, mappings, and transformations between source and target systems to ensure accuracy and reliability.
* Coordinate with client, internal teams and integration partners to ensure timely project delivery and resolve any issues that may arise by following internal escalation and procedures
* Ensure integrations adhere to security, compliance and performance standards as required by Sovos and its clients.
* Must be capable of leading fast\-paced work sessions with internal and/or client’s teams to come up with solutions to solve project problems within Sovos products capabilities and project scope.
* Understanding the impact of individual task completion on the overall project schedule.
* Excellent understanding of Sovos product and capabilities.
* Provide training as necessary to clients in relation to Sovos Products.
* Identify and implement improvements to processes, documents, tools, reports, etc. to benefit and improve Sovos project team and new Client’s implementation processes.
* Perform SIT (System Integration Testing) \& UAT (Users Acceptance Testing) according to Sovos products configurations and project implementation plan.


**What We Need From You**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or similar.
* 5\+ years of experience in system integration, or, enterprise application integration in customer facing role
* Knowledge of development languages, ability to read and understand code, to analyse rules/conditions and data mappings (C\# or similar)
* Good understanding of ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms.
* Solid hands\-on experience with REST and SOAP APIs, covering authentication, error handling, and retries.
* Experience in systems \& data integration, data structure and data mappings with strong knowledge of system architecture, data flows and integration patterns.
* Experience with JSON, XML, and data mapping/transformation techniques.
* Experience in Electronic Invoicing, Billing, Systems Integration, Invoicing Systems (ERP) projects an added advantage.
* Excellent English communications skills (verbal and written)
* Strong critical thinking skills and a solution\-oriented mindset.
* Strong time management, organizational and decision\-making skills.
* Interact effectively with teammates, colleagues and Client’s.
* Comprehend and communicate complex concepts.
* Concentrate, analyse and resolve complex problems.


 The tools to enhance your life \- because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
   

  

* 3 days per week in our Navi Mumbai (Airoli) office, with flexibility to work remotely for the remaining days
* Opportunity to work with a global organization and gain international exposure
* Bi\-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
* Mentoring Programs and career development opportunities
* Globally recognized Training and Development programs
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage
* Collaborative work environment with modern tools and technologies
* Opportunity to be part of a newly acquired entity and shape its growth journey


**Our Recruitment Process**
 We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what a typical process will look like:
   

  

 Stage 1: CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) and EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
   

  

 Stage 2: Automated Video Interview
   

  

 Stage 3: Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or key stakeholders
   

  

 Stage 4: Final Interview
   

  

 Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
   

  

**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose\-built for always\-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT\-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos' cloud\-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.
   

  

 More than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries \-\- including half the Fortune 500 \-\- trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter

3da8ab08.title: Staff Consulting Architect - Database
3da8ab08.description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.****The Opportunity**
Are you an experienced database professional with a strong background in database lifecycle management, virtualization, and automation who excels in solution architecture and collaboration? If so, join our innovative Professional Services team at Nutanix, where you'll have the opportunity to design and manage cutting\-edge database service platforms in a dynamic hybrid environment, all while enhancing client outcomes through your expertise and a supportive, collaborative culture.**About the Team**
The Staff Consulting Architect role will be part of the Professional Services team at Nutanix, located in Bangalore. This team is dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experiences by providing innovative solutions focused on database lifecycle management and virtualization. The culture within the team is collaborative and client\-centric, promoting a supportive environment where diverse perspectives are valued. The mission of the Professional Services team is to ensure successful deployments and optimizations for Nutanix's database service platforms, ultimately enhancing business outcomes for clients through automation and efficiency.


You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who is known for a leadership style that emphasizes empowerment and mentorship, fostering an atmosphere of continuous learning and professional growth. The work setup for this role is hybrid, requiring occasional in\-office presence to facilitate collaboration and client engagements, while also allowing for flexibility in remote work. The exact number of days in the office will be determined based on project needs and team activities.


This role involves approximately 15% travel, which may include trips to client locations for project kick\-offs, deployments, or workshops. This travel is essential for understanding client environments and ensuring successful implementations of Nutanix solutions.

**Your Role*** Design and implement database service platforms integrating automation and virtualization technologies.
* Lead and manage database migration projects, ensuring minimal downtime and optimal resource management.
* Oversee the complete lifecycle of database services, focusing on backup, restore, scaling, and performance optimization.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to develop and integrate database solutions with infrastructure and automation frameworks.
* Establish and document blueprints for consistent database provisioning and lifecycle management.
* Provide technical leadership and mentor team members on database modernization and best practices in automation.
* Monitor and analyze platform health and performance, driving continuous improvement initiatives based on gathered insights.
* Engage with clients to understand requirements and deliver tailored database solutions that enhance their IT infrastructure.
 **What You Will Bring*** 10\+ years of experience in database administration and infrastructure engineering.
* Strong expertise in database lifecycle management, automation, and virtualization technologies.
* Proficient in database design, deployment, and migration for major RDBMSs (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Experience with automation frameworks (API integration, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform).
* Excellent communication and client\-facing consulting skills.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and lead database modernization initiatives.
* Relevant certifications in database management or virtualization preferred.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL and MongoDB technologies.
**Work Arrangement**
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

075d580c.title: Applied Solutions Architect, Google Cloud
075d580c.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.
* Experience building full\-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 4 years of experience in software development, systems architecture, or a highly technical customer\-facing role with proficiency in one of more general\-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Experience designing and building AI applications.


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the technical bridge between our customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer the Proof of Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. By keeping the final production end\-state in mind from day one, you will advocate for our AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape. Design comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation. Code, build, and deploy robust cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions—such as agentic workflows, RAG systems, and applied foundation models—backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value. Ensure all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

5694bdd5.title: Technical Solutions Architect
5694bdd5.description:
**Company Overview**
 Leading with our core values of Quality, Integrity, and Opportunity, MedInsight is one of the healthcare industry’s most trusted solutions for healthcare intelligence. Our company’s purpose is to empower easy, data\-driven decision\-making on important healthcare questions. MedInsight products, education, and services make an impact on healthcare by helping to drive better outcomes for patients while reducing wasteful services. Over 300 leading healthcare organizations have come to rely on MedInsight analytic solutions for healthcare cost and care management.
   

  

 MedInsight is a subsidiary of Milliman; a global, employee\-owned consultancy providing actuarial consulting, retirement funding and healthcare financing, enterprise risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics, and business transformation, as well as a range of other consulting and technology solutions.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The MedInsight Strategic Analytics Services team is looking for a Technical Solutions Architect (Cloud Engineer) to support a variety of healthcare analytics, predictive analytics, and digital transformation projects, leveraging a variety of data types. As a member of the technical staff and a trusted advisor to clients, this professional will join our team to assist in all phases of technical consulting work, including requirements gathering, scalable solution design, data architectures, research, and development. The successful candidate will have strong analytic, technical, and communication skills, and the ability to partner in the delivery of business value to diverse organizations, manage multiple simultaneous projects and innovate solutions that leverage a cloud\-first environment.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Work both independently and in a cross\-functional team environment.
* Listen to, understand, and break client questions down into manageable tasks.
* Be comfortable in presenting and discussing ideas with senior leaders of client organizations and Milliman MedInsight.
* Understand client business goals and strategic context and harvest requirements from client organizations.
* Work independently on assigned tasks, i.e., plan, organize, delegate, problem solve, and meet established deadlines.
* Develop senior technical staff through involvement with effectively aligned cross\-functional teams.
* Prioritize work under time pressure. Follow\-through and exceptional attention to detail on all project tasks are essential.
* Use a variety of proprietary products and technologies to answer simple and complex client questions.
* Turn data results into client\-facing deliverables that are informative and easy\-to\-use.
* Standardize ad hoc processes and drive continuous improvement for automating and optimizing performance of ongoing processes.
* Assist senior technical staff with the support of, upgrades of, and modifications to, existing advanced data products.
* Ensure clear and comprehensive documentation of analytic methodologies and new technical approaches.
* Represent MedInsight at client meetings and trainings.


**Basic Qualifications**
 Minimum 8 to 10 years of relevant work experience. Preference will be given to candidates with healthcare data experience and cloud solutions experience. Previous experience working with large healthcare claims and/or EHR databases preferred.
   

  

**General**
* Working knowledge of healthcare concepts and data structures.
* Familiarity with healthcare claims data and data analytic platforms.
* Ability to prioritize and manage concurrent projects.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Execute work with exceptional attention to detail on all project tasks.
* Ability to work independently and within a diverse team environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks with little supervision and work under time pressure.
* Client consulting experience.


**Technical**
* Programming/development experience with Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Python.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Spark, SQL, Python, R, C\#) preferred.
* Experience in managing or guiding organizations’ transitions from on\-premise to cloud resources.
* Data warehousing and/or large IT project experience.
* Understanding of OLAP technologies.
* Experience working with large data sets.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Excel.
* Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite of products.
* Healthcare informatics, analytics, and reporting knowledge.


**Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in statistics, mathematics, computer science, information systems, finance, economics, engineering, or related fields.


**Desired Experience And Traits**
* Experience working with relational and big data database technologies (Databricks, Microsoft Azure). Experience collapsing, joining, merging data sets.
* Hands\-on experience in creating microservices architecture and cloud\-native applications.
* Hands\-on experience in Agile design and implementation approaches.
* Experience in reducing costs and improving efficiencies in data analytics.
* Healthcare claims analysis experience a plus.
* Ability to translate complex healthcare data questions from clients or account managers into manageable tasks.
* Self\-motivated, organized, and adaptable – adept at planning and execution, capable of prioritizing and accomplishing goals across a spectrum of concurrent tasks for varying stakeholders.
* Consultative and confident approach: Critical thinker, able to effectively comprehend complex business issues and develop solutions and communications that work for varying stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented: Recognizes that the small things make all the difference and pays attention to everything.
* Collaborative: Demonstrated ability to work with engineering and analytics teams to discuss technical concepts, make tradeoffs and evaluate new ideas.
* Intellectually curious: Desire and ability to learn new skills, systems, and processes, and interest in exploring data credibility and advanced analytic approaches.
* Energetic, optimistic, and hard\-working: Maintains a can\-do attitude and is unrelenting in the pursuit of excellence.


 Above all else, we are looking for someone who is excited about working in a fast\-paced environment, collaborating with individuals across multiple teams to solve problems, and developing data\-driven solutions that make important information easy to access, understand and act upon.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is an innovative self\-starter with solid technical foundations, who is interested in working with our team of experienced professionals to make a measurable impact on the business challenges faced by healthcare organizations today. The Milliman MedInsight group has been rapidly growing within different segments of the healthcare field, with presence amongst payers, employers, providers, accountable care organizations, pharmacy benefit managers, digital health companies, and other types of organizations. Successful candidates will support a variety of custom analytic client engagements and will also have opportunities to develop within their position and grow within the larger team.
   

  

**What makes this a great opportunity?**
* Join an award\-winning firm with a track record of growth backed by a marketplace powerhouse.
* Be part of the expansion and evolution of an analytics, technology, and research team in a data\-driven company.
* Enjoy significant visibility and be recognized for your wins.
* Work with a tenured collaborative team that values diversification of thought and new ideas.
* Grow and develop your skills and experience in an organization that invests energy in your career trajectory every day.
* Accelerate data interoperability, advanced analytics, and optimal use of cloud technologies.
* Help client and partner organizations improve healthcare for populations and communities.

**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 In this role, you will drive the end\-to\-end planning, tracking, and execution of complex ML storage infrastructure programs (including Napa priorities like materialization, pushing, and sovereignty/compliance). You will serve as the structural bridge between the centralized Napa team and the horizontal File Formats (Artus) team to prevent technical silos, manage cross\-team dependencies, and ensure frictionless integration. Exercise strong technical judgment to translate high\-level business requirements and architectural recommendations into actionable engineering roadmaps; proactively identify and mitigate systemic risks stemming from platform shifts and infrastructure shortages. You will design, implement, and optimize lightweight project management processes, tracking frameworks and dashboard solutions to help a rapidly evolving site organization scale efficiently. You will navigate ambiguous environments and rapidly resolve cross\-functional or inter\-team dependencies to preserve timeline velocity on business\-critical client commitments.

**About the Role**




 The Global Program Manager for Autonomous Data Platform (ADP) is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end program strategy and delivery for flagship autonomous infrastructure initiative. ADP aims to make self\-operating, self\-healing, and fully autonomous in its data management capabilities — and this role is at the center of making that vision real. You will coordinate across product management, engineering, cloud infrastructure, customer success, and field teams to drive structured delivery, manage cross\-functional dependencies, and ensure ADP reaches customers in a form that generates immediate, measurable value.
 



  





**What You'll Do**



* Own the ADP program roadmap — translating product and engineering intent into a structured, milestone\-driven delivery plan with clear owners, timelines, and success criteria.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment across engineering, platform architecture, product management, and field\-facing teams to ensure ADP capabilities are built, validated, and launched cohesively.

* Lead launch readiness for ADP capabilities, ensuring GTM teams, support, and enablement functions are prepared ahead of each release.
* Define and track metrics that measure ADP program health and customer\-facing impact, including time\-to\-value, automation coverage, and operational reliability benchmarks.
* Represent ADP in leadership reviews — communicating program status, escalating risks, and driving resolution with appropriate urgency.
* Coordinate with implementation and customer success teams to ensure smooth handoffs and early customer feedback loops that feed back into engineering priorities.



  





**What Success Looks Like**



* ADP capabilities ship on a predictable cadence with clear launch criteria, strong cross\-functional alignment, and high\-quality readiness artifacts across GTM, support, and enablement.
* Leadership has real\-time visibility into program health, risks, and delivery confidence — with no surprises at launch.
* Engineering and product teams operate with reduced coordination friction, and dependencies across platform programs are managed proactively rather than reactively.
* Customer\-facing outcomes — including time\-to\-automation and operational reliability — improve measurably release over release.



  





**Who You'll Work With**




 You will work closely with engineering leads, platform architects, product managers, and cloud infrastructure partners on the build side — and with sales engineering, field enablement, customer success, and marketing on the launch and adoption side. This role requires frequent engagement with senior leadership to drive alignment and communicate program status.
 



 Non\-Negotiable Qualifications
 


* 10\+ years of program management experience in the tech industry, with at least 5 years leading cross\-functional, global programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, infrastructure\-heavy or platform engineering programs — preferably in cloud, data infrastructure, or enterprise software.

* Strong communication skills — equally comfortable in engineering standups and executive briefings.
* Bachelor's degree required.

f189f142.title: Senior Solutions Consultant
f189f142.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Solutions Consultants at Curlec by Razorpay are the linchpin of our enterprise sales team. You will be the technical and strategic partner to our sales team, bridging the gap between customer challenges and Razorpay's innovative payment solutions. This is not a traditional pre\-sales role; it's a chance to be a change leader and a revenue catalyst. You'll be the voice of the customer to our product team, the expert in the room with our sales team, and the trusted advisor to some of the largest enterprises.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Solve Big Problems: Work closely with our enterprise sales team to understand customer business goals, challenges, and technical pain points. You'll architect solutions that solve their most complex payment problems, leveraging our core products and custom capabilities. Hence in\-depth understanding of all our products is required.
* Craft Strategic Narratives: Create and deliver compelling presentations, detailed solution documents, and business proposals. You'll translate complex technical concepts into clear, executive\-level narratives that demonstrate Razorpay's unique value proposition and quantify our business value.
* Drive Revenue: Act as a critical enabler for our enterprise sales pipeline. You'll lead technical discussions, build compelling solution demonstrations, and author detailed RFP responses for major deals. Your expertise and communication will directly influence our revenue attainment goals.
* Be an Industry Expert: Drive the strategic viewpoint of the organization towards specific vertical solutions. You'll use your deep industry knowledge to be a change leader for innovative solutions that solve larger, systemic problems within a particular vertical.
* Connect the Dots: Collaborate with sales, product, and engineering teams to ensure a seamless end\-to\-end process—from solution design to successful deployment for key deals. You'll be the go\-to resource for connecting our technology to real\-world business value.
* Champion Knowledge: Contribute to our internal knowledge base and foster a culture of expertise. You'll serve as a subject matter expert, mentoring peers and authoring documentation to elevate the entire team.


**What We're Looking For**
* Problem Solver: Proven creative problem\-solving ability with a track record of leading and delivering full\-lifecycle projects. You can demonstrate how to turn complex challenges into clear, actionable solutions.
* Payments Expert: At least 2\-3 years of experience in the payments or fintech space, with a background in a product, solutions, or sales\-related role.
* Technical Practitioner: Hands\-on experience with technology is a must. You should be comfortable with APIs, technical definitions, and stitching together solutions across different platforms and partner ecosystems.
* Enterprise Advisor: Demonstrated expertise in providing advisory and guidance on large enterprise deployments and complex applications, with a history of identifying additional business opportunities.
* Influential Communicator: Exceptional verbal, presentation, and written communication skills. You have a proven ability to create and deliver technical and business\-focused presentations and documents that influence others and achieve results.
* Documentation Finesse: Established ability in crafting compelling presentations \& solution documents
* Education: An engineering background with an MBA is preferred.


 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.

Responsible for defining application technology and architecture, maintaining the architectural runway, ensuring feasibility and sustainability, managing non\-functional requirements, defining delivery approaches, identifying improvement opportunities, monitoring emerging technologies, and mentoring other architects for skill development.
   

  

* Through cross\-team collaboration, define the technology and architecture that connects the application solutions within ARTs, while guiding the development/engineering team in their portion of the solution’s design.

 Our Company

 Our Culture

a3b3c12d.title: Solution Architect
a3b3c12d.description:
**About Us**
 At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.
   

  

 The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.
   

  

 We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about
 **our What and our Why** 
 and how we can work
 **together** 
 .
   

  

**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
 ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.
   

  

 ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.
   

  

 ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market\-development activities.
   

  

 The Global Business Center \- Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.
   

  

 ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate, and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community\-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.
   

  

 To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.
   

  

**What Role You Will Play In Our Team**
 We are looking for a dynamic, creative, and resourceful Solution Architect to join our team at ExxonMobil’s Bengaluru office. This role is ideal for a hands\-on professional who combines deep technical expertise with strong communication and collaboration skills. You will be responsible for architecture that aligns with organizational goals, scalability, security, and performance standards in ExxonMobil’s Upstream business.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**

**Your Benefits**

e877ac0e.title: AI Solutions Architect
e877ac0e.description:
**Overview**
 At CACTUS AI Solutions, we are building and deploying large\-scale AI systems that power products and enterprise solutions across research, publishing, healthcare, BFSI, government, education, and enterprise transformation. Our ecosystem powers platforms such as Paperpal, R Discovery, and Mind the Graph, and multiple enterprise AI solutions used by millions of users globally.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly experienced and hands\-on AI Solutions Architect who can lead the design, architecture, and technical strategy for enterprise\-scale AI initiatives. This role will play a critical part in shaping how AI solutions are designed, deployed, governed, and scaled across diverse enterprise and government\-facing use cases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is someone who combines strong architecture fundamentals with deep AI/ML understanding, enterprise integration experience, cloud expertise, and practical knowledge of modern AI ecosystems including LLMs, RAG systems, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and AI governance practices.
   

  

**Note** 
 \- For this role, we are looking for Delhi NCR based candidates only.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and drive scalable, secure, and enterprise\-grade architectures for AI/ML platforms, cloud\-native applications, and distributed systems.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate AI/ML models, LLMs, frameworks, and solution approaches, including Generative AI, RAG, semantic search, conversational AI, and intelligent automation.
* Define architecture standards, deployment strategies, integration patterns, and reusable solution frameworks across cloud, hybrid, and on\-premises environments.
* Architect integrations with enterprise platforms using APIs, microservices, and event\-driven architectures while ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Collaborate with engineering, AI/ML, DevOps, and MLOps teams to guide implementation, deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence.
* Drive architecture governance by embedding security, privacy, compliance, auditability, access controls, and Responsible AI practices into solution designs.
* Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions and support technical proposals, architecture reviews, effort estimation, and solution documentation.
* Assess and leverage internal assets, open\-source technologies, and third\-party platforms to accelerate solution delivery and innovation.


**Qualifications And Prerequisites**
* 5–8 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, AI/ML Engineering, or large\-scale platform engineering, with proven expertise in designing enterprise\-grade AI\-powered and cloud\-native solutions.
* Strong understanding of modern AI ecosystems, including LLMs, RAG architectures, semantic retrieval, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and AI deployment patterns.
* Experience architecting distributed systems, enterprise integrations, APIs, microservices, and cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Proven ability to work with cross\-functional teams and enterprise stakeholders to deliver complex, high\-scale technology solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills, with the ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced and ambiguous environments.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Cloud architecture certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent) are preferred.
* Experience contributing to enterprise AI platforms, open\-source initiatives, large\-scale AI deployments, or government/enterprise transformation programs is a plus.


 Application Process
   

  

 Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, we have two technical rounds and one HRBP round.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
   

  

**Accelerating from Anywhere**
 As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.
   

  

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.


**About CACTUS**
 Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting\-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

08e66d9a.title: Senior Solution Architect
08e66d9a.description:
Metyis is growing! We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect with \+10 years of relevant experience for a full\-time position to join the Technology team based out of Bangalore.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 We are Metyis, a forward\-thinking, global company that collaborates with business partners and clients to create and implement the capacities and capabilities required to improve future performance. We operate across a wide range of industries, and with our embedded partnership model we commit to driving sustainable growth for industry\-leading organisations, elevating their potential with a long\-term vision.
   

  

 At Metyis, we develop integrated solutions that enable growth by working within our business partners’ organisations with diverse and multidisciplinary teams. This collaborative environment allows Metyis to build strategies and execute them through an ecosystem that combines Big Data solutions, Digital Commerce solutions, Marketing \& Design solutions, and Advisory services.
   

  

 Our teams are set up so that you have plenty of room to build bigger and bolder ideas by speaking your mind and being creative with your knowledge. Imagine the things you could achieve with a multidisciplinary team that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
   

  

 We are Metyis. Partners for Impact.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Interact with C\-level at our clients on regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change
* Lead your team in creating new business solutions via data driven insights
* Seize opportunities at the client and at Metyis in our entrepreneurial environment
* Become part of a fast growing international and diverse team


**What You Will Do**
* Understand client business domain and drive Digital Business Transformation (DBT) opportunity.
* Lead end\-to\-end solution architecture across discovery, architecture, estimation, roadmap planning, implementation, and production readiness while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles.
* Define architecture standards covering security, scalability, performance, availability, resiliency, observability, maintainability, cost optimization, and operational excellence while balancing business and technical trade\-offs.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Delivery, Data, AI, and Platform teams to define enterprise architecture, engineering standards, governance frameworks, and best practices across multiple engagements.
* Engage with executive stakeholders, business leaders, and technology teams to drive strategic technology decisions, architecture governance, platform selection, and solution roadmaps.
* Lead technology consulting engagements with prospects and clients by defining target architectures, transformation roadmaps, implementation strategies, business cases, effort estimation, and investment planning.
* Own technical solutioning for RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and client presentations, including solution architecture, commercial estimation, delivery approach, staffing models, implementation timelines, and risk assessment.
* Define enterprise technology strategy, modernization roadmaps, cloud adoption, integration architecture, and platform evolution in collaboration with global architecture and engineering leadership.
* Champion modern engineering practices including Agile, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, API\-first design, and AI\-assisted software development.
* Mentor architects and engineering teams through technical leadership, architecture reviews, knowledge sharing, capability development, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support account growth by identifying follow\-on opportunities, defining transformation roadmaps, and building long\-term trusted advisor relationships with clients.


**What You Will Bring**
* 10–15\+ years of experience in designing and delivering enterprise\-scale digital platforms, distributed systems, and cloud\-native solutions, including leading architecture for large transformation programs.
* Strong expertise in software architecture principles, Domain\-Driven Design (DDD), SOLID principles, API\-first architecture, microservices, event\-driven architecture, and integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), cloud\-native deployment models, and platform engineering.
* Experience designing observability solutions using tools such as Grafana, ELK, Splunk, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, and implementing operational KPIs, monitoring, and alerting strategies.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, API management, messaging platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, AWS SNS/SQS), middleware, and asynchronous event\-driven architectures.
* Proven experience leading cross\-functional and globally distributed teams in matrix organizations while influencing technical direction without direct authority.
* Experience designing composable, MACH\-based, and headless architectures, including Single Page Applications (SPA), Progressive Web Applications (PWA), and API\-driven digital experiences.
* Extensive experience delivering enterprise digital commerce solutions, marketplaces, omnichannel platforms, mobile applications, middleware, CMS, cloud platforms, and integration ecosystems.
* Experience with one or more enterprise commerce platforms such as Shopify, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Adobe Commerce (Magento), HCL Commerce, commercetools, or BigCommerce.
* Strong expertise in cloud architecture across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including security, networking, scalability, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Excellent consulting, stakeholder management, presentation, negotiation, and executive communication skills with the ability to influence technical and business decisions.


**Good to Have:**
* Experience with AI/Generative AI technologies and integrating AI capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Architecture or Cloud certifications such as TOGAF, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent.


**We are united by our differences**
 At Metyis, we are driven by curiosity and collaboration. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) in all its forms as it makes us stronger as an organisation and promotes creativity and innovation. We welcome all talents and are committed to creating a workplace where every employee can make a meaningful impact and grow.
   

  

**Recruitment Disclaimer**
 Metyis only contacts candidates through verified and official channels: LinkedIn (official and verified recruiter profiles), emails ending in @metyis.com, and our Applicant Tracking System (Recruitee). We do not use WhatsApp, social media messaging platforms, or personal accounts for recruitment outreach. If you receive suspicious communication claiming to be from Metyis, please verify the sender and report it through our official website.

b6f8b764.description:
**About The Job:**


The Red Hat Consulting Services team is adding a Services Manager in India. In this role, you will develop, cultivate, and manage relationships within key Enterprise and Commercial customer accounts. You will oversee the successful delivery of projects under your management from kickoff to closeout, including determining scope details and monitoring project progress to ensure that it conforms to customer expectations and contractual agreements. You’ll also help identify and qualify new business opportunities and work with Red Hat’s sales organization to formulate account strategies that promote revenue growth. * Work closely with the services sellers to deliver Red Hat's services and solutions using the business requirements of your customers to deliver required outcomes
* Grow your territory through the development of internal business partnerships with the field sales team and alliance and partner programs
* Design and implement effective, high\-impact technical and business solutions for Red Hat's customers with a focus on core Red Hat technologies including OpenShift, Ansible AAP, OpenShift AI, RHEL, and others
* Accurately and consistently provide revenue and booking forecasts for your territory
* Manage revenue and booking goals across all practices; meet margin and use targets
* Ensure successful delivery of all projects

* Providing accurate and regular reports to the management on performance of the service delivery
* Leading personnel management, including staff recruitment, performance assessment, training, and mentoring
* Building strong relationships with teams and stakeholders to enable effective dialogue exchange between departments


Within 12 months, you will be expected to do the following

* Grow your revenue base on a quarterly basis
* Manage escalations without supervision

**What You Will Bring:**

* Knowledge of technical or business consulting practices
* Experience managing technical teams
* Experience in services sales and processes in customer accounts
* Experience in project delivery
* Experience with internal matrix team coordination
* Ability to architect complex solutions using multiple offerings and technologies to deliver requested business value
* Experience adhering to agile methodologies within project teams

\#LI\-VG11

Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
