63cede59.description:
**About The Job**
 The Red Hat Consulting Services team is adding a Services Manager in India. In this role, you will develop, cultivate, and manage relationships within key Enterprise and Commercial customer accounts. You will oversee the successful delivery of projects under your management from kickoff to closeout, including determining scope details and monitoring project progress to ensure that it conforms to customer expectations and contractual agreements. You’ll also help identify and qualify new business opportunities and work with Red Hat’s sales organization to formulate account strategies that promote revenue growth. You’ll partner with Red Hat’s sales representatives to guide consulting sales opportunities from qualification to closing while managing all assigned projects and resources while meeting revenue and booking goals. You’ll need to have a good foundation of technical knowledge, as well as project and scope management expertise, as you'll establish the technical and non\-technical enablement needs for the Consulting team.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Cover a territory consisting of Enterprise and Commercial companies
* Work closely with the services sellers to deliver Red Hat's services and solutions using the business requirements of your customers to deliver required outcomes
* Grow your territory through the development of internal business partnerships with the field sales team and alliance and partner programs
* Design and implement effective, high\-impact technical and business solutions for Red Hat's customers with a focus on core Red Hat technologies including OpenShift, Ansible AAP, OpenShift AI, RHEL, and others
* Accurately and consistently provide revenue and booking forecasts for your territory
* Manage revenue and booking goals across all practices; meet margin and use targets
* Ensure successful delivery of all projects
* Coordinate customer managers who manage consultants, fostering a culture of collaboration within your team
* Taking accountability for service delivery performance, meeting customer expectations, and driving future demand
* Providing accurate and regular reports to the management on performance of the service delivery
* Leading personnel management, including staff recruitment, performance assessment, training, and mentoring
* Building strong relationships with teams and stakeholders to enable effective dialogue exchange between departments


 Within 12 months, you will be expected to do the following
   

  

* Grow your revenue base on a quarterly basis
* Manage escalations without supervision
* Assist with negotiating Red Hat’s master services agreements and statements of work with the customers and the legal team


**What You Will Bring**
* Knowledge of technical or business consulting practices
* Experience managing technical teams
* Experience in services sales and processes in customer accounts
* Experience in project delivery
* Experience with internal matrix team coordination
* Ability to architect complex solutions using multiple offerings and technologies to deliver requested business value
* Experience adhering to agile methodologies within project teams
* Knowledge of application development or cloud solutions creation and delivery
* Experience in and willingness to speak at public conferences and meetups


**About Red Hat**
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

 Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
   

  

 Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application\-assistance@redhat.com.  VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

 We are seeking a delivery\-focused professional to lead squad\-level outcomes within Security Monitoring \& Analytics (SMA). This role centres on ensuring predictable delivery through active planning, tracking, risk and dependency management, and stakeholder alignment. Working closely with the Technical Product Owner, Tech Leads, and Release Train Engineer, the individual will enable effective agile practices while maintaining a strong focus on delivery flow, transparency, and measurable outcomes.

**Who You Are**
 Experienced in delivery management with a focus on predictability, flow, and transparency in complex environmentsProactive in understanding squad objectives and individual accountabilities to drive delivery outcomesKnowledgeable in SAFe and agile practices, including PI planning, forecasting, and dependency managementSkilled in managing risks, issues, and impediments, with the ability to influence stakeholders and resolve blockersEffective communicator with strong stakeholder management and facilitation skillsCapable of translating delivery data into clear, actionable insights for leadershipExperienced with delivery tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or ConfluenceDemonstrates self\-driven ownership, structured thinking, and collaborative problem\-solvingExposure to Security Monitoring \& Analytics or SOC modernisation programmes is desirableRelevant certifications (e.g., SAFe, PRINCE2, PMP, ITIL) are advantageous
   

  

**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to work on critical cyber security initiatives within a global organisationExposure to large\-scale agile delivery frameworks and cross\-functional collaborationA role that enables visible impact on delivery outcomes and organisational performanceContinuous learning through stakeholder engagement and complex programme environmentsAccess to modern delivery tools and structured governance practices
   

  

**What Skills You Will Learn**
 Advanced agile delivery practices within SAFe environmentsEnd\-to\-end delivery lifecycle management in security\-focused programmesRisk, issue, and dependency management at scaleStakeholder alignment and communication across global teamsData\-driven reporting and delivery governance techniques
   

  

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

 Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
   

  

 \#JDEnhancedByTARA
   

  

**Follow us on social media**

22f0dd86.description:
**Company Description** 
 Asset Analytix Inc. is a data\-driven improvement management solutions provider focused on maintenance and reliability, helping organizations maximize asset value while reducing costs through lean principles and best practices. The company’s 360Navigator Improvement Management Platform automates and streamlines improvement processes across the entire asset life cycle. Combining practitioner\-based expertise with proven processes, robust controls, and established standards, Asset Analytix delivers measurable and sustainable performance improvements. Team members work with clients to drive transformational outcomes in a short timeframe, making a direct impact on operational efficiency and asset reliability.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Client Engagement Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pune District, responsible for managing relationships with clients and ensuring successful adoption of Asset Analytix solutions. In this role, the Manager collaborates with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, translate requirements into actionable plans, and oversee improvement initiatives throughout the asset life cycle. Daily activities include coordinating project timelines, facilitating workshops and review meetings, monitoring performance metrics, and providing insights on maintenance and reliability best practices. The Manager also works closely with internal teams to align solution delivery with client expectations, resolve issues promptly, and support continuous improvement in client engagement processes.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support evidence\-based recommendations.
* Candidates should possess Program Management and Project Management skills to plan, execute, and track multiple client initiatives effectively.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Consulting skills to engage stakeholders, present findings, and guide clients through improvement strategies.
* Relevant experience in maintenance, reliability, asset management, or operations improvement is beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related discipline; an advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CMRP, Lean/Six Sigma) are an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site with client teams in Pune District, build strong professional relationships, and adapt to diverse organizational cultures.
* Proficiency with data analysis tools, dashboards, and enterprise platforms; familiarity with improvement management or asset lifecycle systems is preferred.

102d01d6.description:
**Overview**
 Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete AI Revenue Workflow Platform that helps sales leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. Outreach infuses agentic AI to power 100s of use cases across sales motions. From new logo prospecting to renewal and expansion, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Global organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including SAP, Siemens, Snowflake, ZoomInfo, and Verizon to name a few. To learn more, please visit www.outreach.io.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At Outreach, Business Systems’ mission is to enable and enhance corporate processes at scale. We are a centralized team providing a suite of services to other Outreachers, helping them to efficiently serve our customers and each other. We are building the team around strong critical thinkers \- individuals who can navigate ambiguity and help us along our journey of discovery and transformation.
   

  

**The Role**
 Outreach is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the Business Systems team as a TPM aligned closely to our Finance systems portfolio. This role owns the strategy and execution across our end\-to\-end Finance technology stack, spanning ERP, procurement, expense management, and HR financial workflows.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise systems experience, strong cross\-functional instincts, and the technical fluency to navigate integrations across a modern Finance tech stack.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with Finance, Engineering, and Operations leadership to drive delivery, shape system strategy, and build durable program practices for a high\-visibility portfolio.
   

  

**Your Daily Adventures Will Include**
* Own the TPM strategy for Outreach's Finance systems portfolio, serving as the primary program lead across ERP, procurement, expense, and financial operations tooling
* Lead end\-to\-end program management for large\-scale Finance system initiatives, including milestones, risk mitigation, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication across Finance, Engineering, and Operations
* Develop and execute project plans that span multiple teams and systems; proactively identify and resolve blockers across the full delivery lifecycle
* Navigate shifting requirements and evolving business needs by refining scope, clarifying intent, and realigning delivery expectations with stakeholders
* Drive UAT coordination with business stakeholders, ensuring readiness across Finance workflows before production deployment
* Build and maintain program\-level communication rhythms, tailored for both executive sponsors and cross\-functional leads
* Manage cross\-functional delivery challenges with limited precedent; drive convergence in complex decision spaces involving Finance, IT, and external vendors
* Establish and scale QA checkpoints, integration planning practices, and change management processes within the Finance systems portfolio
* Advise on tooling decisions, integration strategy, and platform trade\-offs across the Finance systems landscape
* Informally guide TPM best practices across the team; contribute to cross\-team execution frameworks and delivery culture


**Our Vision Of You**
* 5\+ years of technical program management experience, with at least 2 years on enterprise finance systems or ERP platforms
* Demonstrated experience leading ERP migrations or large\-scale system transitions (NetSuite, SAP, or equivalent)
* Ability to manage shifting requirements across multi\-stakeholder environments; experience aligning Finance, Engineering, and Operations teams around shared delivery goals
* Strong understanding of enterprise system architecture, data flows, and integrations — able to translate business requirements into technical inputs and flag risks proactively
* Experience coordinating UAT with business stakeholders and driving accountability across cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with Finance\-adjacent tools such as Concur, Workday, ZipHQ, or similar platforms is a strong plus
* Proficient in defect/issue tracking tools such as Jira; comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to clearly communicate program status, risks, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences, up to executive level
* Self\-starter who identifies quality and delivery risks proactively, without waiting to be asked
* Experience in a SaaS or high\-growth technology environment preferred


**Why You’ll Love It Here**

* Flexible time off
* 401k to help you save for the future
* Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN\+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA\+), Gender\+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military

* Infertility/ assisted reproductive services benefit
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
* Plus, unlimited snacks and beverages in our kitchen
* We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status


***Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.***

d6ebca6d.title: Lead Technology Program Manager
d6ebca6d.description:
Position Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced
 **Lead Technology Program Manager** 
 to drive the successful delivery of complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives that support strategic business priorities and customer commitments.
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Business teams to plan, coordinate, and execute large\-scale programs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership, executive communication skills, technical acumen, and the ability to influence across a complex matrix organization. This leader will manage strategic customer initiatives and technology programs, cross\-functional dependencies, risks, financial planning, and executive reporting while ensuring delivery against business objectives.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Program Planning and Execution
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of complex technology programs and strategic initiatives.
* Develop and maintain integrated program plans, roadmaps, schedules, and milestone tracking.
* Coordinate activities across multiple product, engineering, and business teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Track program progress and drive timely resolution of issues that may impact delivery commitments.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Customer\-facing teams to align priorities and execution plans.
* Facilitate cross\-functional discussions to manage dependencies, remove obstacles, and resolve conflicts.
* Drive accountability across stakeholders while fostering a collaborative and results\-oriented environment.


 Governance and Communication
   

  

* Establish and manage program governance processes, operating rhythms, and reporting mechanisms.
* Prepare and deliver clear, concise program status updates for leadership reviews.
* Communicate key milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Ensure transparency into program health and delivery progress.


 Risk and Dependency Management
   

  

* Identify, assess, and proactively manage program risks, issues, and interdependencies.
* Develop mitigation plans and coordinate execution of corrective actions.
* Escalate critical issues with clear recommendations and supporting data.


 Customer and Business Alignment
   

  

* Support strategic customer initiatives and business\-critical programs.

9ee6e0a3.title: Solutions Architect - Del, Cross Industries
9ee6e0a3.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

* Do you like helping customers solve technical problems?
* Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing technologies?
* Do you have a knack for helping companies understand Emerging Technology Domains such as GenAI, Agentic AI, Analytics , Microservices architectures including the integration approaches?
* Do you thrive on rolling up your sleeves , a Builder who can help Architect new and emerging technologies along with been consultative to ensure success?
* Do you want to be part of the Retail / CPG team helping to establish Amazon Web Services as a leading technology platform for some of the largest Brands \& Customers in India.


  

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  

  

As a Solution Architect, you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon’s utility computing web services within strategic accounts and partners. Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing a deep expertise in the Amazon Web Services technologies as well as broad know\-how around how applications and services are constructed using the Amazon Web Services platform.  

  

The ideal candidate will possess customer\-facing skills that will allow him/her to represent AISPL well within a customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables him/her to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Serve as a key technical member of the Retail/CPG Account team in helping to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the Amazon Web Services platform.
* Scope each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Own each technical engagement, and help ensure a timely and successful delivery of value. (delivery of actual solutions to be done by Amazon Web Services partners)
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the solution architect community.
* Understand the Amazon Web Services market segments, customer base, and industry verticals.

  

Key job responsibilities  

This role is within the Retail/CPG team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and based out of
  

Delhi  

  

* As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.

  

* Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.

  

* You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.

  

* As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.

  

To be successful in this role you need to be passionate builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.  

  

Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).  

  

A day in the life  

The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.  

  

Want to learn more about being a Solutions Architect at AMAZON, follow the link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=Js21xKMFdww  

  

About the team  

Retail/CPG Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.  

  

You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to some of the largest Brands/Services/Ecommerce customers in India . This customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 3\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* 3\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

6a814254.title: Technical Solutions Consultant, PDM, PLM
6a814254.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C\+\+, Python).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field.
* 5 years of experience with Siemens teamcenter, and 1 year of experience in technical leadership.
* Proficient in ITK, Java, ReactJS, JavaScript, with experience in developing extensions, workflow handlers, and services.
* In\-depth knowledge of PLM servers/APIs, RDBMS, and infrastructure scaling frameworks, and adept at navigating ambiguity, fostering creativity, and driving operational efficiency.
* Expertise in cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP), for deploying and scaling PLM solutions.
* Strong problem\-solving, leadership, and communication skills for effective global team collaboration.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross\-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.  

  

You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.



As a Technical Solution Consultant you will help refine and grow the capabilities of current Product Data Management (PDM) and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, driving continuous improvement to meet the Engineering needs. You will design, develop and sustain PLM, New Product Introduction (NPI) and supply chain related application systems.


In this role, you will also promote best practices and internal business processes. You will be responsive and able to adapt quickly to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment. You will work in a data driven environment, have a desire to drive change, and are excited by the opportunity to analyze systematic issues and implement solutions to challenging problems.


Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices \& Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices \& Services team is making people's lives better through technology.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Architect and optimize Siemens team center solutions, managing the configuration, installation, maintenance, and ongoing support of teamcenter PLM application, including integrations with CAD applications.
* Manage, optimize and support cloud infrastructure for teamcenter, leveraging GCP technologies to ensure scalability, high availability, and security compliance.
* Collaborate with global teams to deliver tailored solutions, providing implementation and configuration expertise.
* Design robust application architectures, including microservices and scalable frameworks, while aligning with development best practices.
* Author and review technical documentation, drive design/code reviews, and identify opportunities to enhance functionality with cloud technologies.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

37596aa0.title: Specialist Infrastructure Delivery Manager
37596aa0.description:
**Scientific Games:**
 Scientific Games is the global leader in lottery games, sports betting and technology, and the partner of choice for government lotteries. From cutting\-edge backend systems to exciting entertainment experiences and trailblazing retail and digital solutions, we elevate play every day. We push game designs to the next level and are pioneers in data analytics and iLottery. Built on a foundation of trusted partnerships, Scientific Games combines relentless innovation, legendary performance, and unwavering security to responsibly propel the global lottery industry ever forward.
   

  

****Position Summary****
**Experience Level** 
 : 8\-12 years
   

  

**About the Role** 
 : We are looking for a Infrastructure Delivery Manager to lead the delivery of complex IT initiatives. Unlike a generalist Project Manager who focuses solely on timelines and budgets, this role is dedicated to technical feasibility and operational stability. You will act as the critical bridge between our business stakeholders and our engineering teams, ensuring that solutions are not only delivered on time but are architecturally sound and ready for production.
   

  

 A key part of your mission will be to eliminate the "gap" between project completion and operational handover. You will ensure that "Done" doesn't just mean the code is written, but that the solution is documented, tested, and transitioned into the live environment without disrupting existing services.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities** 
 :**
* Technical Delivery Management: Lead the end\-to\-end lifecycle of technical projects, translating high\-level business requirements into detailed technical tasks and actionable roadmaps.
* Technical Liaison \& Translation: Act as the primary interface between non\-technical stakeholders and engineers. You will translate complex technical constraints into business risks and business goals into technical specifications.
* Risk \& Dependency Mapping: Proactively identify technical blockers and cross\-team dependencies. You will be responsible for spotting "hidden" risks—such as integration gaps or scalability issues—before they impact the critical path.
* Service Transition \& Governance: Oversee the move from "Project" to "Operations." This includes managing the Change Advisory Board (CAB) process, ensuring rollback plans are viable, and verifying that the support team is equipped to manage the new service.
* Resource \& Velocity Optimization: Manage the allocation of technical resources across multiple workstreams, balancing the need for speed with the need for quality to avoid creating excessive technical debt.
* Documentation Oversight: Ensure that every project concludes with high\-quality technical documentation, including architectural diagrams, SOPs, and runbooks, ensuring a seamless handover to the Ops team.


****Required Technical Experience** 
 :**
* Hybrid Methodology: Proven experience managing projects using both Agile (Scrum/Kanban) for development and Waterfall for infrastructure/hardware deployments.
* ITIL Framework: Deep understanding of Service Transition and Change Management principles to ensure production stability during deployments.
* Technical Literacy: While you aren't required to code, you must have a solid grasp of modern IT landscapes (e.g., Cloud architecture, API integrations, Virtualization, and Database fundamentals) to challenge technical estimates.
* Project Tooling: Mastery of professional tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Confluence, including the ability to build custom dashboards for stakeholder reporting.


****Professional Profile** 
 :**
* The "Technical Translator": You possess the rare ability to discuss API latency with a developer in one meeting and then explain the business impact of that latency to a Director in the next.
* The Stability Guardian: You have a "production\-first" mindset. You are the person who asks, "How do we support this at 3 AM?" rather than just "When will it be finished?"
* The Pragmatic Planner: You know how to distinguish between "Gold\-Plating" (unnecessary perfection) and "Minimum Viable Product" (MVP) to keep projects moving forward without sacrificing quality.


****Qualifications** 
 :**
* At least 5\-8 years of experience in Infrastructure Delivery Manager or a similar lead technical role.
* Certification: PMP, PRINCE2, or CSM (Certified Scrum Master). ITIL v3/v4 certification is highly preferred.
* Experience managing infrastructure or software deployments in high\-availability, enterprise\-scale environments.

c9b52bd1.description:
**About Signant Health**
 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
   

  

 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
   

  

 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Signant Health is recruiting an IT Delivery Lead to give every significant IT delivery a single, accountable owner from approval through to a compliant go\-live. Working within IT’s lean, high\-tempo delivery model, the IT Delivery Lead takes end\-to\-end ownership of automation and Ai delivery — with particular accountability for the cross\-boundary work (dependencies, compliance sequencing, decisions, escalation and continuity) that keeps a delivery on track in a regulated, GxP environment.
   

  

 This is a delivery and coordination role, not a build role: engineering owns the technical work and the initiative roadmap sits with the Sponsor. The IT Delivery Lead owns whether a delivery is genuinely ready to ship — sequencing compliance so it never becomes the bottleneck, confirming dependencies before dates are committed, driving decisions and approvals to closure, and keeping the audit trail complete. It will suit a delivery professional energised by making complex, cross\-functional work land in a controlled environment, who is also fluent in how AI and automation are governed and delivered responsibly.
   

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function**
* Delivery ownership — hold a single delivery accountable end to end through the IT SDLC; run its gates (day\-one AI\-vs\-automation classification, Team Confirmation, Go/No\-Go, release and closure); confirm the delivery is genuinely ready to go live.
* Boundary \& dependency management — maintain the dependency and change\-freeze register; confirm feasibility with dependency owners before dates are committed; drive decisions, approvals and escalations to closure; ensure a named deputy for every gate approver.
* Compliance \& validation orchestration — sequence GxP compliance so it is never the bottleneck; own the tier\-appropriate deliverable set (GxP risk determination, Validation Plan, Process Risk Assessment/FMEA, test evidence, release notification, validation summary) to completion and approval; protect the audit trail.
* Release management — own the release runbook; route production change through the change\-management process, including CAB review for high\-impact change; sequence sign\-offs; confirm hypercare and monitoring ownership before go\-live.
* Team cadence — facilitate the daily standup; uphold Jira hygiene and a shared Definition of Done; coordinate UAT and demos.
* Risk \& continuous improvement — maintain the project risk register; run delivery retrospectives; maintain shared templates and the delivery playbook so learning is retained in the model.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes**
 Essential:
   

  

* Degree\-level education or equivalent professional experience.
* Delivery, project or agile certification (e.g. Scrum, PRINCE2, PMP, ITIL) desirable.
* Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence, coordinate and drive work to closure without direct authority.
* Confident facilitation of agile ceremonies and disciplined use of Jira and delivery tooling.
* Working knowledge of AI and automation governance — and comfort working with AI\-enabled delivery tooling.
* Highly organised and detail\-oriented, with a habit of surfacing risks and dependencies early.


**Desirable:**
* Proven delivery or project\-management track record taking technology change to production in a regulated (preferably GxP / life\-sciences) environment.
* Strong compliance\-sequencing and validation awareness (CSA / GAMP 5, change management) with audit\-grade documentation discipline.
* Experience delivering automation / RPA and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Familiarity with GxP computerised system validation and quality frameworks (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH E6(R3\)).
* Data literacy and experience resolving cross\-system data\-readiness issues.


**Why Signant Health?**
 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
   

  

 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
   

  

 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
   

  

 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
   

  

 Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

 The Client Solutions Manager is responsible for coordinating and executing short and mid\-term client projects and activities, ensuring the team meets or exceeds its commercial, development, compliance and people targets, supporting Sales expanding our presence in the region, and working with the leadership in developing and implementing business performance improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Specific Responsibilities Include (but Are Not Limited To)**
* Managing and leading a team of junior to mid\-level professionals. Ensure best in class client service practices are upheld through close coaching and support direct reports in their professional development plans, actively managing team performance and people development.
* Role model GLG leadership and culture in and outside the team.

* Track team performance and create plans to accelerate growth and revenue near\- and long\-term.
* Programming live in\-country meetings or teleconferences on relevant subject matter and news worthy events to our clients in collaboration with Sales.


**An Ideal Candidate Will Have The Following**
* Up to 7\-10 years of experience, ideally in full\-fledged client facing/servicing roles that could be in consulting, Financial Services, market research, or other professional services or start up environment
* Prior experience in directly managing or mentoring/coaching team members would be a plus.
* Strong can\-do attitude and track record of business growth / turnaround
* Proven ability to manage and motivate a team of client service professionals
* Successful track record of working in fast paced, client service environment
* Client focused/driven individual – must be able to innovate to be a problem solver for clients
* Outstanding communication (oral and written) skills in English and willingness to call and engage senior professionals
* Understanding of the business climate. Interest in working across industries in subjects ranging from industrials to consumers to healthcare


**We Seek Bright, Positive And Flexible People Who Also**
* Act with the highest integrity and professionalism in all their endeavors
* Think creatively and focus on opportunities for accelerated growth
* Exhibit relentless attention to detail
* Express a strong desire to work in and lead a team

**About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group**
 GLG is the world’s leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision\-makers—from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s—with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions.
   

  

 At GLG, you are an extension of our clients' core teams. You will work at the intersection of industries and global markets, navigating high\-stakes challenges across the full spectrum of their strategic initiatives. Operating within the industry’s most trusted research environment, you’ll help our clients capture the nuanced perspectives that drive smarter, faster business outcomes.

ff2adf6f.title: Lead Technology Program Manager
ff2adf6f.description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI\-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud\-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.


**Position Summary**
--------------------

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced **Lead Technology Program Manager** to drive the successful delivery of complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives that support strategic business priorities and customer commitments.


In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Business teams to plan, coordinate, and execute large\-scale programs.


The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership, executive communication skills, technical acumen, and the ability to influence across a complex matrix organization. This leader will manage strategic customer initiatives and technology programs, cross\-functional dependencies, risks, financial planning, and executive reporting while ensuring delivery against business objectives.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Program Planning and Execution**

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of complex technology programs and strategic initiatives.
* Develop and maintain integrated program plans, roadmaps, schedules, and milestone tracking.
* Coordinate activities across multiple product, engineering, and business teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Track program progress and drive timely resolution of issues that may impact delivery commitments.

### **Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Customer\-facing teams to align priorities and execution plans.
* Facilitate cross\-functional discussions to manage dependencies, remove obstacles, and resolve conflicts.
* Drive accountability across stakeholders while fostering a collaborative and results\-oriented environment.

### **Governance and Communication**

* Establish and manage program governance processes, operating rhythms, and reporting mechanisms.
* Prepare and deliver clear, concise program status updates for leadership reviews.
* Communicate key milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Ensure transparency into program health and delivery progress.

### **Risk and Dependency Management**

* Identify, assess, and proactively manage program risks, issues, and interdependencies.
* Develop mitigation plans and coordinate execution of corrective actions.
* Escalate critical issues with clear recommendations and supporting data.

### **Customer and Business Alignment**

* Support strategic customer initiatives and business\-critical programs.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand objectives, requirements, and success criteria.
* Ensure business priorities are reflected in program planning and execution activities.

### **Continuous Improvement**

* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled program management best practices, tools, and processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery predictability, operational efficiency, and team effectiveness.
* Contribute to organizational learning through lessons learned, retrospective reviews, and process enhancements.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in Technology Program Management, Project Management, Product Delivery, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience leading large, cross\-functional technology initiatives in a matrixed organization.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and technology delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs and competing priorities.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a data\-driven approach to decision making.
* Experience managing program risks, dependencies, and executive communications.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience supporting strategic customer programs, airline technology, travel technology, distribution platforms, or digital commerce solutions.
* Experience working across globally distributed teams.
* Familiarity with Agile frameworks, Jira, Rally, Azure DevOps, or similar delivery management tools.
* PMP, Agile, SAFe, or equivalent project/program management certification.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced technology environment undergoing transformation and growth.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

Success in this role will be measured by:


* Delivery of committed program milestones and objectives.
* Effective management of risks, dependencies, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Improved visibility and predictability of program execution.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and confidence in program governance.
* Achievement of customer and business outcomes.
* Contribution to continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

You will play a key role in delivering strategic technology and customer initiatives that drive business value and innovation. This position offers the opportunity to work with global teams, influence high\-impact programs, and contribute to the successful execution of transformative technology initiatives.


**Join us and help shape the future of travel through technology.**

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.


Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

Job Summary
  
  

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Data Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering, data architecture, and data integration. This role involves building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, ensuring data quality and integrity, and supporting data analytics initiatives. You will work closely with internal customers, product owners, core team members, and other stakeholders to ensure that quality data is available, reliable, and easily accessible in a cost effective efficient, scalable way
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:** • Data Pipeline Development: Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable, and efficient data pipelines to collect, process, and store large volumes of data from various sources. • Data Integration: Integrate data from multiple sources, including APIs, databases, and external datasets, ensuring data consistency and reliability. • Data Modelling: Develop and maintain data models and schemas that support efficient data storage, retrieval, and analytics. • Database Management: Manage and optimize databases, ensuring their performance, availability, and security • Data Quality: Implement and monitor data quality checks to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data. Perform analysis required to troubleshoot data related issues and assist in the resolution of data issues. • Automation: configure data extraction and load jobs and automate repetitive tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce errors. Improve performances of jobs and pipelines by applying optimisation and automation techniques. • Documentation: Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of data pipelines, data models, and data integration processes. Maintenance of time allocation reports. • Develop understanding of business/ processes and high\-level understanding of high\-quality digital product delivery • Ways of working: Follow Agile and SDLC processes including the creation of data related user stories. Perform code peer reviews and testing as per SDLC or industry standards. • Collaboration: Work closely with internal customers, product owners, various core team members, and other stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide appropriate solutions. Technical collaboration and oversight with Vendors as required. Create SOWs and work packets with vendors as required. Education: · Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, data science, software engineering, information systems or a similar field or equivalent experience.

1e814b37.title: Lead Architect
1e814b37.description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
   

  

 You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don’t just move the world forward—we’re proud to be recognized as a
 **Great Place to Work®** 
 by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job?
   

  

 The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA
   

  

**About The Role \& Team**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Lead Architect** 
 with strong
 **Java development foundations** 
 and proven
 **solution design expertise** 
 to join our technology team. This role goes beyond high\-level design \- you will act as the
 **Technical Owner** 
 for one or more mission\-critical application built on
 **Java, AWS, and MongoDB** 
 , while also shaping new solutions for future customer and business needs.
   

  

 As a Lead Architect, you will combine
 **hands\-on technical depth** 
 with
 **architectural leadership** 
 , ensuring that systems are scalable, secure, and aligned with modern cloud\-native principles. You will work closely with engineering teams, product owners, and stakeholders, acting as the technical authority throughout the application lifecycle.
   

  

 The world is changing. Are you ready to define the future of travel with us?
   

  

  

  

**what You’ll Do**
* Own the end\-to\-end technical architecture of existing applications built on Java, AWS, and MongoDB
* Act as Technical Owner, responsible for architecture decisions, technical roadmap, and system health
* Design scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective cloud\-native solutions using AWS services
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership, including design reviews, code reviews, and technical guidance
* Define and enforce architecture standards, design patterns, and best practices
* Collaborate with product, delivery, and business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions
* Identify and manage technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and architectural debt
* Support incident resolution, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Mentor engineers and promote strong engineering and DevOps practices


**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**
* Strong background in Java development, with experience using Spring / Spring Boot
* Proven experience in solution architecture or application architecture roles
* Hands\-on expertise with AWS cloud services, including compute, storage, networking, and security
* Solid experience working with MongoDB, including data modeling and performance considerations
* Deep understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs, and distributed systems
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and infrastructure\-as\-code concepts
* Ability to balance hands\-on technical work with architectural leadership responsibilities
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills


  

  

**NICE\-TO\-HAVE**
* Experience working in the aviation, travel, or transportation domain
* Exposure to containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Knowledge of event\-driven architectures and messaging platforms
* Experience modernizing legacy systems to cloud\-native architectures
* Prior experience in customer\-facing or pre\-sales technical roles


  

  

**What We Offer**
 We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
   

  

  

  

 🏡
 **Flex Week:** 
 Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)
   

  

  

  

 ⏰
 **Flex Day:** 
 Make your workday suit your life and plans.
   

  

 🌎
 **Flex Location:** 
 Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
   

  

 🌿
 **Employee Wellbeing:** 
 We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health – a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
   

  

  

  

 🚀
 **Professional Development** 
 : Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!
   

  

**🙌🏽** 
**Competitive Benefits** 
 : Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
   

  

  

  

*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*

abca1187.title: Applied Solutions Architect, Google Cloud
abca1187.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.
* Experience building full\-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 4 years of experience in software development, systems architecture, or a highly technical customer\-facing role with proficiency in one of more general\-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Experience designing and building AI applications.


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the technical bridge between our customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer the Proof of Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. By keeping the final production end\-state in mind from day one, you will advocate for our AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape. Design comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation. Code, build, and deploy robust cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions—such as agentic workflows, RAG systems, and applied foundation models—backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value. Ensure all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

f68cedcf.title: Senior SAP BTP Development Architect
f68cedcf.description:
**Dear Aspirant!**


We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

**We are looking for: SAP BTP Platform Expert**
-----------------------------------------------


We are looking for a highly experienced Senior SAP BTP Development Architect to lead the design and implementation of scalable, cloud\-native applications on the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). This role requires deep expertise in the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) and SAP Build Process Automation, with a strong background in enterprise\-grade application architecture, integration, and DevOps practices.

**You’ll make an impact by:**
-----------------------------

* Architect and design end\-to\-end solutions using SAP BTP services, with a focus on SAP CAP and SAP Build Process Automation according to SAP best practices.
* Lead the development lifecycle of cloud\-native applications, ensuring best practices in modularity, scalability, and maintainability.
* Act as trusted sparring partner with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and developers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Design and develop cloud\-native applications using CAP (Node.js), CDS, and SAP HANA Cloud.
* Implement and optimize automated workflows using SAP Build Process Automation.
* Ensure security, compliance, and performance standards are met across all BTP applications.
* Mentor and guide development teams on CAP, Node.js/Java, CDS modeling, and BTP service integration.
* Stay current with SAP BTP innovations and contribute to the strategic roadmap for cloud development.

**You’re excited to build on your existing expertise, including:**
------------------------------------------------------------------

* 7\+ years of experience in SAP development, with at least 3 years in SAP BTP and CAP.
* Proven expertise in:
* SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) – Node.js
* CDS (Core Data Services) modeling incl. SAP Fiori Elements
* SAP Build Process Automation
* SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Event Mesh, SAP Destination Service, SAP Authorization \& Trust Management
* Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, OData, and OAuth2/JWT authentication.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and DevOps tools.
* Familiarity with SAP Fiori Elements, SAP UI5, and SAP Business Application Studio.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills
* SAP BTP certifications (e.g., SAP Certified Development Associate – SAP BTP Extension Developer).
* Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS applications on BTP is a plus.
* Knowledge of SAP Integration Suite, SAP AI Core, or SAP Mobile Services is a plus.
* Agile/Scrum methodology experience

**Create a better \#TomorrowWithUs!**


This role is based in Pune and Bangalore, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries \- and the shape of things to come.


We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.


We’re Siemens. A collection of over 300,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We’re dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.

7e5cb107.description:
**Company Description**

Genetrix Technology stands at the leading edge of the Marketing Technology industry, delivering enterprise\-level marketing automation solutions with innovation and precision. Specializing in platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Pardot, Braze, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud Growth. we empower businesses to optimize their marketing efforts. Our mission is to enhance customer engagement and drive measurable growth through cutting\-edge technology and strategic expertise. At Genetrix Technology, we are committed to helping organizations achieve new levels of marketing success.

**Role Description**

Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant/Developer responsible for hands\-on implementation and optimization of Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud solutions. This role designs and builds journeys, supports data\-driven personalization, and partners with agencies, Customer Success Managers, and internal teams to deliver compliant email, SMS, and omnichannel engagement programs. This is a mid\-level, delivery\-focused, client\-facing individual contributor role.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead technical discovery sessions and discussions with clients, confidently articulating technical designs, integration strategies, and potential trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, set and manage expectations, and oversee day\-to\-day client interactions and resolve escalations.
* Work with customers to understand key campaign parameters such as subscriber audience, program frequency, degree of personalization, and overall creative approach.
* Drive hands\-on technical implementation across various Marketing Cloud studios and products.
* Translate client requirements into detailed, well\-understood technical and functional documentation.
* Manage the technical aspects of projects, including responsive email and landing page campaigns, custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation.
* Build solutions that utilize out\-of\-the\-box features and modules in Salesforce Marketing Cloud as far as possible.
* Provide guidance on the technical integration of third\-party systems.
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues.
* Lead, mentor, and guide a small team of technical consultants and developers, overseeing their day\-to\-day work, ensuring code quality, and adherence to best practices.
* Guide all the teams on best practices for code, naming conventions, and documentation.
* Define project goals and timelines.
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations.
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role.
* Working remotely, while collaborating with global teams for delivery across geographies. We may need you to be flexible with your work hours.

**Requirements**

* 3\-7 years of deep, hands\-on experience in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Journey Builder, Interaction Studio, Einstein, Automation studio, etc.)
* Expertise with building dynamic HTML Emails, Templates, Landing Pages, and reusable content blocks using mobile\-first HTML, CSS, Javascript, and JQuery.
* Familiar with AMPscript and SSJS
* Familiar with PSD to HTML conversion
* Good to have knowledge on Agentforce Marketing
* Knowledge of different integration patterns
* Understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Commerce and Community Clouds
* Familiarity with building complex solutions with the use of Data Cloud and MC products like MCE, MC Personalization (formerly known as Interaction Studio), and MC Intelligence (formerly known as Datorama)
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with API(Soap and Rest) and SQL
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating with other Salesforce clouds
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire
* Preferred Salesforce certifications
* Good to have Salesforce certifications

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹1,401,606\.00 \- ₹1,681,294\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

Experience:
