* Ensure alignment between strategic objectives, business priorities, and delivery execution.
* Balance competing priorities, resource constraints, and customer expectations across programs.
* Drive dependency management and cross\-functional coordination to achieve portfolio objectives.
* Establish portfolio\-level reporting, governance, and performance measurement mechanisms.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Lead and influence diverse teams including architects, engineering managers, project managers, QA leaders, DevOps teams, product owners, business analysts, and customer stakeholders.
* Drive collaboration across onsite, offshore, and nearshore delivery teams.
* Remove execution bottlenecks and facilitate timely decision\-making.
* Champion engineering best practices, automation, AI\-enabled delivery models, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Experience**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 12\+ years of overall IT industry experience.
* 7\+ years of progressive experience in Delivery Management, Program Management, Transformation Leadership, or Portfolio Management roles.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering large\-scale fixed bid programs and enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing programs with multi\-million\-dollar budgets and distributed global delivery teams.
* Strong experience delivering enterprise software implementations, platform modernization, cloud transformation, and digital initiatives.
* Demonstrated success in managing customer relationships at executive and senior leadership levels.
* Experience managing contractual commitments, commercial governance, and delivery profitability.

81948887.title: Program Manager - Regulatory
81948887.description:
About Origin
Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general\-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi\-trade platform combines purpose\-built hardware with real\-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high\-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver faster execution, stronger project economics, and meaningful cost savings. Join India’s talent\-dense robotics team, with colleagues from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, and other leading institutions.


About the role
As Program Manager \- Regulatory, you will build and run the cross\-functional program that takes Origin’s autonomous robots from engineering prototypes to compliant, deployable products. You will translate market, product, safety, and certification requirements into a clear roadmap, evidence plan, decision log, and execution cadence. You will partner with hardware, embedded, software, safety, manufacturing, legal, and deployment teams, as well as external laboratories and authorities, to ensure regulatory work is planned early and closed without slowing product velocity.


Key responsibilities* Own the regulatory and certification program plan for Origin’s robot platform and deployed configurations.
* Map applicable product, electrical, radio, machinery, functional\-safety, workplace, transport, and market\-entry requirements across target geographies.
* Convert requirements into owners, design inputs, test plans, technical files, evidence packages, milestones, and release gates.
* Coordinate internal design reviews and external test houses, consultants, certification bodies, and authorities.
* Track risks, gaps, dependencies, costs, and schedule; escalate decisions early and drive closure.
* Maintain controlled documentation, compliance matrices, declarations, certificates, reports, and audit trails.
* Integrate regulatory readiness into product development, supplier qualification, manufacturing, and deployment processes.


Requirements
* 6\+ years in regulatory affairs, certification program management, product compliance, safety engineering, or complex technical program management.
* Experience taking electromechanical, industrial, automotive, aerospace, robotics, or connected hardware products through formal compliance processes.
* Strong working knowledge of technical documentation, risk management, test planning, and evidence\-based certification.
* Ability to coordinate senior engineering stakeholders and external laboratories while maintaining clear accountability.
* Excellent written communication, attention to detail, and program tracking.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related technical field.


Preferred experience* Exposure to UL, CE, FCC, IEC, ISO, OSHA, machinery safety, functional safety, EMC, or radio compliance.
* Experience with autonomous systems, construction equipment, industrial machinery, or products deployed in the United States.
* Formal program\-management or quality\-system experience.

 5\-10 years

 Full\-Time

 Urgent Hiring

 Semiconductors

 We're looking for a Program Manager who will work closely with Aether's customers and take full ownership of their programs from our side.  ● Prepare clear updates on program status, risks, actions and deliveries.

 ● Handle customer escalations and make sure the right people are involved internally.
 



 ● Track customer commitments closely so there are no last\-minute surprises.
 



 ● Build strong working relationships with customers and understand their future requirements.

 ● Comfortable working with international customers.

So far, we’ve helped our customers disburse Billions of Dollars in credit across unsecured and secured credit including personal loans, working capital loans, business loans, mortgage and education loans. **About The Role**
 As a Solutions Consultant in Solutions Consulting and Pre\-Sales for International Markets, you will work in tandem with the Account team to build and deliver a winning value proposition for potential customers. The winning value proposition will include, but not be limited to, activities such as solution discovery discussions, RFX (RFP/RFI etc.) responses, crafting POVs/value propositions/solution approaches, and delivering right\-fit and contextual solution demos.
   

  

 You will partner with Account Executives to win and grow strategic accounts by translating FinBox’s credit infrastructure and risk intelligence platforms into outcome\-driven solutions for Banks, NBFCs and Fintech lenders. You will lead discovery, solution design, and buyer\-centric demos that showcase how FinBox can accelerate digital lending, embedded credit, and partnership lending programs while meeting regulatory and risk objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct deep discovery on customer journeys, tech stack, credit policies, and partnership models to identify value levers for FinBox solutions.
* Design end\-to\-end solution architectures using FinBox APIs and platforms (Prism, BRE, Risk Intelligence, Credit Infrastructure) aligned to business, risk, and compliance needs.
* Build and deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and walkthroughs that move conversations from features to measurable business outcomes (AUM growth, GNPA control, time\-to\-market, unit economics).
* Create solution decks, configuration documents, and proposal inputs (scopes, assumptions, phasing) for RFPs/RFIs and large pursuits in partnership with Account Executives.
* Act as the primary technical and product point of contact in deals, handling queries from business, risk, product, technology, InfoSec, and operations stakeholders on the customer side.
* Support commercial negotiations with solution\-level clarification, effort estimates, and rollout plans, ensuring feasibility and success metrics are clearly defined.
* Work closely with Account Executives, Sales, Product, Engineering and Delivery teams to drive opportunities forward and ensure strong alignment throughout the sales cycle.
* Document agreed architectures, configurations, and success KPIs, and ensure smooth handover to Delivery / Customer Success teams after deal closure.
* Continuously channel client and market feedback into Product and Engineering to influence roadmap for risk models, decisioning, and embedded credit capabilities.
* Develop a strong understanding of customer and market needs across international markets and translate these insights into actionable recommendations for internal teams.
* Collaborate closely with regional sales heads, account managers, Account Executives and inside sales/SDR teams to understand opportunities, prioritize pursuits and develop winning solution strategies.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of solutioning approaches, presales playbooks, demo narratives and reusable assets to improve the effectiveness and scalability of the presales function.
* Independently own and drive solutioning for strategic opportunities while collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure timely and high\-quality outcomes.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 5–10 years of overall experience, with minimum 5 years of hands\-on Pre\-Sales / Solutions Consulting experience.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical detail into simple, outcome\-focused narratives for CXO, business, and technology stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving and solutioning mindset with exposure to digital lending, LOS/LMS, bureau data, and embedded finance models.
* Exposure to international markets such as MENA, Africa and APAC.
* Ability to run discovery workshops, design solution architectures, and drive PoCs under tight timelines while collaborating closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering.
* Strong ability to independently manage multiple opportunities and work effectively with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to operate as a hands\-on individual contributor and take ownership of complex enterprise opportunities from discovery through solution design, demo/PoC and deal closure.

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. The Opportunity
  
An OpenText Content Server Cloud Applications Consultant is responsible for the technical delivery of the CS (Content Server) Platform based solutions. **You are good at:**

* Participate in the day\-to\-day administration of the systems, including Incident\& Problem Management
* Participate in execution of new implementations, upgrades and patching activities.
* Participate in the advanced configuration of CS software components, in line with project and customer time scales.
* To co\-ordinate project delivery through multiple teams that may include 3rd party suppliers, partners and client resources.
* Actively contribute in identifying opportunities for automating day to day activities where possible to achieve operational efficiencies.
* Actively seek new opportunities by working with the customer and the change control provisions provided by the contract, to extend the scope of profitable business.
* Actively use and contribute to the project management standards and quality checks used within OpenText Cloud Services.
* Understand requirements, conduct detailed design, determine level of effort, plan work breakdown structures and implementation approach.
* Prepare, maintain and submit activity/progress reports and time recording/management reports in accordance with published procedures. Keep project managers informed of activities and alert of any issues promptly. Provide inputs as part of engagement closure on project learnings and suggest improvements.
* Manage expectations and responsibilities for all clients and internal stakeholders.
* Utilize exceptional written and verbal communication skills while supporting customers via web, telephone, or email, while demonstrating a high level of customer focus and empathy.
* Respond to and solve customer technical requests, show an understanding of the customer's managed hosted environment and applications within the Open Text cloud enabling resolution of complex technical issues. Document or implement proposed solutions.
* Respond to and troubleshoot alerts from monitoring of applications, servers and devices sufficient to meet service level agreements.
* Collaborating on cross\-team and cross\-product technical issues with a variety of resources including Product support, IT, and Professional Services.


**What it takes:**  

* BE /B.Tech. or equivalent technical qualification
* Minimum of 9\-12 years of relevant experience
* Well versed with deployment, administration and troubleshooting of the OpenText Content Suit Platform and surrounding components (Content Server, Archive Server, xECM, Brava, OTDS, Search\& Indexing)
* Experience with Cloud deployment of the Content Suit Platform will be an advantage.
* Knowledge on Windows, UNIX, and Application administration skills in a TCP/IP network environment.
* Experience working with relational DBMS (PostgreSQL/Postgres, Oracle, MS SQL Server, mySQL)
* Programming/scripting is helpful, (ie. SQL, .sh/.bat, Java, JavaScript)
* Familiarity with configuration and management of web/application servers (IIS, Apache, Tomcat, JBoss, etc.).
* Good understanding of object\-oriented programming, Web Services, LDAP configuration, and RDBMS concepts


OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

19de97c2.title: Senior Solutions Architect
19de97c2.description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI\-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on\-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
   

  

 We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
   

  

**Want to join the leader in AI\-powered data security?**
 An increasing share of Cohesity's growth runs through service providers and integrators. Through the Cohesity Aspire Partner Program and a portfolio that spans Cohesity Data Cloud, DataProtect, and NetBackup, our Managed Service Provider (MSP), Cloud Service Provider (CSP), and Global System Integrator (GSI) partners build differentiated, profitable, as\-a\-service offerings on top of our platform.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Solutions Architect** 
 , Multi\-tenancy, MSP \& GSI to be the deep technical lead for partners who deliver Cohesity\-powered services at scale. You will design secure multi\-tenant architectures, enable partners to build repeatable service catalogs such as Backup\-as\-a\-Service and Disaster\-Recovery\-as\-a\-Service, and act as the trusted technical advisor across the service provider and global system integrator ecosystem.
   

  

**HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE** 
 :
   

  

* Architect secure, scalable multi\-tenant deployments using Cohesity Helios and Data Cloud, including namespace isolation, per\-tenant encryption of data at rest and in flight, network and VLAN segmentation, role\-based access control, tenant self\-service, chargeback and showback reporting, and cross\-tenant deduplication.
* Multi\-tenant Architecture and Design
* Design Backup\-as\-a\-Service (BaaS) and Disaster\-Recovery\-as\-a\-Service (DRaaS) offerings that partners can productize and scale across many downstream customers.
* Guide partners on deployment topologies across on\-premises, colocation, partner\-owned data centers, and public cloud, in any combination.
* MSP, CSP and GSI Enablement
* Serve as the technical lead for MSPs, CSPs, and GSIs within the Cohesity Aspire Partner Program, enabling them to build, launch, and grow managed services practices.
* Help GSIs integrate Cohesity into their solution frameworks to deliver repeatable, market\-aligned offerings, and help MSPs and CSPs differentiate their service catalogs and customer experience.
* Support partner onboarding, codesign workshops, reference architectures, and operational readiness reviews.
* Customer and Field Engagement
* Support strategic partner\-led engagements, proof of concept, and executive briefings, representing Cohesity credibly across technical and business stakeholders.
* Partner with channel, alliances, and field teams to drive multi\-tenant and partner\-focused solution plays.
* Product and Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Bring partner and service provider requirements back to product and engineering, influencing the multi\-tenancy, scale, and automation roadmap.


**WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING:**
* 10\+ years in solution architecture, systems engineering, or service provider and partner\-facing roles.
* Experience with Cohesity, NetBackup, or comparable data protection platforms in a multi\-tenant or managed services setting.
* Direct background working with or within an MSP, CSP, or GSI.
* Relevant cloud or architecture certifications.
* Exceptional storytelling and evangelism skills to engage both technical and executive stakeholders
* Experience with data protection platforms such as Cohesity DataProtect, NetBackup, or comparable solutions is a strong plus.
* Technical Expertise
* Strong hands\-on experience designing and operating multi\-tenant environments, ideally within or for a service provider, MSP, CSP, or GSI.
* Solid knowledge of data protection, backup and recovery, and disaster recovery at scale.
* A clear grasp of multi\-tenancy fundamentals, including isolation, segmentation, role\-based access control, encryption and key management, chargeback, and tenant self\-service.
* API\-first and automation skills (REST APIs, orchestration, infrastructure as code), with familiarity across VMware Cloud Director, ServiceNow, and related tooling.
* Familiarity with public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and with as\-a\-service, consumption\-based commercial models.
* Evangelism \& Enablement
* Relevant, demonstrated experience managing or architecting for MSP, CSP, or GSI relationships and multi\-tenant service delivery.
* Strong customer\-facing and partner\-facing skills, with composure and credibility in complex, multi\-stakeholder engagements.
* Commercial awareness, including the ability to connect technical design to partner profitability, consumption economics, and faster time to value.
* A compelling communicator across both technical and executive audiences.
* Collaboration \& Leadership
* Ability to influence and lead across multiple teams—engineering, product, sales, and marketing.
* Strategic thinker who can balance deep technical expertise with business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support decision making

924373a4.description:
**About Chubb** 




 Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S\&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: http://www.chubb.com/
 



  





**About Chubb India** 




 At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we foster a startup mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape. We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real\-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.
 



  





**Position Details:** 




**Job Title:** 
 Solution Architect
 



**Function/Department:** 

 Architecture
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad/Bangalore
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





 The Solution Architect will play a pivotal role in leading the architecture and design of Chubb’s core insurance system transformation.
 



  





 The focus is on design and governance of end‑to‑end technology solutions for insurance applications, ensuring they are business‑aligned, secure, scalable, and consistent with enterprise architecture standards.
 



  





 The role acts as a key bridge between business stakeholders (underwriting, claims, operations, actuarial, finance), platform engineering, and delivery teams to define solutions that support profitable growth, operational efficiency, and excellent experience.
 


* Lines of business: P\&C, Personal Lines, Specialty and A\&H
* Domain coverage: Distribution, quote \& bind, policy, billing, claims, reinsurance, catastrophe management and finance
* Solution types: insurance packaged platforms, custom build, digital portals, finance/shared services applications, integration, data \& analytics, workflow/automation



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Solution Architecture \& Design** 



* Lead the design of end‑to‑end solutions across underwriting, policy, claims, billing, reinsurance, underwriting, and digital channels.
* Produce and maintain architecture artefacts (solution diagrams, interface specifications, design decisions) in line with standards.
* Design for non‑functional requirements (performance, availability, security, resilience, supportability).
* Liaise with analytics, infrastructure, operational resilience and security to have an end\-to\-end solution design



  





**Business \& Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Work closely with underwriting, claims, operations, actuarial, finance, and distribution stakeholders to understand business objectives, products, and processes.
* Translate business requirements and pain points into viable solution options, highlighting impacts, risks, and trade‑offs.
* Participate in governance forums (architecture boards, design reviews, project steering groups) to present and defend solution designs.



  





**Integration \& Data** 



* Design integration patterns between applications, platforms, shared services, and external partners
* Define data flows and key data entities across underwriting, claims, finance, and regulatory reporting; ensure data quality, lineage, and appropriate use.
* Promote standardized API design patterns, and reusable services to reduce duplication and increase agility.



  





**Initiative Delivery Support \& Technical Leadership** 



* Provide architectural guidance to product owners, business analysts, developers, testers, and vendors throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Review solution designs, estimates, and technical decisions from delivery teams, ensuring alignment with target architecture.
* Support issue resolution and root‑cause analysis for complex production or integration issues related to solutions.



  





**Risk, Compliance \& Security** 



* Ensure solutions align with internal risk, security, and compliance policies, and support applicable P\&C regulatory and reporting needs.
* Embed controls for data protection, auditability, access management, and operational resilience in solution designs.



**Continuous Improvement \& Strategy** 



* Contribute to technology roadmaps and target architecture, including decommissioning of legacy systems and adoption of strategic platforms.
* Monitor industry and technology trends in insurance (AI, digital distribution, automation, straight‑through processing, data \& analytics) and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Promote architectural best practices, patterns, and standards.



  





**Qualifications:** 




  




* 10\-15 years of IT Experience and 1\-2 years in architectural designs.
* 1\-2 years understanding of insurance business (ideally Commercial Lines).
* Deep knowledge in at least two of the following insurance platforms (Duckcreek/Guidewire), AI, cloud platforms, API‑led integration, microservices, and data architectures.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Professional architecture or technology certifications desirable.

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.

**Why Chubb?** 




 Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!

* **Growth and success:**

**Employee Benefits**

* Captures all required and relevant information for immediate resolution.
* Provides second level support to all incidents, requests and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Communicates with other teams and clients for extending support.
* Executes changes with clear identification of risks and mitigation plans to be captured into the change record.

* Provides Assistance to L1 Security Engineers for better initial triage or troubleshooting.
* Leads and manages all initial client escalation for operational issues.
* Contributes to the change management process by logging all change requests with complete details for standard and non\-standard including patching and any other changes to Configuration Items.
* Ensures all changes are carried out with proper change approvals.
* Plans and executes approved maintenance activities.
* Audits and analyses incident and request tickets for quality and recommends improvements with updates to knowledge articles.
* Produces trend analysis reports for identifying tasks for automation, leading to a reduction in tickets and optimization of effort.
* May also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
* Performs any other related task as required.


**Knowledge and Attributes:**
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.


**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role).

+ CCNP or equivalent certification

 On\-site Working

We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long\-term success. 76166565.title: Principle IT Architect
76166565.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Job Specific Summary
  

ServiceNow Architect
  

Job Description
  

Work on a growing, dynamic team to guide the design and implementation of new ServiceNow features, custom enhancements to ServiceNow applications, new custom applications, and migration of legacy solutions to the latest technologies. Our current programs include a broad rollout of NowAssist and Predictive Intelligence capabilities, expansion of Configurable Workspace capabilities, and numerous modernization and automation initiatives.
  

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
  

* Develop and maintain the overall ServiceNow platform architecture, ensuring alignment with business goals and industry best practices.
* Lead the design of scalable and sustainable solutions, considering performance, security, and integration requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to a team of ServiceNow developers and administrators.
* Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to understand requirements and assist in translating them into effective ServiceNow solutions.
* Work with enterprise and business unit architects to align on strategic direction and tactical decisions while representing the needs of the ServiceNow platform
* Oversee the implementation and configuration of ServiceNow modules.
* Ensure adherence to coding and configuration standards.
* Design and implement integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems to streamline processes and data flow.
* Participate in establishing and enforcing guardrails, policies, and ensuring compliance with security standards and regulations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including IT teams, business units, and external vendors, to gather requirements and ensure successful platform implementation.
* Act as a bridge between technical and non\-technical stakeholders, facilitating effective communication.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including architectural diagrams, configuration guides, and best practice documentation.
* Provide training and mentorship to team members to enhance their ServiceNow skills.

Requirements
  

* Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214\.2(h)(4\)(iii)(A)
* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree plus relevant experience
* Proven experience of 2\+ years as a ServiceNow Platform Architect, with a strong focus on platform design and implementation
* Active ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification
* ServiceNow Architect certification is highly desirable
* Proven experience leading ServiceNow implementations, including customization, integration, and development.

In\-depth understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, ServiceNow modules, scripting, integrations, and best practices.
  

* Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and AJAX, along with experience in web application development and ServiceNow platform functionalities
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities to troubleshoot issues and optimize processes
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders
* Relevant certifications such as ServiceNow Certified Application Developer or Certified Implementation Specialist (HR/CSM/ITSM)
* Demonstrated leadership abilities, with the capability to mentor and guide ServiceNow developers.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience creating and maintaining an Architecture Blueprint for a ServiceNow ecosystem
* Demonstrated experience developing and supporting custom Service Portal widgets and pages, including complex CSS and user interfaces
* Practical experience with ServiceNow AI Search configuration and optimization
* Practical experience with NowAssist configuration and optimization
* Practical experience building and supporting custom Configurable Workspaces
* Practical experience with designing and building Flow Designer Flows
* Extensive experience designing and implementing custom REST integrations, including experience building reusable frameworks and transitioning to IntegrationHub spokes
* Experience configuring OAuth authentication and Single Sign\-on solutions

65c28685.title: Sr Technical Project Delivery Manager
65c28685.description:
**Job Description** 




**The Senior Technical Project Delivery Manager will lead the end\-to\-end execution of the People Empowerment Platform (Super\-App), ensuring timely delivery, technical excellence, and alignment with business goals. This role demands strong project management, cloud\-native architecture expertise (GCP), and Agile delivery leadership. The manager will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, vendors, and partners to deliver a scalable, secure, and AI\-powered platform.** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**Project \& Delivery Management** 



* Lead Agile\-based project execution across scope, schedule, cost, and quality.
* Manage CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and performance monitoring.
* Ensure timely delivery of milestones and risk mitigation.



**Cloud\-Native Architecture \& Development** 



* Oversee microservices deployment on GCP using Kubernetes (GKE).
* Optimize AI/ML workflows, data pipelines, and real\-time analytics.
* Ensure secure, scalable, and high\-availability architecture.



**Technology Oversight** 



* Manage full\-stack delivery: Flutter (frontend), Node.js (backend), GCP services.
* Ensure seamless integration of tools like BigQuery, Vertex AI, Looker, and Jenkins.
* Drive observability, automation, and performance optimization.



**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Collaborate with system integrators, Google Cloud partners, and consultants.
* Conduct technical due diligence and negotiate SLAs and contracts.
* Align internal and external teams for smooth execution.



**Security \& Compliance** 



* Enforce SSDLC, cloud security, and data privacy standards.
* Implement disaster recovery and failover strategies.
* Monitor compliance with GDPR and other regulatory frameworks.



**Leadership \& Process Improvement** 



* Mentor technical teams and promote Agile, DevOps, and innovation.
* Continuously improve delivery processes and cost efficiency.
* Contribute to strategic planning and platform evolution.



**Requirements** 




**Key Attributes** 



* Strong leadership and stakeholder management
* Deep expertise in GCP, microservices, and DevOps
* Analytical mindset with a focus on performance and scalability
* High accountability, ownership, and collaborative spirit
* CI/CD automation, Kubernetes orchestration, and DevOps pipeline optimization.
* Real\-time AI/ML\-driven insights using Big Query, Looker, and Vertex AI.



**Experience And Qualification** 



* Strong understanding of the Industry and familiarity with research products and services.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and negotiate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
* Strategic thinker with a demonstrated ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and develop targeted strategies to drive growth.



**Education** 



* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or IT (MBA preferred)
* 8\+ years in technical project management and cloud\-based delivery
* 5\+ years of hands\-on development experience
* Certifications preferred: PMP, SAFe, GCP, ITIL



**Benefits** 



* Opportunity to make significant contributions to a dynamic company
* Evening snacks are provided by the company to keep you refreshed towards the end of the day.
* Walking distance from Chakala metro station, making commuting easy and convenient.



***At Axis My India, we value discipline and focus. Our team members wear brand on sleeves, adhere to a no\-mobile policy during work hours, and work from our office with alternate Saturdays off. If you thrive in a structured environment and are committed to excellence, we encourage you to apply.***

91a2e16a.title: [Upcoming Roles] Technical Delivery Manager
91a2e16a.description:
**Join Us!**
 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
   

  

**This job posting is part of our proactive talent pipelining efforts for future openings. While there may not be an immediate vacancy, candidates may be invited to complete assessments or interviews at this stage. By applying, you consent to being considered for relevant opportunities that may arise within the next 6 months.**
**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Delivery Manager in the Google Operations Center, you'll play a critical role in overseeing the development and delivery of our essential internal tools and applications. You'll collaborate closely with engineering leads, product managers, and stakeholders across Google to define project scope, manage timelines, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution. If you have a proven track record of delivering impactful solutions, a deep understanding of software development lifecycles, and exceptional communication and leadership skills, we encourage you to apply!
   

  

****Position Responsibilities****
* Organizational Leadership: Manage and develop a team of Team Leads. Provide regular coaching, mentoring, and performance management to elevate their leadership capabilities and support their career growth.
* Workflow Oversight: Serve as the focal point of contact for internal and external project queries, ensuring that the team’s actions remain in synergy with broader business goals.
* Strategic Alignment: Ensure the development teams' work aligns with the overall strategic goals and roadmap of the Google Operations Center. This includes understanding the big picture and translating it into actionable plans for the teams.
* Cross\-Team Coordination: Work with domain experts, SWE, UX, and PM to translate project requirements into technical tasks.
* Risk Management and Mitigation: Proactively identify and assess potential risks that could impact project delivery, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues as needed to ensure timely resolution.
* Dependency Management: Identify and manage dependencies between different projects and teams, ensuring that roadblocks are removed and projects are delivered efficiently.
* Process Optimization: Continuously analyze and improve development processes, workflows, and tools to enhance efficiency, productivity, and overall team performance. This could involve implementing Agile best practices, refining communication channels, or introducing new technologies.


**Minimum Requirements**
* Experience: 12y\+ in technical project management, with a focus on maintenance \& core development with multiple dev models like agile / scrum / waterfall.
* People Management: 7y\+ people management experience involving performance management .
* Strong Experience in Project Planning and Scheduling, Team Coordination, Stakeholder Management, Risk Management, Resource Management, and Quality Assurance
* Excellent organizational skills to track project / scrum timelines, roadmaps, and deliverables.
* Strong Experience in end to end Software Development Life Cycle
* Experience with multiple full lifecycles from Design \& Architecture through Development, Testing, Deployment and Debugging production issues.


**Preferred Qualifications**
*Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable:*
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong experience in SQL, Regex, database concepts.
* 5y\+ experience using GIT based continuous integration \& delivery
* Experience with Cloud Computing platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS
* Experience in Middleware development/design (remote procedure call based, publish subscribe based, etc…)


**Benefits**
* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender\-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth\-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences


 Information collected and processed as part of your Google Operations Center (GOC) jobs profile, and any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to GOC's Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy.
   

  

 Google Operations Center (GOC) is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
   

  

 To ensure a barrier\-free interview, please mention any required assistance or specific arrangements in your application and confirm them with your recruiter.
   

  

 To all recruitment agencies: Google Operations Center (GOC) does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, GOC employees, or any other organization location. GOC is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
   

  

*Thanks for your interest in this opportunity! Our recruitment team will contact you if your profile is a good fit for the role. If you don't hear from us within 2\-3 weeks, please consider your application unsuccessful at this time. We value your patience throughout this time. For any questions, feel free to reach out to us at goc\-candidate\-global@googleoperationscenter.com.*

 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
   

  

**This job posting is part of our proactive talent pipelining efforts for future openings. While there may not be an immediate vacancy, candidates may be invited to complete assessments or interviews at this stage. By applying, you consent to being considered for relevant opportunities that may arise within the next 6 months.**
**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Delivery Manager in the Google Operations Center, you'll play a critical role in overseeing the development and delivery of our essential internal tools and applications. You'll collaborate closely with engineering leads, product managers, and stakeholders across Google to define project scope, manage timelines, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution. If you have a proven track record of delivering impactful solutions, a deep understanding of software development lifecycles, and exceptional communication and leadership skills, we encourage you to apply!
   

  

****Position Responsibilities****
* Organizational Leadership: Manage and develop a team of Team Leads. Provide regular coaching, mentoring, and performance management to elevate their leadership capabilities and support their career growth.
* Workflow Oversight: Serve as the focal point of contact for internal and external project queries, ensuring that the team’s actions remain in synergy with broader business goals.
* Strategic Alignment: Ensure the development teams' work aligns with the overall strategic goals and roadmap of the Google Operations Center. This includes understanding the big picture and translating it into actionable plans for the teams.
* Cross\-Team Coordination: Work with domain experts, SWE, UX, and PM to translate project requirements into technical tasks.
* Risk Management and Mitigation: Proactively identify and assess potential risks that could impact project delivery, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues as needed to ensure timely resolution.
* Dependency Management: Identify and manage dependencies between different projects and teams, ensuring that roadblocks are removed and projects are delivered efficiently.
* Process Optimization: Continuously analyze and improve development processes, workflows, and tools to enhance efficiency, productivity, and overall team performance. This could involve implementing Agile best practices, refining communication channels, or introducing new technologies.


**Minimum Requirements**
* Experience: 12y\+ in technical project management, with a focus on maintenance \& core development with multiple dev models like agile / scrum / waterfall.
* People Management: 7y\+ people management experience involving performance management .
* Strong Experience in Project Planning and Scheduling, Team Coordination, Stakeholder Management, Risk Management, Resource Management, and Quality Assurance
* Excellent organizational skills to track project / scrum timelines, roadmaps, and deliverables.
* Strong Experience in end to end Software Development Life Cycle
* Experience with multiple full lifecycles from Design \& Architecture through Development, Testing, Deployment and Debugging production issues.


**Preferred Qualifications**
*Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable:*
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong experience in SQL, Regex, database concepts.
* 5y\+ experience using GIT based continuous integration \& delivery
* Experience with Cloud Computing platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS
* Experience in Middleware development/design (remote procedure call based, publish subscribe based, etc…)


**Benefits**
* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender\-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth\-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

b207d084.title: Delivery Lead
b207d084.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Delivery Lead
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Lead end\-to\-end delivery, or a defined component of a contract to meet operational, contractual, and financial commitments. Ensure service quality and efficiency. Manage delivery outcomes and identify opportunities for follow\-on work through up\-selling or cross\-selling.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Security Delivery Governance
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Delivery Lead, a typical day involves overseeing the complete delivery process or a specific segment of a contract to ensure all operational, contractual, and financial goals are achieved. This role requires maintaining high standards of service quality and operational efficiency while managing delivery results. The Delivery Lead actively seeks opportunities to expand business through up\-selling or cross\-selling, collaborating with various stakeholders to drive successful project outcomes and foster long\-term client relationships.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
* Lead strategic planning and execution to align delivery objectives with organizational goals.
* Facilitate communication and coordination among cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless project progress.
* Mentor and support junior team members to enhance their skills and performance.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Security Delivery Governance.
* Strong knowledge of governance frameworks and compliance standards related to security delivery.
* Experience in managing service delivery processes and ensuring adherence to contractual obligations.
* Ability to analyze delivery metrics and implement improvements to optimize service quality.
* Skilled in stakeholder management and effective communication across diverse teams.
* Competence in risk management and problem\-solving within complex delivery environments.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 12 years of experience in Security Delivery Governance.
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

55e95e9e.title: [Upcoming Roles] Technical Program Manager
55e95e9e.description:
**Join Us!**
 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
   

  

**This job posting is part of our proactive talent pipelining efforts for future openings. While there may not be an immediate vacancy, candidates may be invited to complete assessments or interviews at this stage. By applying, you consent to being considered for relevant opportunities that may arise within the next 6 months.**
****Role Overview****
 As a Technical Program Manager at Google Operations Center, you will serve as a strategic operational lead, responsible for orchestrating complex, cross\-functional programs to ensure seamless execution and delivery. You will function as the primary bridge between technical teams and executive leadership, translating intricate technical challenges into high\-level business insights. The ideal candidate will possess the capability to navigate organizational ambiguity, facilitate strategic alignment across diverse stakeholders, and provide decisive leadership during high\-stakes product launches to ensure operational excellence.
   

  

****Position Responsibilities****
* Program Orchestration \& Delivery: Define dependencies, clear operational bottlenecks, and track program velocity to ensure predictable delivery. Synthesize complex project tracks into a cohesive program roadmap.
* Support for Critical Launches: Serve as the operational lead for high\-stakes, time\-sensitive product or feature launches. Establish launch readiness criteria, run "go/no\-go" checkpoints, and create hypercare support plans for post\-launch stability. Manage real\-time risk mitigation and lead fire\-drills when unforeseen blockers threaten launch dates.
* Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary interface between working execution teams and executive leadership. Manage competing priorities across departments, aligning diverse agendas around shared program objectives. Proactively identify alignment gaps and facilitate strategic trade\-off decisions with senior stakeholders.
* Communication \& Collaboration: Translate technical complexities into clear, business\-focused updates for non\-technical teams and executives. Establish standard operating procedures for status reporting, ensuring a single, accurate source of truth for the program's health. Foster an environment of transparency, ensuring risks are flagged early and constructively.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Bridge organizational silos by facilitating cross\-functional syncs, workshops, and retro meetings. Ensure resource allocations match program priorities across engineering, product, design, and operations.


**Requirements**
****Minimum Requirements****
* Experience: 8\+ years of experience in program or project management, ideally leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives in a physical or operational setting.
* Methodology Expertise: Strong proficiency with project management tools and methodologies. PMP, Scrum Master (CSM), or equivalent certification is a strong plus.
* Technical Experience: Basic knowledge of Java, HTML, and CSS, or equivalent Technical Program Management experience.
* Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, communicating technical work to non\-technical executive teams, with a proven ability to influence without authority and present to senior executives.
* Adaptability: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and pivoting quickly in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related field.


**Preferred Qualifications**
*Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable:*
* Preferred Certifications: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or Project Management Professional (PMP) certifications are strong indicators of qualified candidates for this role.


**Benefits**
* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender\-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth\-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

50324e01.title: Service Delivery Architect for Applications, Business Processing, and Infrastructure Services
50324e01.description:
**Req ID:** 364616
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Service Delivery Architect for Applications, Business Processing, and Infrastructure Services to join our team in Noida, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

Job Description
  
  

Position Title Service Delivery Architect for Applications, Business Processing, and Infrastructure Services
  
  

Position's Role Architect
  
  

**Skills:**  

**Primary Skill:** Yrs Exp Expert (5\+ Years Experience)
  
  

Enterprise Infrastructure Architect
  
  

**Delivery Oversight:** Strategy\-Planning\-Assessment
  
  

Skill
  
  

Solution Architect\-Solution Architecture\-Infrastructure Solution Architect\-Design and Costing of Solutions, PreSales for Enterprise Systems
  
  

**Primary Skill:** Yrs Exp Expert (5\+ Years Experience)
  
  

Solution Architecture
  
  

Position's General Duties and Tasks
  
* Work collaboratively to ensure the successful design (and delivery) of assigned projects and programs for our clients and contributing to the growth targets.
* Work closely with subject matter experts (Technical Architects, Principal Architects, Delivery resources) to ensure the end\-to\-end solution is deliverable and meets cost targets.
* Drive risk identification and management to ensure that the solutions designed meet the needs of the client and are deliverable by the practice.
* Oversee and guide review of solution and delivery architecture.
* Understand, document, and drive development of review and approval processes and tools
* Understand and use competitive financial and benefit analysis.
* Develop and document standards around IT services solutions.
* Serve as an expert consultant to senior leadership and primary and technical architectures
* Act as an "agent of change” and continuously foster the sharing of customer, architecture, and technical information between organizations.


Key Skills
  
* Strong leadership, business, technical, analytical, problem solving and verbal and written communication skills with the willingness to travel when required
* Self\-motivation and ability to work on own initiative, as well as be a strong contributor in a team environment, natural drive to learn and pick up new challenges
* Experience in developing complex solutions to business problems or customer engagements
* Familiar with technologies and processes used to support and deliver complex multi\-tower outsourcing relationships.
* Understand and interpret requirements by probing for information, facilitating consensus building, and synthesizing and translating ideas into actionable requirements.
* Familiarity with industry trends and new developments and using this knowledge in developing differentiated solutions for opportunities
* Great collaborator with strong and positive influencing/negotiating skills coupled with strategic thinking


**Basic Required Qualifications:**  

* Experience in IT outsourcing – infrastructure solutions development, modeling and costing
* An understanding of services delivery architecture or experience in leading / managing complex multi\-tower outsourcing relationships
* Fluency in English is critical.
* Flexibility to work with Global teams and stakeholders
* Understanding the impact of automation and efficiencies on solutions.
* Subject matter expert in at least one service area or technology and proficient in multiple service areas and technologies.
* In\-depth knowledge of assessing operational risk on profitability and impacts to service delivery.


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience in IT Services Delivery – managing multiple delivery teams and / or PL
* Relevant Experience and/or Industry Certification (ITIL, DevSecOps, TOGAF, Agile, or Industry cloud certifications) in Service Management and/or Application Development
* Experience in Web\-based applications development and deployment
* Experience with Microsoft Office / O365 including Macro Design and Programming
* Experience in VB and/or other development languages suitable for Office and Web\-based applications development and deployment
* Experience in Infrastructure architecting and implementing solutions, while providing ongoing solutions support


About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.
  
  

NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. For our EEO Policy Statement, please click here. If you'd like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here. For Pay Transparency information, please click here.

8d121c52.title: Solution Planner
8d121c52.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Solution Planner
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Analyzes client requirements and supports configuring a solution from a standard set of offerings. Liaisons with the delivery organization to ensure effective transition, shape services, and determine appropriate service delivery locations and related costs. Works with client stakeholders to receive sign\-off on the solution.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Solution Architecture
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Program Project Management
   

  

**Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 Graduate or Master graduate with good grades and 10 plus years Solution Architect experience with related certifications good to have
   

  

 Summary: As a Solution Planner, you will engage in a dynamic and collaborative environment where you will analyze client requirements and support the configuration of solutions from a standard set of offerings. Your typical day will involve liaising with the delivery organization to ensure effective transitions, shaping services, and determining appropriate service delivery locations and related costs. You will also work closely with client stakeholders to secure sign\-off on the proposed solutions, ensuring that all aspects of the project align with client expectations and organizational standards. Roles \& Responsibilities: \- Expected to be a Subject Matter Expert with deep knowledge and experience. \- Should have influencing and advisory skills. \- Responsible for team decisions. \- Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. \- Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams. \- Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather requirements and present solutions. \- Develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders to ensure alignment and satisfaction. Professional \& Technical Skills: \- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Solution Architecture. \- Good To Have Skills: Experience with Program Project Management. \- Strong understanding of system integration and architecture frameworks. \- Ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into effective solutions. \- Experience in stakeholder management and communication. Additional Information: \- The candidate should have minimum 15 years of experience in Solution Architecture. \- This position is open for almost all the locations in India. \- A Graduate or Master graduate with good grades and 10 plus years Solution Architect experience with related certifications is good to have

21630cd3.title: Customer Engineer, Platform, Google Cloud
21630cd3.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on\-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience driving the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building the technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors).


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical\-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs\-of\-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross\-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your business acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
   

  

 You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted business motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots and workshops.
* Architect cross\-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post\-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross\-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

517e49b7.title: Sr Solution Architect - Consulting - WMS
517e49b7.description:
**Overview**
 Blue Yonder is currently seeking Enterprise Solution Architect to join our Consulting Services team, specific to the Blue Yonder Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). Enterprise Solution Architect provides leadership and direction to the on\-site implementation team on the design and execution of the solution and definition of business process workflows that accompany the solution. The aim of this role is to take ownership of a solution within an implementation project and architect software solutions that solve the customer’s business problem, while generating maximum value for the customer..
   

  

**Scope**
 Core responsibilities to include Designing, Developing, Unit testing and Validation of New modification and provide support to any production issues related to Modification
   

  

 Be trusted advisor to customer and ability to articulate supply chain logistic business process and solution.
   

  

 Drive value for customer
   

  

**Our Current Technical Environment**
 Software: Java, Java Script, GIT, Rest API, XML/XSLT, MS SQL, PL/SQL
   

  

 Application Architecture: MOCA, PageBuilder and Integrator
   

  

 Cloud Architecture: MS Azure
   

  

 Databases – Oracle / SQL Server
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Leveraged as the Blue Yonder/RedPrairie WMS solution expert for transformational projects/programs
   

  

 Strong domain knowledge in Blue Yonder/RedPrairie WMS solution to understand how the Blue Yonder solutions can be configured and delivered to better facilitate customer business processes
   

  

 Strong domain knowledge in Blue Yonder/RedPrairie Discrete WMS solution to construct an overall architecture for current and future customer business needs
   

  

 Key contributor to the Change Management efforts for global or regional program implementations
   

  

* Ability to prepare and deliver presentations for user, management, and executive level audiences


 Provides advice to customers regarding industry best practices and process methodology
   

  

 Assists Project Manager(s) in planning efforts
   

  

 Able to ask appropriate questions to assess business needs that fall outside the standard solution, assess integration complexity, architecture constraints
   

  

 Can demonstrate and facilitate integration discussions of product functionality and product architecture (i.e. Show data and process flow from one Blue Yonder solution to another)
   

  

 Lead the project team to design and develop functional specifications for modifications, interfaces, reports and screens to ensure smooth integration between technical and functional business requirements
   

  

 Lead the project team in preparing Product Requirement Specifications, test plan for modifications
   

  

 Interact closely with Development services in modification development, quality delivery and organizing demonstrations with customers on modifications.
   

  

 Creates and modifies procedural and system documentation throughout the project
   

  

 Supports the development and execution of test scripts to ensure Blue Yonder consistently meets the customer's business objectives
   

  

 Provides level 3 non\-technical support during the "go\-live" period
   

  

 Provides level 3 user support and verifies that the system provides the required business functions and maintains data integrity
   

  

 Serves as a technical liaison and attends and contributes to key meetings between Project Manager, key customer contacts, and customer users, up to and including key executive project sponsors.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 15 – 18 years of corporate experience
   

  

 Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science or Engineering or other relevant discipline.
   

  

 Expertise in technical configuration of WMS product, Solution Integration, Quality Assurance, System Testing, PLSQL, SQL Server, and Performance Tuning.
   

  

 Hands\-on Experience on Technical configuration of WMS product (preferably Blue Yonder/RedPrairie WMS), Jasper reports, Nice labels, Pagebuilder and MOCA.
   

  

 Knowledge on interfaces between WMS and ERP/Host, TMS, WLM, T\&T, Parcel, 3rd party system that integrates with WMS.
   

  

 Knowledge on integration between WMS and Voice / Material Handling / ASRS systems
   

  

 Ability to resolve complex problems with minimal guidance.
   

  

 Excellent computer skills with in\-depth knowledge of operating systems, client/server technology, ERP systems, Integration and Middleware technologies and applications
   

  

 Ability to develop and maintain strong, productive relationships with customers, partners and consultants
   

  

 Strong proactive communicator and presenter, able to influence and collaborate at all levels of an organization to maximize problem resolution while effectively presenting information and responding to highly specialized technical questions
   

  

 Highly developed analytical and problem solving skills
   

  

 Ability to effectively and proactively work independently
   

  

 Teamwork mentality
   

  

 Contributes to the growth of the technical consulting practice by developing and maintaining practice aids, databases, best\-practice collateral.
   

  

 Ensures compliance with the following internal and external company policies and procedures: Company project methodology On\-time submission of Time, Travel and Expenses report Company procedures related to travel and expenses
   

  

 Skill set and availability requirements as per the organization's needs
   

  

 Knowledge in performance tuning techniques is added advantage.
   

  

 Knowledge on Azure fundamentals
   

  

 Provides guidance to Support Services in responding to base technical issues.
   

  

 Understanding and experience with the technical requirements for the product line assigned.
   

  

 Understanding of Database structures. Understanding of various technical platforms and infrastructures.
   

  

 Understands Blue Yonder product suite so as to convey relationships and touch\-points to the customer.
   

  

 Works with appropriate parties to ensure issues are resolved.
   

  

 Travel readiness based on business needs.
   

  

**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
