7cd7eb20.title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
7cd7eb20.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
   

  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**
 In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

176fb33f.title: Sr Program Manager, Retail Business Services
176fb33f.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Senior Program Manager, Purchase – Retail Business Services  

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead strategy and execution for Shopping Mission Completion, ensuring customers can seamlessly discover, evaluate, and purchase products across the Amazon store.  

  

About Amazon  

Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the widest of selection at low price that drives Amazon’s flywheel.  

  

About the Team  

The vision of Retail Business Services (RBS) Organization at Amazon is to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel by improving customer experience and enabling our Selling Partners (SPs) to grow their business with Amazon. RBS provides catalog augmentation and correction technologies for the Amazon selling community. Our solutions ensure information in Amazon's catalogs is both complete and comprehensive enough to give our customers a great shopping experience every time.  

  

Role Overview  

RBS is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead a Strategy for Shopping Mission Completion for Customers. Amazon Store Walk analysis uncovers critical defects across the Amazon shopping journey; spanning across product discovery, evaluation, and purchase completion. These systemic problems impact the customer shopping journey, from how customers discover and evaluate products to their ability to complete purchases. These issues are categorized into four key defect themes: Data, Search, Catalog and Customer Experience. To resolve these issues, we recommend a coordinated, cross\-functional engagement with partner teams that will improve overall customer shopping experience . This role will be at the center of collaboration between multiple world wide teams in re\-imagining the purchase experience for customers.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Shopping Mission is an essential part of the consumer experience and can fundamentally influence the way customers shop on Amazon as well as shape their perception of Amazon.
  

As a Senior Program Manager \- Purchase, you will
  

* Think Big and own vision for building a Strategy that enables customers to complete their shopping journey.
* Disambiguate the problem space and size the problem and opportunity for RBS
* Be responsible for end\-to\-end business strategy, goal setting, program management, review and collaboration mechanisms.
* Break down ambiguous problems into clear abstract use cases and solution workflows for Tech and Product teams.
* Be responsible for end to end program management with multiple parallel tasks.
* Establish accountability with partner teams and influence them without authority on a common goals.
* Identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate them.
* Be responsible for reporting and review mechanisms and communication to Leadership (Flash updates, WBR, QBR, Deep dives)

  

To be successful in this role, you should be comfortable and confident liaising with remote global teams in business, design and technology at senior leadership levels. You will solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). You will be data\-driven and demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships).
  

  

Representing the voice of customers, you will be an evangelist for the program vision, maintaining support for your cause, keeping engineering teams energized and excited, and driving your program roadmap at all levels. You will be very comfortable with written communication skills and a proven track record of delivering projects from concept to launch.  

  

About the team  

The 'Shopping Mission' program is part of the Customer Experience vertical of RBS. The program is responsible for defining the Vision and long term strategy of improving Customer Experience through improving the quality of Amazon products. RBS is the global sponsor of the program, bringing together multiple world\-wide product, design and engineering teams to execute in a federated manner.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

90ada23e.title: Solution Architect - Technology & Innovation
90ada23e.description:
The TNI Solution Architect is a versatile, highly skilled technology generalist responsible for shaping and delivering enterprise architecture across Convatec’s innovation, infrastructure, and platform portfolio.
 



  





 This role is broad and hands\-on, supporting initiatives such as:
 


* Cloud and on\-premise hosting architecture
* Server migrations, data centre transitions, and re\-platforming
* Custom\-built applications and bespoke software solutions
* Database migrations and optimisation
* Enterprise integration and middleware patterns
* Legacy system modernization
* Evaluation and POCs of emerging technologies
* R\&D, innovation pilots and rapid architectural prototyping



  





 The Solution Architect will work closely with the TNI leadership team, engineering groups, security, infrastructure, business stakeholders, and third\-party partners to ensure scalable, secure, and future\-ready architectural outcomes.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 



* Lead solution architecture for Technology \& Innovation (R\&D) initiatives spanning custom development, infrastructure, hosting environments, cloud platforms, on\-premise systems, database transitions, and enterprise integrations.
* Design and document high\-quality solution design artefacts for a wide range of technology solutions, from infrastructure modernization to custom application builds.
* Architect cloud\-based and hybrid hosting environments (Azure preferred), including servers, networks, load balancing, security controls, and performance optimization.
* Support server moves, application re\-hosting, OS upgrades, lifecycle transitions and re\-platforming activities.
* Evaluate and design on\-premise architecture for solutions that require local hosting, regulatory compliance, or low\-latency demands.
* Lead database migration strategies, including SQL, Oracle, MySQL, NoSQL, and legacy database modernisation.
* Provide architectural guidance on integration patterns such as API\-led connectivity, microservices, ESB, event\-driven architectures, middleware, and GraphQL.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure solutions are delivered according to architectural standards and security\-by\-design principles.
* Identify technology gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities across existing environments.
* Lead or support technology pilots, hackathons, emerging\-technology experiments, and rapid prototyping for the Technology \& Innovation (R\&D) organisation.
* Act as Technical Design Authority (TDA) for assigned Technology \& Innovation (R\&D) projects.
* Ensure alignment with Convatec’s privacy, security, regulatory, and operational frameworks.
* Work with platform providers, hosting partners, and system integrators to understand product roadmaps, patterns, and best practices.
* Contribute to the future\-state architecture vision for Technology \& Innovation (R\&D) and broader enterprise technology domains.



  





**Note: Role based in Hyderabad, India** 




  





**Key Requirements** 



* Min 5 year's experience in related field of Technology \& Innovation; background in similar industry is highly preferred
* Broad solution architecture experience covering infrastructure, platforms, cloud, integration, and custom software development.
* Regulations and standards like HIPPA, etc.,
* Experience with on\-premise hosting, data centre operations, server migration planning, load balancing, failover, backup/DR and hybrid environments.
* Strong background in custom\-built software, including solution design, application architecture, and modern development frameworks.
* Experience with database migrations, optimizations, and cross\-platform transitions (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, etc.).
* Knowledge of enterprise integration including REST APIs, SOAP, GraphQL, messaging queues, ESB, middleware, event streaming.
* Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, and application modernization patterns.
* Experience writing HLA/HLD documentation that guides engineering teams through delivery.
* Strong communicator comfortable working with PMs, BAs, engineering leads, infrastructure
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and conducting POCs.



  





**Technical competencies** 



* Strong understanding of architecture modelling standards such as C4, ArchiMate, and system context modelling.
* Knowledge of Windows Server, Linux, containerisation, virtualisation (VMware, Hyper\-V, Azure VM), and networking fundamentals.
* Familiarity with scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python) to support automation and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of IT governance, compliance, security frameworks and operational standards.
* Good understanding of SDLC practices (Agile, DevOps, Waterfall) and the ability to work across them.



  





 At Convatec, we’re pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch. If you’re ready to make a real impact, apply today and help us bring our Forever Caring promise to life.
 



  





**Beware of scams online or from individuals claiming to represent Convatec** 




 A formal recruitment process is required for all our opportunities prior to any offer of employment. This will include an interview confirmed by an official Convatec email address.
 



 If you receive a suspicious approach over social media, text message, email or phone call about recruitment at Convatec, do not disclose any personal information or pay any fees whatsoever. If you’re unsure, please contact us at careers@Convatec.com.
 



  





**Equal opportunities** 




 Convatec provides equal employment opportunities for all current employees and applicants for employment. This policy means that no one will be discriminated against because of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, nationality, citizenship, ancestry, sex, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, genetic predisposing characteristics or any other basis prohibited by law.
 



  





**Notice to Agency and Search Firm Representatives** 




 Convatec is not accepting unsolicited resumes from agencies and/or search firms for this job posting. Resumes submitted to any Convatec employee by a third party agency and/or search firm without a valid written and signed search agreement, will become the sole property of Convatec. No fee will be paid if a candidate is hired for this position as a result of an unsolicited agency or search firm referral. Thank you.
 



  





**Already a Convatec employee?** 




**If you are an active employee at Convatec, please do not apply here. Go to the Career Worklet on your Workday home page and View "Convatec Internal Career Site \- Find Jobs". Thank you!** 




  





**About Convatec** 




**Pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch:** 




 Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company, focused on solutions for the management of chronic conditions, with leading positions in Advanced Wound Care, Ostomy Care, Continence Care, and Infusion Care. With over 10,000 colleagues, we provide products and services in around 90 countries, united by a promise to be forever caring. Our solutions provide a range of benefits, from infection prevention, treatment for hard to heal wounds, at\-risk skin and ulcerated tissue to supporting debilitating conditions, improved patient outcomes and reduced care costs. Convatec's revenues in 2025 were over $2 billion. The company is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index (LSE:CTEC). To learn more please visit: http://www.convatecgroup.com.

**UPTO ₹10 LAKH IN BONUSES** 




**Location \- Nashik, Maharashtra** 




**Years of Experience \- 7\-10 years (5\-6\+ in architecture or solutioning)** 




**Salary Range (Annual) \- 14\-20LPA** 




**Manages \- Tech Team** 




  





**About the Role** 




 You own the architecture of the multi\-tenant SaaS platform serving multiple verticals AND
 



 the AI agent layer (orchestration, tool execution, HITL approval architecture) AND the
 



 media\-engine infrastructure. You report to the Operations Manager. You lead a team of 3
 



 junior full\-stack developers and partner with the existing senior engineering talent on the
 



 team.
 



**What You'll Do** 




 • Set the architecture for the multi\-tenant SaaS platform (tenant isolation as a security boundary, not a filter)
 



 • Design the AI agent layer: orchestration, tool calling, context management, evaluation, HITL approval
 



 • Design the media\-engine infrastructure: multi\-agent pipelines, prompt versioning, automation workflows
 



 • Ship code yourself 30\-40% of the time (you set the bar by shipping, not by reviewing)
 



 • Run code review for 100% of the junior dev PRs
 



 • Hire, mentor, and develop the junior full\-stack developers
 



 • Set the engineering bar: AI\-native coding (Cursor / Claude Code / Copilot), shipping cadence, code review standards
 



 • Hold the production reliability bar: CI/CD, deploy reliability, platform uptime
 



**What We're Looking For (Must\-Have)** 




 • 5\-6\+ years of architecture or solutioning experience owning the technical direction of a product
 



 • Demonstrated depth in shipping production\-grade systems
 



 • Has shipped AI agent systems to production and knows where they fail (orchestration, tool calling, context management, evaluation)
 



 • Multi\-tenant SaaS expertise: tenant isolation as a security boundary
 



 • AI\-native coding: uses Cursor / Claude Code / Copilot daily
 



 • Cloud infrastructure at production scale (AWS: containers, managed databases, cost control)
 



 • Has led engineers and made them better
 



 • Ships first, refactors on the way
 



**What We're Looking For (Preferred)** 




 • Compliance\-constrained environments (HIPAA, PCI) and BYOC / on\-prem deployment
 



 • LLM evaluation and observability
 



 • Early\-stage startup experience (first engineering hire or founding engineer)
 



 • Productive in Node.js, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Prisma in week one (or transferable expertise in Python, Go, or Java)
 



**Who Excels in This Role** 




 • Takes ownership — treats the role as their own operation; ships the work end\-to\-end
 



 • Proactive — sees the next move before being asked; ships the fix and reports
 



 • Domain expert — has real, hands\-on depth in the discipline this role covers
 



 • Out\-of\-the\-box thinker — when the obvious move stops working, finds the non\-obvious one quickly
 



 • Performs under stress — triages and ships in real\-time when things break
 



**What Success Looks Like** 




 The team ships production code daily with high quality. The architecture scales to the next 10x without a rewrite. Junior developers ramp to owning features independently within 4\-6 months. The Operations Manager trusts your architectural decisions enough to step back from day\-to\-day

2cae3b60.title: GMx - Managed Services Solution Architect
2cae3b60.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Managed Services Solution Architect, Manager \- GMx Solutioning, Global Managed Services**
 At EY GDS – a member of the global integrated service delivery centre network by EY, Managed Services (MS) is a significant part of our business, comprising more than $7b in revenue with major clients across the globe. We help clients with people based, asset based \& integrated solutions, leveraging our deep sector and domain expertise to deliver enhanced value to our clients. In MS we are also ambitious, seeking to more than double our success in the future.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Global Managed Services at EY is entering a phase of accelerated growth, with increasing demand for integrated, multi\-tower managed services across Technology, Finance, Risk, and Data.
   

  

 As a
 **Technology Managed Services Solution Architect** 
 , you will play a central role in shaping and articulating differentiated managed services solutions. Beyond designing the solution, you will be responsible for ensuring the solution is
 **clearly understood, commercially compelling, and operationally credible** 
 to clients.
   

  

 You will work across global pursuit teams, collaborating with Sales, Delivery, Pricing, and domain solution leaders to bring together complex service offerings into a
 **cohesive, client\-ready narrative** 
 .
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Solution strategy and narrative development
+ Translate client requirements, business context, and evaluation criteria into a clear and structured solution storyline
+ Define the solution spine across technology managed services, ensuring alignment with client priorities such as stability, cost, transformation, and risk reduction
+ Develop compelling value propositions that connect service design to measurable business outcomes
+ Convert complex delivery constructs into simple, intuitive messaging for executive stakeholders

* End\-to\-end Tech Managed Services solution design
+ Design integrated Technology Managed Services solutions across applications, cloud, data, platforms, and service operations
+ Define scope, service catalogue, operating model, delivery model, governance, and continuous improvement approach
+ Incorporate automation, AI/GenAI, and platform\-led efficiencies into the solution
+ Ensure solution decisions are grounded in delivery feasibility, available data, and market competitiveness

* Articulation and client engagement
+ Actively participate in the Articulate phase of pursuits, contributing to proposal development, solution documentation, and oral presentations
+ Structure and communicate the solution across five dimensions: Client context, Design intent, Service operating model, Transition and stabilization approach and Value realization
+ Support or lead solution walkthroughs, workshops, and client discussions, ensuring clarity and confidence in the proposed model
+ Partner with Sales and deal leadership to ensure the client narrative and solution design remain aligned

* Transition, stabilization, and delivery model design
+ Design transition and onboarding strategies, including knowledge transfer, phased migration, and stabilization
+ Define early\-stage risk mitigation levers such as SWAT teams, command centre, and backlog reduction
+ Ensure transition plans are practical, sequenced, and aligned to client readiness
+ Support delivery teams in mobilization and early lifecycle stages

* Estimation and commercial input
+ Translate solution design into effort drivers, staffing models, and productivity assumptions
+ Work closely with Pricing teams to ensure commercial models reflect solution realities
+ Validate alignment between service commitments, SLAs, and cost structures
+ Highlight risks, contingencies, and dependencies that impact commercial viability

* Solution assurance and risk management
+ Identify and address risks across scope, delivery, transition, tooling, and governance
+ Ensure solution integrity across proposal content, pricing assumptions, and client messaging
+ Participate in solution reviews, challenge sessions, and leadership governance forums
+ Maintain clarity on assumptions, exclusions, and dependencies to avoid downstream risk


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Ability to translate complex managed services solutions into clear, client\-relevant narratives
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end Managed Services lifecycle (pursuit to steady state)
* Experience aligning delivery reality with client\-facing messaging
* Structured thinking with the ability to connect business outcomes, service design, and commercial models
* Confidence to engage and influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Delivery, and domain teams
* Strong collaboration skills to work across global, multi\-disciplinary pursuit teams
* Comfort operating in ambiguous, multi\-owner environments and driving alignment


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 10\+ years of experience in Technology Managed Services, Application Management, or TechOps
* Proven experience in solutioning and/or leading complex managed services pursuits
* Hands\-on experience in one or more areas:
+ Enterprise applications (SAP, ServiceNow, MS Dynamics, Guidewire, etc.)
+ Cloud and platform operations
+ Data and analytics platforms
+ Service management and ITSM environments (e.g., ServiceNow)

* Experience working across multi\-tower or integrated managed services deals
* Strong exposure to transition, service delivery, and operating model design


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience participating in or leading solution articulation, proposals, or orals
* Understanding of integrated business and technology managed services models
* Familiarity with commercial constructs and pricing drivers in managed services
* Exposure to design thinking, structured problem solving, or agile ways of working
* Architecture or service management certifications (e.g., TOGAF, ITIL)


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the you may aspire to become.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

iLO Platform Firmware Architect  



This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



**Compute at HPE** helps organizations power their edge\-to\-cloud platform with proven, workload\-optimized products, solutions, and services. Our leading supercomputing technologies enable customers to transform and modernize their IT infrastructure, solve complex problems and support new business opportunities with purpose\-built infrastructure and software. Join us redefine what’s next for you.


Seeking **Senior** **Software Engineer** to work on HPE iLO (Integrated Lights Out) server management solution specifically focused on iLO platform enablement areas.

**HPE Integrated Lights Out Management** is a flagship product in server industry leading embedded server manager for decades. It’s one of the most profitable HPE product raking millions through its licensing revenue. iLO supports the complete lifecycle of all HPE ProLiant servers, from initial deployment to ongoing management and service alerting. As part of the Hewlett Packard Enterprise Servers group, this team is responsible for designing and developing iLO manageability firmware.

**What you’ll do:**

***Management Level Definition:***


Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross\-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.

***Responsibilities:***

* Designs enhancements, updates, and programming changes for portions and subsystems of firmware, including DSP, embedded code, CHIF, I2C, SPI drivers, BMC applications and BIOS/UEFI.
* Leads multiple project teams of other software systems engineers and internal and outsourced development partners responsible for all stages of design and development for complex products and platforms, including solution design, analysis, coding, testing, and integration.
* Manages and expands relationships with internal and outsourced development partners on software systems design and development.
* Reviews and evaluates designs and project activities for compliance with systems design and development guidelines and standards; provides tangible feedback to improve product quality and mitigate failure risk.
* Provides domain\-specific expertise and overall software systems leadership and perspective to cross\-organization projects, programs, and activities.
* Drives innovation and integration of new technologies into projects and activities in the software systems design organization.
* Provides guidance and mentoring to less\- experienced staff members.

**What you need to bring:**

***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
* Typically, 10\+ years' experience.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

e9544f94.title: Specialist – Presales
e9544f94.description:
As a Presales Solution Architect at Ingram Micro, you'll be more than just a technical expert — you'll be a trusted advisor to our partners, guiding them through the journey of adopting cloud services. Your primary focus will be to identify, develop, and close opportunities by working closely with our sales and marketing teams and applying your technical consulting and solutioning\-led skills.
   

  

 You'll engage with partners and end customers at various levels, from decision\-makers to technical teams, ensuring they understand the value of Google’s cloud solutions. By aligning their needs with our solutions, you'll drive the transition from traditional models to cloud\-managed services, driving to multi\-year subscription buy\-ins. By sharing best practices and insights, you'll contribute to the continuous improvement of our services.
   

  

 Your contributions will be instrumental in the successful materialization of the sales opportunities, upselling, thereby contributing to the revenue.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Participate in pre\-sales activities, including solutioning, cost estimation, proposal presentations, and partner enablement sessions.
* Should be able to work independently on the Presales RFP/RFI to build solution proposals.
* Drive modernization initiatives leveraging a broad range of GCP services to improve performance and efficiency (conduct in\-depth application and infrastructure assessments and define modernization and migration paths).
* Architect solutions on GCP based cloud infrastructure, modernization of legacy applications to cloud\-native architectures.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to articulate solution concepts and influence teams.
* Mentor partner engineering team and enforce best practices.
* Working closely with the sales team to qualify leads, present the solution effectively, answer technical questions, accompany the sales team to customer/partner locations across India (need basis) for partner/customer meetings, and represent Ingram Micro at various events/workshops.


**Skills:**
* Strong working experience in Presales with a focus on Google’s GCP (Google Cloud Platform),
* Compute: Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, App Engine, Cloud Functions
* Networking: VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud CDN, Cloud Interconnect, Cloud Armor.
* Database \& Storage: AlloyDB, Cloud SQL, Spanner for relational workloads. Firestore, Bigtable for NoSQL applications
* Security \& IAM: Organization policies, IAM, Secret Manager, Certificate Manager, Security Command Center
* Operations: Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Error Reporting, Cloud Trace.


**Technical Skills:**
* Proven experience with Google infra, GKE, Terraform, Observability, CI/CD, Databases, and modernization projects.
* Strong expertise in Google Cloud Infrastructure and product solutions, and services.
* Hands\-on experience with GKE, Terraform, and CI/CD tools.
* Demonstrated success in legacy system migration and cloud modernization (VMs Workload \& Database modernization (SQL Server to PostgreSQL/AlloyDB).
* Knowledge of observability frameworks (e.g., Prometheus and Grafana).
* Good understanding of networking, security, and cloud\-native architectures
* Strong expertise Knowledge of security best practices in cloud and distributed systems.
* Multi\-cloud architectures with Cross\-Cloud Interconnect
* Exposure to Generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* Strong logical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in English (written and spoken).

 Minimum 4 to 5 years focused on Google’s cloud/hybrid cloud, infrastructure modernization, or managed services.

a9f18af6.title: Senior Digital Solutions Consultant (Solution Architect)
a9f18af6.description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**Purpose :**

Worley is seeking an experienced Solution Architect to define and deliver integrated digital, OT, IT, data, application, infrastructure, integration, and security architectures for major industrial programs. The role will translate business and operational objectives into practical solution designs, architecture artefacts, integration models, and implementation\-ready guidance supporting procurement, vendor assessment, FEED delivery, and project execution. The ideal candidate will bring strong architecture capability, practical IT/OT integration experience, cybersecurity\-by\-design awareness, and the ability to align client, engineering, vendor, and delivery stakeholders around secure, scalable, and operationally maintainable outcomes.


**The Role*****As a Senior Digital Solutions Consultant with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.


* Develop solution architectures across technology, application, data, integration, infrastructure, OT, IT, and security domains, ensuring alignment with client reference models and delivery\-phase requirements.
* Translate enterprise architecture, business objectives, and operational requirements into actionable solution designs that guide procurement, vendor assessment, implementation planning, and project execution.
* Produce implementation\-focused architecture artefacts, including system context diagrams, logical and physical architecture views, integration models, infrastructure deployment views, network segmentation concepts, platform deployment views, application interface definitions, and architecture decision records.
* Define integration and interoperability models across industrial levels 1\-4, including OT/IT convergence, edge/cloud hybrid deployments, data exchange patterns, secure connectivity, and segmented network architectures.
* Apply architecture governance to ensure solutions meet client standards, engineering requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable industrial frameworks such as IEC 62443, ISA\-95, OPC UA, MQTT, and other relevant integration patterns.
* Collaborate with internal and client\-side stakeholders, including OT, IT, cybersecurity, telecommunications, control systems, digital, operations, project delivery, vendors, and system integrators, to gather requirements, validate assumptions, and coordinate architecture inputs.
* Support traceability of business, operational, functional, non\-functional, and technical requirements through architecture artefacts and requirements management tools.
* Assess vendor and system integrator solutions for functional alignment, technical feasibility, interoperability, cybersecurity, maintainability, scalability, and lifecycle suitability.
* Contribute to risk assessments, cost\-benefit analysis, project option selection, transition planning, and FEED\-to\-delivery handover.
* Support design reviews, workshops, procurement packages, tender responses, implementation planning, and executive\-level technical briefings.

**Additional Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to multidisciplinary teams while maintaining alignment with project governance, quality, safety, and delivery assurance processes.
* Identify architecture risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and decisions, and support their resolution through structured engagement with stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of emerging industrial digital, OT networking, cybersecurity, cloud, edge, data, and automation technologies and apply them pragmatically where they provide measurable client value.

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* Deep experience in solution architecture across technology, application, data, integration, infrastructure, and security domains.
* Strong understanding of OT and IT networking technologies, including segmented networks, SDN, SD\-WAN, MPLS, hosting services, cloud networks, secure remote access, and IT/OT convergence strategies.
* Knowledge of industrial automation and control systems architectures, including fixed and wireless networks, telemetry, SCADA, PLCs, DCS, historians, edge systems, and the transport of critical production data.
* Experience developing high\-fidelity architecture artefacts that support system procurement, design validation, implementation planning, and stakeholder decision\-making.
* Practical understanding of IT/OT system interoperability in mining, resources, utilities, oil and gas, or other large\-scale industrial programs.
* Knowledge of integration patterns and protocols such as OPC UA, MQTT, API gateways, message brokers, industrial data platforms, and secure data exchange across OT and enterprise environments.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity\-by\-design principles, including network segmentation, Zero Trust concepts, defence\-in\-depth, access control, secure interfaces, and industrial cybersecurity standards.
* Ability to align diverse technical stakeholders through structured architecture methods, workshops, design reviews, decision records, and clear visual communication.
* Experience in hybrid cloud\-edge deployments, remote operations concepts, platform orchestration, digital integration, and secure connectivity for operational environments.
* Ability to support cost, risk, schedule, procurement, vendor, and delivery decisions with architecture\-led evidence and traceability.

**Other Qualifications:**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Control Systems, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 10\-15 years of relevant experience in solution architecture, systems architecture, digital architecture, OT/IT architecture, or industrial technology architecture within mining, resources, energy, utilities, oil and gas, or large\-scale industrial environments.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business, operational, and engineering requirements into practical, implementable architecture solutions.
* Experience producing architecture artefacts, architecture decisions, technical assessments, solution options, system interface definitions, and implementation\-supporting documentation.
* Experience collaborating with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, OT, IT, telecommunications, control systems, digital, operations, vendor, and project delivery teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architecture concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of project delivery lifecycles from concept and FEED through detailed design, implementation support, commissioning, and handover.
* Architecture certifications such as TOGAF, SABSA, ArchiMate, Azure/AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent practical credentials.
* Network, cybersecurity, or OT credentials such as CCNP, IEC 62443 Foundation/Practitioner, CISSP, GICSP, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with architecture modelling, requirements traceability, and portfolio tools such as Orbus Infinity, ArchiMate\-based tooling, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with industrial digital platforms, data platforms, edge computing, cloud integration, remote operations, autonomous systems, and critical communications environments.
* Experience supporting procurement, vendor assessment, RFP/RFQ development, technical bid evaluation, and implementation transition planning.
* Structured, pragmatic, and outcome\-focused, with the ability to navigate technical ambiguity and convert complex requirements into clear architecture direction.
* Able to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and maintain accuracy and attention to detail in complex, multidisciplinary delivery environments.
* Strong relationship\-building skills with clients, vendors, peers, senior management, executives, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Able to protect sensitive, proprietary, security\-related, and commercially confidential information.
* Proactive, service\-minded, collaborative, and willing to challenge assumptions constructively to improve client and project outcomes.
* Committed to quality, safety, operational reliability, sustainability, and Worley values.

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.


And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

17f01026.description:
**Entity**
 Technology
   

  

**Job Family Group**
 IT\&S Group
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a hands\-on System Architect (10–12\+ years) who can design, build, and deliver scalable enterprise solutions. This role goes beyond governance, requiring deep involvement in implementation, integration, and problem\-solving across SaaS, non\-SaaS, AI, and web service ecosystems, working closely with engineering teams to deliver secure, high\-performance solutions.
   

  

 As the lead Architect for a number of areas including People \& Culture, this role will define and drive the technology architecture strategy for the HR domain, ensuring alignment with business priorities, enterprise architecture standards, and future workforce transformation needs. **Required Skills \& Experience**

* Extensive experience architecting and delivering enterprise HR technology solutions, including platforms such as Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Cornerstone, Eightfold, HiredScore, or equivalent HR ecosystems.

 Preferred Certifications: TOGAF, Cloud Architect (AWS/Azure/GCP), MuleSoft/Boomi. TOGAF certification or equivalent architecture qualification strongly preferred.

Artificial Intelligence Cloud Storage

Bachelor of Technology (BTech)
  
**Job Description**
-------------------


Job Purpose


Lead the overall Solutions and Presales function across Cloud, AI and Managed Services, providing strategic and technical leadership for enterprise and government customer engagements.


The role will own the end\-to\-end solutioning lifecycle from customer requirement discovery and solution strategy through architecture, proposal, commercials, technical validation and transition to delivery. Roles \& Responsibilities


**1\. Solutions Strategy \& Leadership**


* Own and lead the overall solutioning strategy across **Cloud, AI/GPU and Managed Services**.
* Establish common solution architecture, design and governance standards across the three solution domains.
* Develop differentiated and repeatable solution frameworks, reference architectures, service models and solution blueprints.
* Align solution capabilities with business strategy, market opportunities, customer requirements and revenue objectives.
* Drive continuous innovation across cloud\-native, AI, automation, observability, security and managed services.

**2\. Enterprise Solution Architecture**


* Provide executive\-level architectural leadership for complex, large\-scale enterprise and government opportunities.
* Lead development of end\-to\-end solutions spanning **compute, storage, networking, cloud, AI/GPU infrastructure, security, backup/DR, observability and managed services****.**
* Ensure integration of public, private, hybrid and sovereign cloud environments.
* Define architecture principles covering scalability, performance, security, compliance, availability and cost optimization.
* Review and approve solution architectures, BoQs, technical designs and major proposals.

**3\. AI \& GPU Solution Leadership**


* Lead AI Cloud and AI Factory solutioning covering GPU infrastructure, HPC, high\-performance networking and AI platforms.
* Provide oversight on GPU sizing, workload architecture, distributed training/inference, Kubernetes, Slurm, InfiniBand/RoCE and high\-performance storage.
* Guide architecture for GenAI, RAG, agentic AI and enterprise AI workloads.
* Drive adoption of emerging NVIDIA and other accelerator technologies and establish reusable AI reference architectures.
* Ensure AI solutions address performance, utilization, scalability, data sovereignty and commercial viability.
   

The underlying AI Architect JD specifically covers NVIDIA GPU clusters, InfiniBand/RoCE, GPU/CPU/memory/NVMe sizing, Kubernetes/Kubeflow, Slurm, vLLM/Triton/TensorRT\-LLM and RAG/agentic AI.

**4\. Managed Services Solution Leadership**


* Own the solutioning strategy for managed infrastructure, cloud operations, security, network, backup/DR, SOC/NOC, observability, automation and ITSM services.
* Define service catalog, SLA/KPI frameworks, operating models and transition approaches.
* Ensure managed services solutions are aligned with customer business outcomes, operational feasibility and commercial objectives.
* Establish strong solution\-to\-delivery governance and ensure effective transition of won engagements.
   

The existing Managed Services JD emphasizes requirement discovery, service design, RFP/RFI responses, SLA/KPI mapping, pricing, customer value and pre\-sales\-to\-delivery transition.

**5\. Customer \& CXO Engagement**


* Act as the senior technology and solutioning interface for strategic customers and CXO stakeholders.
* Lead discovery workshops, solution presentations, technical negotiations, PoCs and executive\-level discussions.
* Translate complex technology capabilities into clear business value, ROI, risk and transformation outcomes.
* Build trusted\-advisor relationships with enterprise and government customers.

**6\. Pre\-Sales \& Business Enablement**


* Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to identify, qualify and shape strategic opportunities.
* Lead solution strategy for large RFP/RFI, tenders and strategic bids.
* Ensure high\-quality technical proposals, BoQs, SOWs, solution narratives and presentations.
* Drive solution competitiveness through differentiated architecture, service models and commercial constructs.
* Support deal strategy, technical negotiations and closure of strategic opportunities.

**7\. Commercial \& Business Case Ownership**


* Provide leadership on solution costing, pricing assumptions, capacity models and business cases.
* Ensure solutions balance technical excellence with commercial viability and target margins.
* Review major BoQs, partner/OEM proposals and commercial assumptions.
* Identify opportunities for standardization, reuse and optimization to improve solution profitability.

**8\. Technology Partners \& OEM Ecosystem**


* Build and manage strategic relationships with cloud, AI, infrastructure, security and managed services technology partners.
* Work with OEMs to develop joint reference architectures, solution offerings and GTM propositions.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and determine their relevance to the solution portfolio.
* Drive partner enablement and technical competency development across the solutions team.

**9\. Solution Governance \& Quality**


* Establish architecture and solution review mechanisms for strategic and complex opportunities.
* Ensure adherence to security, compliance, data sovereignty and regulatory requirements.
* Drive standardization of solution documentation, architecture reviews, costing models and handover processes.
* Ensure alignment between proposed solutions, available platform capabilities and delivery readiness.

**10\. Team Leadership \& Capability Building**


* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary solutions organization covering Cloud, AI/GPU and Managed Services.
* Define competency frameworks, role structures, KPIs and career paths for solution architects and specialists.
* Build a culture of technical excellence, customer centricity, collaboration and ownership.
* Mentor senior architects and develop future solution leaders.
* Create cross\-functional collaboration between Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Security and Delivery teams.

**Educational Qualifications**


BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication


**Relevant Experience**


* Experience: 15\-20 years of overall IT experience, with a minimum of 3 years in GPU cloud architecture and design roles.
* Cloud Infrastructure Expertise: Proven track record in the design, operations, and maintenance of public/private cloud platforms, including service migration from on\-premises to cloud or between enterprise data centers.
* Result\-Oriented with Security Focus: Strong background in IT networking and cloud security, with the ability to address complex business needs in global, enterprise\-scale environments.
* Deep knowledge of Azure, AWS, and GCP services, including native security controls, security centers, DDoS protection, firewalls, express route/direct connect, storage solutions, CDN, and site recovery.
* Proficiency with containerization and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms and tools such as, AWS EC2, AWS GuardDuty, AWS KMS, CloudWatch, AWS Lambda, and other modern cloud\-native services.
* Private Cloud Technologies: Experience in OpenStack, VMware, Nutanix, and Kubernetes\-based private cloud platforms, along with SaaS integration.
* Multi\-Cloud \& Hybrid Cloud: Skilled in design, deployment, and maintenance of hybrid/multi\-cloud architectures with seamless connectivity and governance.
* Cloud Migration \& Consulting: Strong expertise in cloud migration strategy, execution, and advisory consulting for enterprise clients.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and presentation skills with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.
* Compliance \& Identity Management: Experience in cloud networking, IAM (Identity \& Access Management), governance, and compliance frameworks (ISO, PCI\-DSS, DPDP, etc.)

 **Required Skills:**

* **Location** *: Hyderabad*

Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and **third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally** .


Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by **making self\-care as simple as it should be** . For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.


At the core of this mission is our **100 loved brands** , our **11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites** and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.


**B Corp certified in multiple markets** , we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com .


About the job:


We are looking for a Customer MDM Architect with Delivery Management responsibilities to lead the design, implementation, and evolution of our global Customer Master Data platform.


This role combines deep hands\-on expertise in Informatica IDMC Customer 360 SaaS solution with strong delivery leadership capabilities. You will be accountable for both:


Designing and governing the Customer MDM architecture


Orchestrating end\-to\-end agile delivery across countries, upstream/downstream systems, and stakeholders


Our technology stack is based on Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (Customer 360 SaaS) \+ Snowflake/Databricks.


You will play a critical role in ensuring high\-quality, governed, scalable, and business\-aligned customer master data capabilities that enable global growth and enhanced customer experience.


Main responsibilities:


1\. **MDM Architecture \& Solution Design**

Own and evolve the end\-to\-end Customer MDM architecture landscape


Design and implement scalable solutions using Informatica Customer 360 SaaS


Drive the design and implementation of the MDM solution (Informatica SaaS MDM) which will be a key enabler for our global expansion and for enhancing customer experience.


Define and help maintain Customer data models, hierarchies, and reference data structures


Design ingress and egress mechanisms (batch and API\-based integrations)


Define match \& merge logic, survivorship rules, and performance optimization strategies


Ensure seamless integration between MDM, Snowflake/Databricks, and upstream/downstream systems


Define data synchronization and replication mechanisms


Maintain master data dictionaries and metadata documentation


Define testing strategies (batch \& real\-time ingestion)


Monitor performance, scalability, and platform optimization


Analyze existing data structures, systems, and processes to identify data management gaps and opportunities for improvement


Maintain and document the end\-to\-end MDM landscape architecture, including integrations, data flows, and system dependencies (high\-level \+ detail view)


2\. **Data Governance \& Data Quality**

Ensure alignment with enterprise Data Governance policies


Define and implement data quality rules and monitoring frameworks with the help of the DG team


Perform data profiling, cleansing, deduplication, and standardization


Implement and optimize match \& merge strategies


Define KPIs to monitor data quality and governance effectiveness


Collaborate with Data Stewards, Domain Owners, and Governance bodies


Produce data quality dashboards and trend reports


Implement security and access controls for sensitive master data


3\. **Delivery Management \& Agile Orchestration**

Act as the Delivery Lead for the Customer MDM area:


Drive stakeholder alignment and business adoption across countries


Own scope, risks, dependencies, and issue management


Help orchestrate agile ceremonies and sprint execution


Prioritize and manage backlog (user stories, L3 tickets, enhancements)


Help ensure structured coordination between:


Upstream systems


Downstream applications


Data owners Business teams


Countries


Coordinate development, testing, cutover, hypercare, and knowledge transfer


Manage integration dependencies and cross\-system impacts


Ensure structured documentation, RACI definition, and status reporting


Support onboarding, training materials, and change management activities


Resolve blockers and ensure smooth sprint execution


4\. **Stakeholder Leadership \& Communication**

Conduct workshops and stakeholder interviews to gather and analyze business and technical requirements for Informatica Customer 360 SaaS implementations


Translate business needs into scalable MDM solutions


Support business case evolution and roadmap definition


Provide technical mentorship to team members


Communicate architecture decisions and trade\-offs clearly


Drive adoption through structured communication and enablement


About you:


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field


10\+ years of hands\-on experience in Master Data Management with 3\+ years of Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS solution, with at least \+3 years managing teams and delivering successful MDM implementations


Proven experience with:


Informatica IDMC Customer 360 SaaS / Multidomain MDM


Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS)


Informatica Reference 360 (strong plus)


Strong experience integrating MDM with Snowflake/Databricks or enterprise DWH platforms


Deep understanding of:


Customer data models


Match \& Merge strategies


Data governance frameworks


Data quality methodologies


Experience in defining and implementing MDM solution architectures


Strong knowledge of batch and API\-based integration patterns


Experience with Power BI or equivalent reporting tools (plus)


Experience leading agile delivery in complex, multi\-country environments


Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills


Certifications in Informatica MDM (Developer / Administrator) are a plus.


Key Competencies


Strategic thinker with hands\-on technical depth


Strong ownership and accountability mindset


Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills


Ability to balance governance rigor with business agility


Strong communication skills across business and technical audiences


Comfortable operating in complex, multi\-system environments


Structured, organized, and delivery\-oriented


What Success Looks Like


High\-quality, trusted Customer Master Data adopted across countries


Stable and scalable MDM architecture aligned with enterprise data strategy


On\-time and predictable delivery execution


Clear governance, documented architecture, and measurable data quality improvements


Strong collaboration between IT, business, governance, and operationsWhy us?

We are dedicated to making self\-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:

6d0e3d9b.title: Head AI Cloud Solution Architect
6d0e3d9b.description:
**Job Purpose**
 Lead the overall Solutions and Presales function across Cloud, AI and Managed Services, providing strategic and technical leadership for enterprise and government customer engagements.
   

  

 The role will own the end\-to\-end solutioning lifecycle from customer requirement discovery and solution strategy through architecture, proposal, commercials, technical validation and transition to delivery. The position will establish a unified solutioning framework across Cloud Infrastructure, AI/GPU Platforms and Managed Services, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, commercially viable and aligned with the business strategy
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Solutions Strategy \& Leadership
* Own and lead the overall solutioning strategy across Cloud, AI/GPU and Managed Services .
* Establish common solution architecture, design and governance standards across the three solution domains.
* Develop differentiated and repeatable solution frameworks, reference architectures, service models and solution blueprints.
* Align solution capabilities with business strategy, market opportunities, customer requirements and revenue objectives.
* Drive continuous innovation across cloud\-native, AI, automation, observability, security and managed services.
* Enterprise Solution Architecture
* Provide executive\-level architectural leadership for complex, large\-scale enterprise and government opportunities.
* Lead development of end\-to\-end solutions spanning compute, storage, networking, cloud, AI/GPU infrastructure, security, backup/DR, observability and managed services .
* Ensure integration of public, private, hybrid and sovereign cloud environments.
* Define architecture principles covering scalability, performance, security, compliance, availability and cost optimization.
* Review and approve solution architectures, BoQs, technical designs and major proposals.
* AI \& GPU Solution Leadership
* Lead AI Cloud and AI Factory solutioning covering GPU infrastructure, HPC, high\-performance networking and AI platforms.
* Provide oversight on GPU sizing, workload architecture, distributed training/inference, Kubernetes, Slurm, InfiniBand/RoCE and high\-performance storage.
* Guide architecture for GenAI, RAG, agentic AI and enterprise AI workloads.
* Drive adoption of emerging NVIDIA and other accelerator technologies and establish reusable AI reference architectures.
* Ensure AI solutions address performance, utilization, scalability, data sovereignty and commercial viability. The underlying AI Architect JD specifically covers NVIDIA GPU clusters, InfiniBand/RoCE, GPU/CPU/memory/NVMe sizing, Kubernetes/Kubeflow, Slurm, vLLM/Triton/TensorRT\-LLM and RAG/agentic AI.
* Managed Services Solution Leadership
* Own the solutioning strategy for managed infrastructure, cloud operations, security, network, backup/DR, SOC/NOC, observability, automation and ITSM services.
* Define service catalog, SLA/KPI frameworks, operating models and transition approaches.
* Ensure managed services solutions are aligned with customer business outcomes, operational feasibility and commercial objectives.
* Establish strong solution\-to\-delivery governance and ensure effective transition of won engagements. The existing Managed Services JD emphasizes requirement discovery, service design, RFP/RFI responses, SLA/KPI mapping, pricing, customer value and pre\-sales\-to\-delivery transition.
* Customer \& CXO Engagement
* Act as the senior technology and solutioning interface for strategic customers and CXO stakeholders.
* Lead discovery workshops, solution presentations, technical negotiations, PoCs and executive\-level discussions.
* Translate complex technology capabilities into clear business value, ROI, risk and transformation outcomes.
* Build trusted\-advisor relationships with enterprise and government customers.
* Pre\-Sales \& Business Enablement
* Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to identify, qualify and shape strategic opportunities.
* Lead solution strategy for large RFP/RFI, tenders and strategic bids.
* Ensure high\-quality technical proposals, BoQs, SOWs, solution narratives and presentations.
* Drive solution competitiveness through differentiated architecture, service models and commercial constructs.
* Support deal strategy, technical negotiations and closure of strategic opportunities.
* Commercial \& Business Case Ownership
* Provide leadership on solution costing, pricing assumptions, capacity models and business cases.
* Ensure solutions balance technical excellence with commercial viability and target margins.
* Review major BoQs, partner/OEM proposals and commercial assumptions.
* Identify opportunities for standardization, reuse and optimization to improve solution profitability.
* Technology Partners \& OEM Ecosystem
* Build and manage strategic relationships with cloud, AI, infrastructure, security and managed services technology partners.
* Work with OEMs to develop joint reference architectures, solution offerings and GTM propositions.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and determine their relevance to the solution portfolio.
* Drive partner enablement and technical competency development across the solutions team.
* Solution Governance \& Quality
* Establish architecture and solution review mechanisms for strategic and complex opportunities.
* Ensure adherence to security, compliance, data sovereignty and regulatory requirements.
* Drive standardization of solution documentation, architecture reviews, costing models and handover processes.
* Ensure alignment between proposed solutions, available platform capabilities and delivery readiness.
* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary solutions organization covering Cloud, AI/GPU and Managed Services.
* Define competency frameworks, role structures, KPIs and career paths for solution architects and specialists.
* Build a culture of technical excellence, customer centricity, collaboration and ownership.
* Mentor senior architects and develop future solution leaders.
* Create cross\-functional collaboration between Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Security and Delivery teams.


**Educational Qualifications**
 BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication
   

  

**Relevant Experience**
* Experience: 15\-20 years of overall IT experience, with a minimum of 3 years in GPU cloud architecture and design roles.
* Cloud Infrastructure Expertise: Proven track record in the design, operations, and maintenance of public/private cloud platforms, including service migration from on\-premises to cloud or between enterprise data centers.
* Result\-Oriented with Security Focus: Strong background in IT networking and cloud security, with the ability to address complex business needs in global, enterprise\-scale environments.
* Deep knowledge of Azure, AWS, and GCP services, including native security controls, security centers, DDoS protection, firewalls, express route/direct connect, storage solutions, CDN, and site recovery.
* Proficiency with containerization and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms and tools such as, AWS EC2, AWS GuardDuty, AWS KMS, CloudWatch, AWS Lambda, and other modern cloud\-native services.
* Private Cloud Technologies: Experience in OpenStack, VMware, Nutanix, and Kubernetes\-based private cloud platforms, along with SaaS integration.
* Multi\-Cloud \& Hybrid Cloud: Skilled in design, deployment, and maintenance of hybrid/multi\-cloud architectures with seamless connectivity and governance.
* Cloud Migration \& Consulting: Strong expertise in cloud migration strategy, execution, and advisory consulting for enterprise clients.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and presentation skills with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.
* Compliance \& Identity Management: Experience in cloud networking, IAM (Identity \& Access Management), governance, and compliance frameworks (ISO, PCI\-DSS, DPDP, etc.)

25d9f178.title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
25d9f178.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Migration Strategy: Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**
 In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.
