6a56f19e.title: Cloud Operations Engineer
6a56f19e.description:
**About Neo4j**
 Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise\-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy\-to\-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
   

  

 Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
   

  

 As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
   

  

**The Role**
 A Cloud Operations Engineer is comfortable troubleshooting server \& database technical issues and can reliably manage and monitor the customer’s Neo4j database environment, taking a holistic view of the health of the environment, to maximize the application and infrastructure uptime.
   

  

 This role is instrumental in ensuring our customers are successfully deploying and managing Neo4j in their production environments. It is well suited to an individual with strong technical skills who enjoys solving problems as much as collaborating directly with customers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Participate in the On\-Call rotation, as a member of the Cloud Managed Services team, and respond to incidents that impact Neo4j cloud infrastructure availability to provide the necessary support for customer cases.
* Work as a member of the Cloud Managed Services Team during business hours, with occasional off\-hours scheduled work, to support and manage the Neo4j database infrastructure of the customers and handle and resolve escalations related to cloud hosted environments from customers and/or internal teams.
* Improve, document, and automate operational processes (such as deployments and upgrades) to make them as efficient as possible.
* Gather and analyze metrics from operating systems as well as Neo4j databases to assist in performance tuning and incident diagnostics.
* Document the incidents, procedures, and outcomes of customer communications. Assist in building the Cloud Managed Services knowledge base.
* Install and upgrade Neo4j infrastructure (servers, storage, databases) for our Cloud Managed Service customers.
* Troubleshoot cluster issues across multiple servers, data centers and regions, in a variety of clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), virtual, and bare metal environments.
* Collaborate and communicate effectively within Customers, Customer Success, Product Engineering, and other Neo4j teams to understand and resolve customer issues completely and expediently.
* Proactive approach to identifying problems, performance bottlenecks, and areas for improvement is necessary to succeed in this position.


**Job Requirements And Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of cloud infrastructure administrator experience is required.
* Bachelor's or equivalent work experience degree in Computer Science or Computing Systems equivalent field. Background in math will be a plus.
* Experience working with Linux operating systems such as RedHat / CentOS / Amazon Linux is required.
* Significant prior experience with at least one of the Big 3 Cloud providers (AWS/GCP/Azure) is required.
* Must have command\-level fluency in Linux environments.
* Familiarity with Linux / Windows diagnostics and tuning will be a plus.
* Experience with Ansible, Terraform, and Kubernetes is desirable.
* Experience working with Nagios and Prometheus is desirable.
* Neo4j Certified Professional certification is desirable.
* Must be proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Applications (Outlook / Word / Excel).
* Must be detail oriented, collaborate well with other team members, have excellent verbal and communication skills, and thrive in a fast paced, high\-energy, multi\-tasking environment.

**Role description**  

Job Role : Service Delivery Manager, End User Services (Chennai, India) Role Overview :



The Service Delivery Manager – End User Services (EUS) will be responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery, governance, performance, and continuous improvement of Digital Workplace and End User Computing services.



The role will act as the primary interface between the client, delivery teams, technology teams, and third\-party providers, ensuring services are delivered in line with agreed SLAs, XLAs, security requirements, and business expectations.



The successful candidate should have strong service delivery leadership experience combined with a solid understanding of modern endpoint management, Digital Employee Experience (DEX), device lifecycle management, and workplace technologies including Microsoft Intune, Nexthink, SysTrack, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Windows, Autopilot, SCCM/MECM, and related EUC platforms.



Key Roles and Responsibilities:



Service Delivery \& Operations Management


* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of End User Services, ensuring services meet agreed SLAs, KPIs, XLAs, contractual commitments, and customer expectations.


* Manage operational performance across Service Desk, Desktop Support, Endpoint Management, Digital Workplace, VDI and associated EUS services.


* Conduct daily operational reviews and regular weekly/monthly service reviews with delivery teams and client stakeholders.


* Monitor incidents, service requests, problems, changes and major incidents affecting end\-user services and drive timely resolution.


* Ensure effective Major Incident Management for high\-impact workplace issues and coordinate technical teams, vendors and business stakeholders.


* Review service performance trends and proactively identify risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities.


* Own service improvement plans for areas where performance falls below agreed targets.


* Ensure appropriate operational documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles and support processes are maintained. Digital Workplace \& Endpoint Management



• Provide service delivery oversight for endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune and SCCM/MECM, including device enrolment, configuration, application deployment, patching and compliance. • Understand and oversee Windows Autopilot and modern device provisioning processes covering device build, enrolment and user onboarding.


* Support the implementation and operational governance of modern endpoint management and cloud\-based workplace strategies.


* Ensure endpoint security and compliance policies are effectively implemented and monitored in collaboration with Security and IAM teams.


* Coordinate Windows OS upgrades, application deployments, patching campaigns and endpoint remediation activities.


* Oversee device lifecycle processes covering procurement, provisioning, deployment, refresh, replacement and decommissioning. Digital Employee Experience – Nexthink \& SysTrack


* Drive adoption of Nexthink, SysTrack or similar Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platforms to improve visibility into endpoint health and user experience.


* Use DEX analytics to identify performance degradation, application issues, device health problems and recurring user\-impacting issues.


* Establish proactive monitoring and remediation processes to identify issues before they generate service desk incidents.


* Develop DEX dashboards and reporting to measure endpoint performance, user experience and service effectiveness.


* Identify opportunities for automated remediation and self\-healing using Nexthink, SysTrack, Intune, PowerShell or other automation platforms.


* Support the transition from traditional SLA\-based service measurement toward Experience Level Agreements (XLAs) and employee experience metrics.


* Translate technical DEX data into meaningful business insights and improvement initiatives. Service Desk \& End User Support


* Provide governance and oversight of Service Desk, Desktop Support and Field Support operations.


* Drive improvements in First Contact Resolution (FCR), Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR), customer satisfaction and ticket reduction.


* Analyse incident and request trends to identify opportunities for shift\-left, self\-service, automation and knowledge management.


* Ensure effective escalation management between L1, L2, L3, infrastructure, application and security teams.


* Improve self\-service capabilities through knowledge bases, automation, virtual agents and employee experience platforms.


* Work with technical teams to reduce avoidable incidents and improve overall workplace reliability. Microsoft 365 \& Modern Workplace


* Maintain a good working understanding of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem including Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Exchange Online and Microsoft 365 Apps.


* Coordinate with Microsoft 365 engineering teams to resolve service\-impacting issues and deliver workplace improvements.


* Understand identity and access dependencies involving Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access and device compliance.


* Support adoption and operationalisation of new Microsoft 365 and Modern Workplace capabilities. Service Governance \& Client Management


* Act as the primary service delivery contact for client stakeholders and build strong relationships across business and technology teams.


* Lead monthly service reviews, governance meetings and executive\-level service discussions.


* Prepare service performance dashboards covering SLA/KPI performance, incidents, problems, changes, user experience and improvement initiatives.


* Maintain RAID registers covering key risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies.


* Manage service escalations and ensure appropriate communication and stakeholder engagement.


* Coordinate delivery across internal teams, offshore/nearshore teams and third\-party suppliers.


* Ensure contractual obligations, service scope and operational responsibilities are clearly understood and maintained. Continuous Service Improvement \& Automation


* Establish and maintain a structured Continuous Service Improvement (CSI) programme for End User Services.


* Identify opportunities to reduce ticket volumes through automation, proactive remediation and self\-service.


* Drive automated endpoint remediation using Intune, Nexthink, SysTrack, PowerShell and other relevant technologies.


* Identify repetitive operational activities suitable for automation and measure the benefits achieved.


* Use service analytics and DEX telemetry to prioritise improvement initiatives based on business and user impact.


* Track improvements against measurable outcomes including ticket reduction, improved endpoint health, higher FCR, reduced MTTR and improved user satisfaction. Technical Knowledge The candidate should have strong working knowledge across several of the following technologies:


* Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, Nexthink, Lakeside SysTrack, Microsoft SCCM / MECM, Windows 10/11, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint, Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, Conditional Access and MFA, Active Directory and Group Policy, VDI technologies such as Citrix or Azure Virtual Desktop, PowerShell and endpoint automation, ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, Endpoint security and compliance technologies, ITIL\-based Incident, Problem, Change and Request Management



Experience \& Qualifications


* 8–12\+ years of IT experience, with at least 4–6 years in Service Delivery, End User Computing, Digital Workplace or related leadership roles.


* Experience with Intune and modern endpoint management environments is highly desirable.


* Experience with Nexthink, SysTrack or another DEX platform is strongly preferred.


* Experience managing Service Desk, Desktop Support and Endpoint Management services.


* Experience working within a Managed Services or large enterprise IT environment is preferred.


* ITIL Foundation certification is preferred; ITIL Managing Professional or equivalent would be advantageous.

 **Skills**  

Microsoft 365, ITIL, Incident Management, Problem Management

fccd8294.title: Pre Sales Associate
fccd8294.description:
**About Atlys** 




 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
 



 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
 



 Atlys is changing that.
 



 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We’re looking for a
 **Pre Sales Associate** 
 to turn customer interest into confident decisions and successful conversions.
 



 You’ll be one of the first people travellers speak to at Atlys, understanding what they need, helping them navigate their options, and building trust through clear, thoughtful conversations.
 



 This is a customer\-facing role for someone who can combine strong communication with commercial instinct, follow through consistently, and move quickly in a high\-volume environment.
 



  





**The Job** 



* **Engage and qualify potential customers** 
 across calls, chats and email by understanding their travel needs and guiding them toward the right Atlys solution.
* **Explain our products and visa processes clearly** 
 so customers understand their options, feel confident in their decision and know what happens next.
* **Drive leads through to conversion** 
 through thoughtful follow\-ups, objection handling and consistent ownership of the customer journey.
* **Learn from customer conversations** 
 by identifying recurring questions, pain points and signals that can improve conversion and the overall experience.
* **Work closely across teams** 
 with Marketing, Fulfilment and Product while keeping lead and interaction data accurate and up to date.



  





**The Ideal Candidate** 




 You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:
 


* Have 1\+ years of experience in pre\-sales, sales, customer success or another customer\-facing role.
* Communicate clearly and confidently, and can simplify complex information into easy, human conversations.
* Are persuasive without being pushy, with strong empathy and the ability to understand what a customer actually needs.
* Are proactive, organised and comfortable managing multiple conversations and follow\-ups in a fast\-paced environment.
* Are comfortable working a 6\-day schedule, with Monday to Friday in\-office and a rotational WFH shift on either Saturday or Sunday.



  





**What you can expect** 




 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
 



 Here’s what you can expect:
 


* **Competitive compensation and equity** 
 so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance** 
 covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy** 
 with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office** 
 , so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning \& development credits** 
 to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support** 
 to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work** 
 , including high\-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work** 
 , with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.



  





 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
 



  





*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

8b09ca12.description:
**Overview**
 Oracle Subscriptions Management Cloud lead is responsible for working closely with Business Analysts, Global Delivery Leads, and onshore/offshore development team members to help them implement Oracle Cloud solutions and be the SME in Subscriptions Revenue Management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should collaborate with our Engineering/BRM team to understand their business requirements, design solutions and support the implementation process to facilitate successful project delivery. You ll have the chance to bring in innovative concepts and ideas while utilizing our well\-established processes and best practices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Implement and Support Subscriptions and Revenue Management module in Oracle Cloud ERP production systems.
* Gather business requirements, document those, do fit gap analysis and map them to Oracle Cloud ERP application.
* Engage business users spanning multiple business units and ensure cohesive articulation of business goals and processes to ensure effective technology solutions.
* Do system configurations, create technical/functional design documents, develop and document test scripts.
* Conduct requirement and design workshops, manage and run conference room pilots, and drive user testing and training workshops.
* Co\-ordinate with the onshore functional and technical teams as needed for all project deliverables throughout the different phases of the implementation.


**Qualifications**
**Mandatory Skills**
* At least 12 \+ years of Implementation / Support experience in implementing Oracle ERP Applications.
* At least 2 Oracle Subscriptions Cloud implementations, working as Subscriptions lead functional consultant.
* Excellent functional knowledge and hands\-on experience on Oracle Subscriptions Cloud and Revenue Management Cloud
* Excellent functional knowledge and hands\-on experience on Oracle Fusion Pricing and Installed Base
* Experience working with Oracle CPQ and Order Management Cloud
* Must have good understanding of Saas Extensions \- using Groovy, Algorithms, Application Composer

* Good knowledge in Oracle Finance modules, General Ledger (GL), Receivables (AR), and Revenue Management.
* Good Knowledge of REST APIs and Integration Cloud
* Good Knowledge about Data Conversion/Migrations, Inbound/Outbound interfaces, and Reports.
* Ability to Configure Oracle Applications to meet client requirements and document application set\-ups.
* Good Knowledge in configuring SLA rules
* Good Knowledge in Oracle SCM \- Order Management, Pricing and Product management
* Strong consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit\-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilots (CRPs), perform functional configuration, perform functional testing and conduct user training workshops.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks on assignments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presentation skills.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills with the ability to exercise mature judgment.
* Ability to work well in a global team environment.

This role requires envisioning and articulating a clear and compelling architecture vision, establishing a target state for the enterprise, and developing a detailed transformation roadmap. f0b15311.title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
f0b15311.description:
Overview:
**Working at Atlassian**


Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

 **Why should you apply to this role?**  

The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.  

You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.  

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.


Responsibilities:
**Migration Strategy:** Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.

* **Risk Management**: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* **Technical Architecture:** Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* **Trusted Advisor:** Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* **Delivery Excellence:** Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* **Drive Accountability**: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* **Escalation Management:** Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* **Team Leadership**: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.

**Industry Insight:** Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.


Compensation:

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.


This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.


Qualifications:

Qualifications

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.

**Benefits \& Perks**  

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits****.**

 **About Atlassian**  

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.  

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.  

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.  

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit **go.atlassian.com/crh****.**  

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

 SymphonyAI is a leading enterprise AI solutions provider helping retailers and manufacturers optimize business operations through advanced analytics, planning, and automation solutions. Our products support global organizations in improving supply chain efficiency, inventory performance, forecasting accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Technical Consultant with strong technical expertise to support the implementation of SymphonyAI SCPO solutions for global retail customers. This is a customer\-facing role focused on US retailer rollout support, requiring close collaboration with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and implementation teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead technical discovery sessions and workshops with customers to understand current system landscapes, integration needs, and technical requirements.
* Design scalable and secure technical solutions aligned with SymphonyAI SCPO capabilities and customer business objectives.

* Configure and support REST APIs, middleware, messaging systems, and data integration pipelines.
* Provide hands\-on support across Java, Angular, .NET, shell scripting, and related technologies during implementation activities.
* Work with PL/SQL, Oracle databases, UNIX/Linux environments, and middleware platforms such as WebLogic and Glassfish.
* Support integration testing, defect resolution, performance validation, and production readiness activities.

* 6\-10 years of experience in enterprise application development, technical consulting, or software implementation.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java, Angular, .NET, and bash/shell scripting.
* Experience working with PL/SQL, Oracle databases, UNIX/Linux, middleware platforms such as WebLogic and Glassfish.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, system integrations, and enterprise application architecture.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Python, Kubernetes, Data Lake technologies, Snowflake, Kafka, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Familiarity with retail planning systems, supply chain applications, or enterprise retail platforms.
* Exposure to implementation projects for US\-based retailers.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to work on high\-impact retail transformation programs.
* Exposure to leading global retailers and large\-scale implementation projects.
* A collaborative and fast\-paced work environment.

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,000\+ employees and 24,000\+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

  

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

  

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future  

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation

  

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

 *For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud**.*

 **About the role:**


Cvent’s Platform Services team is looking for a Senior Cloud Systems/Platform Engineer based in India. You’ll work shifted hours to provide morning overlap with the US team, covering day\-to\-day Linux operations, driving automation initiatives, and taking technical lead ownership on infrastructure and application projects. This is a hands\-on role — we want someone who identifies toil and builds solutions, not just executes tickets.


In This Role, You Will::
* Provide Follow\-the\-Sun Linux operations coverage; monitor, respond to incidents, and perform root cause analysis.
* Administer Rocky Linux / RHEL / CentOS systems across on\-prem datacenters (SF, CO, Amsterdam) and cloud environments.
* Design and maintain Ansible playbooks, roles, and inventories for configuration management, patching, and deployments.
* Manage OS lifecycle and patching using tools such as Foreman, Satellite, or equivalent.
* Build and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines (declarative/Jenkinsfile); integrate automation tooling into release workflows.
* Manage Git repositories and IaC version control; enforce code review and change management practices.
* Administer and troubleshoot Java application servers (WebLogic, Tomcat) and web servers (NGINX, Apache).
* Support workloads in GCP, AWS, and/or Azure; contribute to cloud migration projects.
* Work with Kubernetes/GKE for containerized workload operations and deployments.
* Lead and contribute to migration of legacy monitoring platforms to Datadog, including APM, centralized logging, security monitoring, dashboards, and alerting.
* Evaluate and integrate AI\-assisted tooling into automation and operational workflows (e.g., AI powered observability, LLM\-assisted scripting, intelligent alerting).
* Write clean, maintainable Bash and Python scripts for operational tooling.
* Participate in on\-call rotation; collaborate daily with US\-based engineers and management.


Here's What You Need::
**Must\-have:**

* 7\+ years Linux sysadmin experience in production enterprise environments (Rocky Linux, RHEL,  

CentOS).
* 3\+ years hands\-on Ansible/AWX — writing playbooks, roles, and inventories from scratch.
* Jenkins CI/CD pipeline experience (declarative syntax / Jenkinsfile).
* Git proficiency — branching strategies, IaC version control, PR workflows.
* Hands\-on cloud experience — AWS preferred, GCP and Azure helpful. Ability to administer and deploy workloads, not just familiarity.
* Shifted schedule availability for US morning overlap (\~4:00 PM–12:30 AM IST).
* Strong English communication skills — daily collaboration with US team.
* Kubernetes / GKE experience.

**Nice\-to\-have:**

* AI tooling exposure — AI\-assisted observability, LLM\-integrated scripting, or automation platforms with AI capabilities.
* OS patch management tooling: Foreman, Satellite, or equivalent.
* Java app server administration: WebLogic, Tomcat.
* Infrastructure\-as\-code in cloud environments.
* Additional CI/CD tooling: GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD.
* Monitoring/observability platforms — Datadog preferred; Checkmk, Nagios, Zabbix, or similar also relevant.
* F5 BIG\-IP or enterprise load balancer exposure.
* Multi\-cloud (AWS \+ Azure/GCP) experience.

**What We Are Looking For**
* A broad range of technical skills and knowledge of working on fincrime and regtech products as a solutions architect.
* 10\+ years in software application domain and 5\+ years architecture / design experience.
* Strong problem solving and diagnostic skills.
* Demonstrates adaptability to change and a strong ability to learn new concepts quickly.
* Experience with API integration technologies such as REST and GraphQL.
* Experience big data technology such as Spark and Kafka.
* Experience in databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL.
* Hands\-on experience with modern deployment tools (e.g., GitHub/GitHub Actions, Helm, Docker) and practices.
* Hands\-on experience with forward deployment engineering, including model operationalization (MLOps), CI/CD, and cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Proficient with AI/ML frameworks.
* Experience of working on Application Server such as JBOSS, Websphere, WidlFly.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering AI\-driven projects from concept to production.
* Experience in Agile methodologies and fast\-paced deployment cycles.


**Why Join Us?**
* Opportunity to be at the forefront of financial crime prevention technology.
* A dynamic and supportive work environment that fosters innovation and collaboration.
* Competitive salary and benefits package, including health and dental insurance, flexible working arrangement, and more.
* The chance to work with a global team of passionate AI and machine learning experts.
* Professional development opportunities to advance your career in a rapidly growing industry.

This position offers the opportunity to design, build, and evolve solutions that bring generative AI and intelligent workflows into everyday sales experiences.
   

  

 You will work across the application stack and collaborate with Product, AI and machine learning, Data, Security, Solution Architecture, and Engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions used globally.

* Guide technical solutions across front\-end, back\-end, APIs, data services, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
* Translate product requirements and business needs into secure, maintainable solutions and intuitive user experiences.
* Integrate generative AI models, AI services, APIs, retrieval systems, and agentic workflows into production applications.

* Proficiency in one or more languages or frameworks, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, React, Node.js, or similar technologies.
* Experience designing APIs, distributed applications, data services, enterprise integrations, scalable cloud applications, databases, and messaging systems.

* Ability to lead technical initiatives, make informed engineering decisions, communicate with technical and non\-technical teams, and mentor engineers.

* Experience building generative AI applications, including AI assistants, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, AI productivity tools, Python\-based AI services, large language model APIs, vector databases, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation.

336a35d5.title: Sr Program Manager, Retail Business Services
336a35d5.description:
**Description**
 Senior Program Manager, Purchase – Retail Business Services
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead strategy and execution for Shopping Mission Completion, ensuring customers can seamlessly discover, evaluate, and purchase products across the Amazon store.
   

  

**About Amazon**
 Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the widest of selection at low price that drives Amazon’s flywheel.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The vision of Retail Business Services (RBS) Organization at Amazon is to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel by improving customer experience and enabling our Selling Partners (SPs) to grow their business with Amazon. RBS provides catalog augmentation and correction technologies for the Amazon selling community. Our solutions ensure information in Amazon's catalogs is both complete and comprehensive enough to give our customers a great shopping experience every time.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 RBS is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead a Strategy for Shopping Mission Completion for Customers. Amazon Store Walk analysis uncovers critical defects across the Amazon shopping journey; spanning across product discovery, evaluation, and purchase completion. These systemic problems impact the customer shopping journey, from how customers discover and evaluate products to their ability to complete purchases. These issues are categorized into four key defect themes: Data, Search, Catalog and Customer Experience. To resolve these issues, we recommend a coordinated, cross\-functional engagement with partner teams that will improve overall customer shopping experience . This role will be at the center of collaboration between multiple world wide teams in re\-imagining the purchase experience for customers.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Shopping Mission is an essential part of the consumer experience and can fundamentally influence the way customers shop on Amazon as well as shape their perception of Amazon.
   

  

 As a Senior Program Manager \- Purchase, you will
   

  

* Think Big and own vision for building a Strategy that enables customers to complete their shopping journey.
* Disambiguate the problem space and size the problem and opportunity for RBS
* Be responsible for end\-to\-end business strategy, goal setting, program management, review and collaboration mechanisms.
* Break down ambiguous problems into clear abstract use cases and solution workflows for Tech and Product teams.
* Be responsible for end to end program management with multiple parallel tasks.
* Establish accountability with partner teams and influence them without authority on a common goals.
* Identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate them.
* Be responsible for reporting and review mechanisms and communication to Leadership (Flash updates, WBR, QBR, Deep dives)


 To be successful in this role, you should be comfortable and confident liaising with remote global teams in business, design and technology at senior leadership levels. You will solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). You will be data\-driven and demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships).
   

  

 Representing the voice of customers, you will be an evangelist for the program vision, maintaining support for your cause, keeping engineering teams energized and excited, and driving your program roadmap at all levels. You will be very comfortable with written communication skills and a proven track record of delivering projects from concept to launch.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The 'Shopping Mission' program is part of the Customer Experience vertical of RBS. The program is responsible for defining the Vision and long term strategy of improving Customer Experience through improving the quality of Amazon products. RBS is the global sponsor of the program, bringing together multiple world\-wide product, design and engineering teams to execute in a federated manner.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

4d0af432.title: AWS Solution Architect
4d0af432.description:

 At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever\-evolving digital landscape with cutting\-edge, tailored strategies.
   

  

 We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post\-launch, we've earned the distinction of being Salesforce's \#1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.
   

  

 Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI\-powered transformation. Here, you'll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI\-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you're ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.
   

  

 AS AN AWS SOLUTION ARCHITECT, YOU WILL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:
   

  

* Ensure customer success in building and launching Amazon Connect solutions for NeuraFlash customers
* Conduct technology assessment and audits to identify the need (from an ROI and Outcomes perspective) to move to CCaaS AWS Connect Platform, improving agent experience and productivity
* Facilitate business process reviews to identify customer requirements and processes
* Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Lead discovery for customers, help customers build ROIs for projects, and deliver presentations and estimate for delivering that ROI
* Translate customer requirements into contact center design, leveraging best practices, and other AWS Services
* Oversee and mentor technical teams, providing guidance and support to ensure that proposed solution (on Salesforce and AWS Cloud) is delivered on time, on budget, and to the required quality standards
* Act as a liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders, communicating technical concepts in a clear and understandable manner, and managing expectations and priorities
* Drive best practice contact center design into each and every aspect of solution delivery
* Effectively manage all aspects of project and customer communications
* Deliver customer end user training and documentation
* Exercise independent judgment, and take the lead role on enterprise level projects with minimal direction from senior management
* Lead vision and strategy discussions with contact center and customer service leadership and management


 QUALIFICATIONS:
   

  

* Customer\-facing contact center experience
* Experience building integrations across WFM, CRM, and contact center solutions
* Experience with communications protocols and APIs such as WebRTC and SIP
* Experience with hands\-on Scripting/coding (e.g., python, java, c\#, .NET, Node.js)
* Communication and presentation skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with executives, IT Management, and customers
* API integration experience
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills
* Experience with Cloudformation, Contact Flow Design, Lambda Integration, Lex Integration, and Call Center Routing
* Knowledge of automation tools and frameworks for building, testing, and deploying software, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CodeDeploy
* Contact Center architecture knowledge
* Experience in technology/software sales, pre\-sales, or consulting
* Advanced knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture
* Salesforce knowledge and familiarity with Salesforce Service Cloud
* Contact center product knowledge of other platforms (Genesys, Cisco, Avaya, Twilio, etc.)
* Experience with WorkForce Management solutions
* Experience working with outbound dialers and campaign management
* Knowledge of software development methodologies such as Agile and Scrum
* AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification
* AWS Developer Associate Certification or Professional
* AWS Solution Architect Certification or Professional
* Salesforce Certified Administrator


**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
*All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.*
 What's it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?
   

  

* Remote \& In\-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we're focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
* Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet\-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
* Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in\-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9\-5 isn't possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
* Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it's a no\-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls \& company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.

And while we work hard, we don't forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

898be4d6.title: SAP PM / PP-PI Solution Architect
898be4d6.description:
About the Company We are a global IT and digital transformation services organization helping enterprises modernize their business processes through SAP, cloud, data, and emerging technologies. With a strong presence across global markets, the organization works with leading enterprises on large\-scale SAP transformation, implementation, integration, and managed services engagements. We are looking for experienced SAP professionals who can work closely with business stakeholders, lead complex SAP transformation initiatives, and deliver scalable solutions across global client environments. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced SAP PM / PP\-PI Solution Architect with strong hands\-on experience in SAP Plant Maintenance and Process Manufacturing. The ideal candidate should have extensive experience leading end\-to\-end SAP implementations, strong business knowledge of the Life Sciences / Process Industry, and proven expertise in maintenance, batch management, planning, and sampling processes. The candidate will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable SAP solutions, leading workshops, designing functional processes, configuring SAP PM, coordinating with cross\-functional teams, and supporting implementation and transformation programs. Candidates with strong S/4HANA experience, SAP certification, and experience in global implementation programs will be preferred. Key Responsibilities Lead and execute full lifecycle SAP PM implementations including blueprinting, requirement gathering, configuration, testing, training, cutover, and go\-live support. Lead business requirement workshops with business users, maintenance teams, planners, engineers, and senior stakeholders. Analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP functional designs and system configurations. Design and implement SAP PM processes covering: Preventive Maintenance Corrective Maintenance Breakdown Maintenance Maintenance Planning Calibration Refurbishment Warranty Management Maintenance Notifications Maintenance Orders Configure SAP PM master data including: Equipment Functional Locations Equipment BOMs Maintenance Task Lists Maintenance Plans Work Centers Measuring Points Maintenance Strategies Configure maintenance order types, planning parameters, priorities, notification types, catalog profiles, and related PM settings. Provide strong expertise in SAP PP\-PI processes, particularly within process manufacturing and life sciences environments. Design and support Batch Management, Production Planning, Sampling Processes, and Process Industry scenarios. Ensure appropriate integration between SAP PM, PP\-PI, QM, MM, FI/CO, PS, and CS. Work closely with SAP QM teams on quality inspection, calibration, sampling, and maintenance\-related quality processes. Ensure seamless integration with procurement, inventory, quality management, production, finance, controlling, and project systems. Coordinate with ABAP and technical teams for functional specifications, enhancements, reports, interfaces, BAPIs/BADIs, user exits, and other developments. Prepare functional specifications, configuration documents, process flows, test scripts, training materials, and solution documentation. Develop and execute unit, system integration, regression, and user acceptance test scenarios. Lead defect resolution and provide functional troubleshooting during implementation and post\-go\-live phases. Provide post\-go\-live support and ensure system stability and business continuity. Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, automation, and adoption of SAP best practices. Handle change requests, enhancements, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives across ECC and S/4HANA environments. Provide solution guidance and functional leadership to junior consultants and project team members. Transfer knowledge to client teams and internal consultants. Stay current with SAP product developments, industry trends, and emerging asset management technologies. Interact confidently with customer leadership and senior management. Participate in project\-specific business travel as required. Required Technical \& Functional Skills SAP PM SAP PP\-PI SAP S/4HANA Maintenance Planning Maintenance Orders Preventive Maintenance Corrective Maintenance Breakdown Management Calibration Refurbishment Warranty Management Equipment Management Functional Locations Maintenance Task Lists Maintenance Plans SAP PM Master Data Batch Management Process Manufacturing Planning Processes Sampling Processes SAP QM Integration SAP MM Integration SAP FI/CO Integration SAP PS Integration SAP CS Integration Functional Specifications SAP Testing SAP Implementation SAP Configuration Industry Experience Strong experience in Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical / Process Manufacturing is highly preferred. Experience in the following industries will also be considered advantageous: Pharmaceuticals Life Sciences Chemicals Manufacturing Oil \& Gas Utilities Automotive Heavy Engineering Consumer Products S/4HANA \& Emerging Technology Exposure Candidates with experience in the following areas will have an advantage: SAP S/4HANA Asset Management S/4HANA PM SAP Fiori Simplified Data Models SAP Asset Manager Mobile PM Solutions Predictive Maintenance SAP Workflow IoT Integration SAP Analytics Cloud Asset Management Analytics Education \& Certification Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or an equivalent discipline. SAP PM / EAM certification is an added advantage. S/4HANA certification in PM/EAM is preferred. Candidate Profile Minimum 8 years of SAP PM experience. At least 3 end\-to\-end SAP implementations. Strong hands\-on configuration experience. Strong understanding of business processes in process manufacturing / life sciences. Ability to connect business requirements with SAP solutions. Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication. Strong documentation and presentation skills. Excellent facilitation and stakeholder\-management skills. Strong executive presence with the ability to interact with customer top management. Ability to coach and mentor team members. Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative mindset. Passion for SAP and willingness to learn emerging technologies. Willingness to travel based on project requirements

Pay: Up to ₹1,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

849770eb.title: Technical Solutions Engineer I, Infrastructure, Compute, Google Cloud
849770eb.description:
Application Instructions: This role requires you to work in a shift pattern or non\-standard work hours as required. This may include weekend work.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience troubleshooting and advocating for customer needs, and triaging technical issues (e.g., hardware, software, application, operational, process).
* 5 years of experience with computer networking and web technologies (e.g., HTTP, HTML, DNS, etc.).
* Experience with one or more core programming or scripting languages (e.g., C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, Python, JavaScript, PowerShell, Bash/Shell, Perl, Visual Basic).
* Experience with Linux/Unix or other operating systems.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Vmware certification.
* Experience with any of the following solutions: system virtualization, on\-premise or hybrid cloud computing.
* Experience with cloud computing (i.e., certifications, internships, coursework, etc.) and debugging complex workload issues across large\-scale, multi\-node environments.
* Experience working with distributed systems.
* Expertise on Vsphere,VCF,VSAN, NSX,HCX and Vmware Vitualisation.
* Familiarity with common solutions, design patterns, or best practices.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.



As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will own our large and important customer issues in addition to providing level two support to our other support teams. You will be a part of a global team that provides 24x7 support to help customers seamlessly make the switch to Google Cloud.  

In this role, you will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and when needed, coding/scripting. You will make our products easier to adopt and use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes and documentation. Our Technical Solutions team is driven by customers and you will help drive the success of Google Cloud by understanding and advocating for our customers’ issues.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work within a team of engineers/consultants that globally ensure 24\-hour customer support.
* Manage the customer’s problem through effective diagnosis, resolution, or investigation tools implementation to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products.
* Act as a consultant and subject matter expert for Engineering, Sales, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment obstacles and improve Google Cloud.
* Develop an understanding of Google's product technology and underlying architectures by troubleshooting, reproducing, determining the root cause for customer reported issues, and building tools for faster diagnosis.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to improve the product, and interact with Site Reliability Engineering teams to drive high\-quality production. Understand customer issues and advocate for their needs with cross\-functional teams.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

831735a2.title: Senior Solution Architect — Sales AI Applications
831735a2.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Solution Architect — Sales AI Applications based in India.**
 This is a senior technical opportunity focused on building intelligent applications that transform enterprise sales workflows through generative AI.
   

  

 You will work across the full application stack, from user experiences and APIs to data services, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on software engineering with solution architecture, technical leadership, and strategic decision\-making.
   

  

 You will collaborate with Product, AI/ML, Data, Security, Engineering, and Architecture teams in a highly cross\-functional environment.
   

  

 Your work will help bring AI assistants, retrieval systems, and agentic workflows from concepts and prototypes into secure, reliable production applications.
   

  

 You will also influence engineering standards, mentor developers, and help shape scalable solutions used by global teams.
   

  

 The position offers the opportunity to solve complex technology challenges at the intersection of enterprise software, cloud computing, and AI.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable full\-stack applications supporting enterprise sales workflows and intelligent user experiences.
* Provide technical direction across front\-end and back\-end development, APIs, data services, enterprise integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
* Translate business and product requirements into secure, maintainable, scalable, and user\-focused technical solutions.
* Architect and integrate generative AI models, AI services, APIs, retrieval systems, and agentic workflows into production applications.
* Design application architectures with strong emphasis on performance, availability, observability, security, scalability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Lead technical design discussions, assess alternative implementation approaches, make architecture decisions, and evaluate emerging technologies.
* Improve engineering practices across testing, code quality, CI/CD, monitoring, documentation, reliability, and production readiness.
* Investigate complex technical and production issues and develop solutions that improve application reliability and user experience.
* Collaborate closely with Product, AI/ML, Data, Security, Solution Architecture, and Engineering stakeholders to deliver integrated solutions.
* Mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and contribute to engineering standards, development practices, and a strong collaborative culture.
* Help advance AI capabilities from experimentation and prototyping into robust, scalable, enterprise\-ready applications.
* Contribute to responsible AI adoption by considering security, privacy, access controls, governance, and operational requirements throughout the solution lifecycle.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline is preferred.
* 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including designing, developing, and operating production\-grade applications.
* Strong full\-stack development experience using modern front\-end, back\-end, and web application technologies.
* Proficiency in one or more technologies such as Python, Java, JavaScript, React, Node.js, or comparable frameworks and languages.
* Proven experience designing APIs, distributed applications, data services, enterprise integrations, databases, messaging systems, and scalable cloud applications.
* Experience integrating AI or machine learning capabilities through APIs, models, retrieval systems, or managed AI services.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, application security, testing, observability, reliability, and production operations.
* Ability to lead complex technical initiatives, make sound engineering and architectural decisions, and communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated mentoring and technical leadership capabilities, with the ability to influence engineering teams and establish effective development practices.
* Experience with generative AI applications such as AI assistants, RAG, agentic workflows, LLM APIs, vector databases, prompt engineering, AI evaluation, or AI productivity solutions is a strong advantage.
* Experience taking AI solutions from prototype through production while integrating traditional software systems, data pipelines, and enterprise applications is highly valued.
* Familiarity with responsible AI, data privacy, security, access management, and enterprise AI governance is beneficial.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, microservices, infrastructure as code, DevOps, application performance, observability, reliability, scalability, and cloud cost optimization is advantageous.
* Comfortable working with globally distributed engineering teams and managing multiple priorities in a fast\-moving technical environment.


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to work on innovative generative AI and intelligent workflow applications with global business impact.
* Remote work flexibility in India, with the role also available in Pune.
* Exposure to large\-scale cloud applications, distributed systems, AI services, and enterprise technology.
* Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams spanning Product, AI/ML, Data, Security, Engineering, and Architecture.
* Opportunity to influence technical architecture, engineering standards, and the evolution of AI\-powered sales applications.
* Strong opportunities for technical leadership, mentoring, professional growth, and continuous learning.

9b481d0e.title: Sr. Solutions Architect
9b481d0e.description:
**Description**  

Sr. Solutions Architect  



  

**Full Location:** Bengaluru \- IN

  

The Sr. Solutions Architect designs and sells winning outsourcing solutions for the assigned vertical. This role owns the solution response on new business and expansion pursuits: sizing the work, shaping the operating and delivery model, building the staffing and cost model, and making a clear case for how ResultsCX (RCX) will run the client’s customer experience better than it runs today. The role works directly with prospects and clients (“client”) and with RCX sales, operations, workforce management, recruiting, training, and pricing teams to produce solutions that win in the market and hold up in the field. The measures that matter are operational and commercial: cost to serve, CSAT and NPS, first contact resolution, sales conversion, quality, and compliance. This role also shapes the transformation roadmap for large multi\-tower deals, new geographies, and new service offerings.

**In this role you will:**

* Own the solution end to end on assigned pursuits, from qualification through contract signature and handoff to the implementation and transition teams.
* Drive the process with a sense of urgency while protecting the quality of the solution.
* Timely responses to RFIs, RFPs, proposals, and contractual obligations.
* Development and delivery of client presentations, solution documents, and the commercial story behind the price.
* Orchestration of pilots, site visits, and proof\-of\-concept work.
* Preparation of cost estimates, staffing models, and pricing assumptions.
* Coordination of operations, workforce management, recruiting, training, and quality resources as required.
* Identify solutioning opportunities
* Conducting discovery across the client’s current operation: volumes, channels, handle times, shrinkage, occupancy, staffing, schedules, and cost per contact.
* Capturing pain points and business requirements, and documenting both the “as is” and “to be” operating models.
* Build a clear picture of how the client’s operation runs today
* Match RCX delivery locations, labor models, and service offerings to what the client actually needs.
* Identify performance gaps and recommend practical options to close them.
* Assess risk and regulatory exposure that affects the client’s operation and the proposed solution.
* Design solutions that combine people, process, and automation in a mix the client can adopt and RCX can deliver.
* Maintain professional and industry knowledge by attending events and workshops, reviewing industry publications, building a network, and participating in professional associations.

**We are looking for someone who has:**

* A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in area of Business, Management, Marketing, Finance or other closely degree. Equivalent experience may be substituted for education.
* Master’s Degree a plus.
* A minimum of four (4\) years of progressive experience in BPO, contact center, or outsourced services solutioning, sales support, or operations leadership, with a track record of shaping deals that were won and then delivered.
* Strong hands\-on experience building outsourcing solutions across customer care, sales and retention, back office (F\&A, supply chain, and similar), and trust and safety, including labor models, delivery footprint, FTE and seat build, and pricing constructs. Consulting or outsourcing sales\-support experience preferred.
* A deep domain expertise in the core vertical for which they are being hired.
* A demonstrated ability to drive sales origination in a prior role.
* Cross\-industry experience required; must have breadth across multiple verticals and understand how to apply those learnings across them.
* Experience with large, complex outsourcing programs and transitions that delivered measurable results: lower cost to serve, higher customer satisfaction, better operating efficiency, and stronger quality and compliance.
* Experience at ResultsCX or in the BPO industry with hands\-on contact center operations experience in a frontline, workforce management, quality, or site leadership role.

 **About ResultsCX:**


ResultsCX is a premier customer experience partner to Fortune 100 and 500 companies. We design, build, and deliver digitally influenced customer journeys that achieve the satisfaction and loyalty brands need to thrive and grow, while improving efficiency and reducing costs. ResultsCX’s 30\+\-year track record for reimagining the customer experience to meet consumers’ evolving expectations has driven growth to more than 20 geographic hubs and approximately 20,000 colleagues worldwide. Our core expertise extends to actionable analytics, contact center as a service (CCaaS), and our own SupportPredict AI\-powered digital experience platform. Our strength lies in exceptional individuals working together in a high\-performing, fun culture to deliver next\-generation customer experiences on behalf of our clients.

  

Results\-CX is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factors under federal, state, or local law.

26005c4b.title: Solution Architect
26005c4b.description:
**Project Role :** Solution Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Translate client requirements into differentiated, deliverable solutions using in\-depth knowledge of a technology, function, or platform. Collaborate with the Sales Pursuit and Delivery Teams to develop a winnable and deliverable solution that underpins the client value proposition and business case.
  

**Must have skills :** Network Architecture and Design  

**Good to have skills :** SD\-WAN Implementation  

Minimum **12** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Solution Architect, a typical day involves interpreting and transforming client needs into unique and actionable solutions that align with business objectives. This role requires close collaboration with sales and delivery teams to craft strategies that not only meet client expectations but also provide a strong foundation for successful project execution. The position demands continuous engagement with various stakeholders to ensure that the proposed solutions are practical, innovative, and add significant value to the client s business case, fostering long\-term partnerships and successful outcomes.  

We are seeking a seasoned and highly experienced Senior Solution Architect to join our Technology Practice. This is a strategic, client\-facing solutioning role where the primary focus is converting sales\-qualified opportunities into well\-defined, technically sound, and commercially viable solutions. Opportunities are brought in by the Sales Team — your remit begins with validating the requirement and ends with a complete solution ready for delivery.
  

The successful candidate will work in close partnership with the Sales Team to understand client needs, validate scope, and develop compelling solution proposals. This role demands exceptional communication skills, deep technical expertise across networking, cloud, and Microsoft technologies, and the ability to define resource requirements and delivery timelines with precision.
  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Requirement Validation \& Sales Collaboration

Receive sales\-qualified opportunities from the Sales Team and conduct thorough validation of client requirements, scope, and technical feasibility.
  

Work closely with the Sales Team to clarify ambiguities, fill gaps in the brief, and ensure a clear understanding of the client's business and technical needs before solutioning begins.
  

Act as the key liaison between the Sales Team and the technical practice — ensuring alignment on scope, timelines, and commercial expectations throughout the engagement.
  

* Client Engagement \& Advisory

Lead client\-facing conversations to probe, validate, and refine requirements in collaboration with the Sales Team.
  

Build credibility with client stakeholders as a trusted technical advisor, articulating solution value clearly at both technical and business levels.
  

Present solution proposals, architecture blueprints, and delivery roadmaps with confidence to client and internal stakeholders.
  

* Solutioning \& Architecture

Design end\-to\-end technical solutions across SD\-WAN, networking, Microsoft Product Suite, and Cloud Implementation Services based on validated requirements.
  

Define resource requirements and effort estimates — specifying the number of resources and number of days required for delivery.
  

Develop high\-level and detailed architecture documentation, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and technical proposals.
  

Ensure proposed solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with client business objectives and industry best practices.
  

* Internal Coordination \& Stakeholder Management

Coordinate internally with delivery leads, engineers, project managers, vendors, and practice leads to validate and refine solutions prior to submission.
